consumer.sentenceEn: Librarians know that patrons aren't just information consumers , they're information producers.
consumer.translationZh: 图书馆员们知道，读者不仅仅是信息的消费者，更是信息的生产者。

consumer.sentenceEn: Behavioral scientist Linda Bacon, one of the study's authors, said, "Restaurants can have a positive impact on the environment by encouraging their customers to choose more plant-based food and less meat. However, our findings suggest that while certain restaurant menu designs can encourage some consumers to make pro-environmental food choices, they can have the opposite effect on others."
consumer.translationZh: 该研究的作者之一、行为科学家琳达·培根（Linda Bacon）表示：“餐厅可以通过鼓励顾客选择更多植物基食物、减少肉类消费，从而对环境产生积极影响。然而，我们的研究结果表明，虽然某些餐厅菜单的设计可以鼓励部分消费者做出环保的饮食选择，但对其他人可能会产生适得其反的效果。”
consumer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

consumer.sentenceEn: The opposing side agrees that renewables are crucial, but says society needs an amount of power available to meet consumers' basic demands when the sun isn't shining and the wind isn't blowing.
consumer.translationZh: 反对一方同意可再生能源至关重要，但认为社会需要一定量的电力储备，以满足在没有阳光照耀、没有风吹动时消费者的基本需求。
consumer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

consumer.sentenceEn: While there is strong scientific consensus around most existing guidelines, one question has recently stirred debate: should consumers be warned to avoid ultra-processed foods?
consumer.translationZh: 虽然科学界对大多数现有指南有着强烈共识，但最近有一个问题引发了争议：是否应该警告消费者避免超加工食品？
consumer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

consumer.sentenceEn: For their arguments to prevail, advocates of free trade must try to forge bonds of affection between consumers at home and producers overseas.
consumer.translationZh: 要让自由贸易的主张获得认可，其倡导者必须努力在国内消费者与海外生产者之间建立情感纽带。

consumer.sentenceEn: Consumers often have a craving for the latest model.
consumer.translationZh: 消费者常常渴望拥有最新款产品。

community.sentenceEn: Archives preserve historic artifacts, oral histories, digital history projects, and scholarly writings relevant to the community , including minority groups.
community.translationZh: 档案馆保存与社区相关的历史文物、口述历史、数字历史项目和学术著作，包括少数群体的相关资料。

community.sentenceEn: Through library collections, programs, and physical spaces, children learn to share, to be engaged in their communities , to participate in the arts, and to explore their immediate world and the world at large.
community.translationZh: 通过图书馆的馆藏资源、活动项目和实体空间，孩子们学会分享，参与社区活动，投身艺术体验，并探索身边世界及更广阔的天地。

community.sentenceEn: Many people point out the value public libraries bring to their communities .
community.translationZh: 许多人指出公共图书馆为社区带来的价值。

community.sentenceEn: We encourage you to try some of these ideas in your own libraries, and we hope that these ideas will help you be better able to convince your community leaders of the important role that public libraries play in communities large and small.
community.translationZh: 我们鼓励您在自己的图书馆中尝试这些想法，希望这些想法能帮助您更好地向社区领导者说明公共图书馆在大大小小社区中所发挥的重要作用。

community.sentenceEn: These are inspiring and hopefully will encourage librarians interested in community services and cultural outreach to make connections with each other, share ideas, and build partnerships.
community.translationZh: 这些内容令人鼓舞，希望能激励那些对社区服务和文化推广感兴趣的图书馆员们相互建立联系、分享想法并建立合作伙伴关系。

community.sentenceEn: Programs like ImaginOn in Charlotte, North Carolina, provide exciting models that take community partnership, creativity, and creation to a new level.
community.translationZh: 北卡罗来纳州夏洛特市的ImaginOn等项目提供了令人振奋的模式，将社区合作、创造力和创新提升到了新高度。

climate.sentenceEn: Like many, Charlene experiences climate anxiety—a chronic fear of a climate catastrophe—and was, at the time, looking for an outlet.
climate.translationZh: 和许多人一样，夏琳患有气候焦虑症——一种对气候灾难的长期恐惧——并且当时正在寻找一个宣泄的途径。
climate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

climate.sentenceEn: Pesticide use on college campuses also contributes to our global climate crisis.
climate.translationZh: 大学校园使用农药也加剧了全球气候危机。
climate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

climate.sentenceEn: The problem was that analysts from the FAO used a comprehensive life-cycle assessment to study the climate impact of livestock, but a different method when they analyzed transportation.
climate.translationZh: 问题在于，联合国粮农组织(FAO)的分析师在研究畜牧业对气候的影响时使用了全面的生命周期评估方法，而在分析交通运输时却采用了另一种不同的方法。

climate.sentenceEn: Climate change demands urgent attention, and the livestock industry has a large overall environmental footprint that affects air, water and land.
climate.translationZh: 气候变化亟需关注，而畜牧业的整体环境足迹巨大，影响着空气、水和土地。

climate.sentenceEn: Environmentalists try hard to make people consume less meat to combat climate change.
climate.translationZh: 环保人士努力促使人们减少肉类消费，以应对气候变化。

climate.sentenceEn: Yes, eating meat affects the environment, but cows are not killing the climate
climate.translationZh: 是的，吃肉确实会影响环境，但牛并非是气候的杀手

challenge.sentenceEn: Unexcused absences can be a powerful signal of how those out-of-school challenges affect children's academic progress.
challenge.translationZh: 无故缺课能有力地反映出校外挑战对儿童学业进展的影响。
challenge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

challenge.sentenceEn: We believe unexcused absence is a strong signal of the many challenges children and families face, including economic and medical hardships.
challenge.translationZh: 我们认为，无故缺课是儿童和家庭面临诸多挑战的强烈信号，包括经济困难和医疗困境。
challenge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

challenge.sentenceEn: Feeding this many people will raise immense challenges .
challenge.translationZh: 养活这么多人将面临巨大挑战。

challenge.sentenceEn: Americans' growing aversion to spending time in the kitchen signifies a host of challenges for the grocery industry.
challenge.translationZh: 美国人日益厌恶在厨房劳作，这给杂货零售业带来了一系列挑战。
challenge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第17句

challenge.sentenceEn: What does the passage say signifies a host of challenges for America's grocery industry?
challenge.translationZh: 文中提到的哪些迹象表明美国食品零售业正面临诸多挑战？

challenge.sentenceEn: They point directly to many of the out-of-school challenges confronting children and their families.
challenge.translationZh: 它们直接指向儿童及其家庭面临的许多校外挑战。

claim.sentenceEn: Supporters of libraries as community builders claim that unless you are out there changing neighborhoods, you are not completing the work you are to do.
claim.translationZh: 支持图书馆作为社区建设者的人认为，除非你切实参与到社区改造中，否则你就没有完成应尽的工作。

claim.sentenceEn: That is very different from claiming that livestock represents as much as or more than transportation.
claim.translationZh: 这与声称畜牧业排放等同于甚至超过交通运输排放的说法截然不同。

claim.sentenceEn: This latter claim was wrong, and has since been corrected by Henning Stenfeld, the report's senior author.
claim.translationZh: 后一种说法是错误的，报告的主要作者亨宁·斯滕菲尔德后来对此进行了更正。

claim.sentenceEn: A key claim underlying these arguments holds that globally, meat production generates more greenhouse gases than the entire transportation sector.
claim.translationZh: 这些论点的一个核心主张认为，在全球范围内，肉类生产产生的温室气体比整个交通运输部门还要多。

claim.sentenceEn: Why does Professor Tom Oliver claim that the material "us" is constantly changing?
claim.translationZh: 为什么汤姆·奥利弗教授声称“我们”这种物质在不断变化？

claim.sentenceEn: Its owner has forgot to pick it up from the baggage claim .
claim.translationZh: 它的主人忘了从行李提取处把它取走。

career.sentenceEn: Colleges, workplaces and career counselors who promote the "follow your passion" path for everyone, without leveling the playing field, help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities among career aspirants.
career.translationZh: 大学、工作场所和职业顾问向所有人宣扬"追随激情"的道路，却不创造公平的竞争环境，这会加剧职业追求者之间的社会经济不平等。
career.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

career.sentenceEn: It wasn't until I began to research this widely accepted career advice that I understood how problematic it really was.
career.translationZh: 直到我开始研究这个被广泛接受的职业建议，我才明白它实际上存在多大问题。
career.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

career.sentenceEn: Surveys show the American public has long held the passion principle in high regard as a career decision-making priority.
career.translationZh: 调查显示，长期以来，美国公众高度重视以热情为原则的职业决策优先事项。
career.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

career.sentenceEn: M: A career in law is a beautiful thing in my opinion.
career.translationZh: 男：在我看来，法律行业的职业生涯是一份美好的事业。
career.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

career.sentenceEn: What will many people say about a career in law?
career.translationZh: 很多人会如何评价法律行业的职业？

career.sentenceEn: Many more career aspirants end up unemployed.
career.translationZh: 更多的职业追求者最终失业。

case.sentenceEn: So in many cases I am employed to arbitrate between two clashing parties.
case.translationZh: 因此在很多情况下，我受雇于两方冲突之间进行仲裁。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

case.sentenceEn: We find neither to be the case .
case.translationZh: 我们发现两种情况都不成立。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第3句

case.sentenceEn: I imagine someone from your office called our central office and I'm the engineer designated to your case .
case.translationZh: 我想应该是您办公室有人联系了我们的总部，而我是负责您这个案子的工程师。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

case.sentenceEn: Yet as is so often the case , by the time we've reached midlife, we've stopped dreaming about what we want to achieve and feel quite negatively about goal setting.
case.translationZh: 然而，情况往往如此，当我们步入中年时，我们已经不再梦想自己想要实现什么，并且对设定目标感到相当消极。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

case.sentenceEn: Even though a green light signals "go", attention should be paid to traffic on either side in case some driver is being careless or ignoring a red light.
case.translationZh: 虽然绿灯代表“通行”，但仍应注意两侧交通，以防有司机粗心大意或闯红灯。

case.sentenceEn: It analysed cases from a daily poll of US residents.
case.translationZh: 它分析了来自美国居民每日民意调查的案例。

crop.sentenceEn: Food crops could be engineered to produce tardigrade proteins, allowing these organisms to grow more efficiently on spacecraft where levels of radiation are elevated compared with on Earth.
crop.translationZh: 粮食作物可以通过基因工程改造来产生水熊虫蛋白质，使这些生物体能够在辐射水平高于地球的航天器上更高效地生长。
crop.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

crop.sentenceEn: And researchers are looking to the microscopic animals to learn how to prepare humans and crops to handle the rigors of space travel.
crop.translationZh: 研究人员正寄望于这些微型动物，以了解如何让人类和农作物做好准备，应对太空旅行的严酷挑战。
crop.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

crop.sentenceEn: It's also a way to help counter perceptions of local crops as "old or poor people's food" or as inferior "women's crops ", adds Tan.
crop.translationZh: 谭补充道，这也是一种有助于改变人们对本地作物的看法的方式——不再将其视为“老年人或穷人的食物”，或次等的“女性作物”。

crop.sentenceEn: "I try to modernise forgotten crops instead of using old recipes." says Tan, who is also a trained chef.
crop.translationZh: 身为专业厨师的谭说：“我尝试让那些被遗忘的农作物现代化，而不是沿用旧食谱。”

crop.sentenceEn: "But actually there're 7,000 crops we've been farming for thousands of years. We ignore all of those."
crop.translationZh: 但事实上，数千年来我们耕种过的农作物有7000种之多，而我们却忽视了所有这些作物。

crop.sentenceEn: Measuring crops by nutrition instead of yield is at the heart of the forgotten foods enterprise.
crop.translationZh: 以营养而非产量来衡量农作物，是「被遗忘食物」事业的核心所在。

concern.sentenceEn: He has found that personality traits commonly associated with creativity are openness (receptiveness to new thoughts and experiences), self-confidence, and autonomy—which may include "a lack of concern for social norms" and "a preference for being alone".
concern.translationZh: 他发现，通常与创造力相关的人格特质包括开放性（乐于接受新思想和新体验）、自信心和自主性——其中可能包括“不太在意社会规范”和“喜欢独处”。

concern.sentenceEn: There are concerns about how happiness can be measured.
concern.translationZh: 人们对如何衡量幸福感存在担忧。
concern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

concern.sentenceEn: In addition, it bolsters women's sense that government cares about their concerns and inspires young women to become more politically engaged.
concern.translationZh: 此外，这增强了女性对政府关注其关切的认同感，并激励年轻女性更多地参与政治。
concern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

concern.sentenceEn: After spending five consecutive nights in five similar hotels, the business traveler may find it difficult to remember what happened from day to day, or even what towns were visited, and the tourist may get the mistaken impression that all cities are pretty much the same, at least as far as decoration, food and service are concerned .
concern.translationZh: 商务旅客在连住五晚类似的酒店后，可能会难以记起每天发生的事，甚至不记得去过哪些城镇；而游客也可能产生一种错觉，认为所有城市都大同小异，至少就装饰、饮食和服务而言是如此。
concern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

concern.sentenceEn: What concern do monitoring initiatives cause among many staffers?
concern.translationZh: 监控举措引起了许多员工的什么担忧？

concern.sentenceEn: They advanced a new model concerning human information storage and retrieval.
concern.translationZh: 他们提出了一个关于人类信息存储与检索的新模型。

customer.sentenceEn: Personalisation is seen as key to the appeal of this technology, alongside its ability to reliably push so-called "upsells" (meal deals, extras, larger drinks) to customers .
customer.translationZh: 个性化被视为这项技术的吸引力核心，同时它还能可靠地向客户推送所谓的“追加销售”（如套餐、加餐、大杯饮料）。

customer.sentenceEn: Fully automated burger restaurants managed with minimal human oversight — where customers order at screens, pay electronically, and eat food cooked and delivered by robots — are now a possibility.
customer.translationZh: 现在，通过极少的人工监管即可运行的全自动化汉堡餐厅已成为可能——在这里，顾客通过屏幕点餐并进行电子支付，而食物的烹饪与配送均由机器人完成。

customer.sentenceEn: In terms of simplifying or enhancing the customer experience, online restaurant booking has been the easily-won success of the internet age.
customer.translationZh: 在简化或提升客户体验方面，在线餐厅预订已成为互联网时代最容易取得成功的典范。

customer.sentenceEn: Many restaurants are trying to persuade customers to eat more sustainably, moving away from environmentally unfriendly meat towards greener dishes.
customer.translationZh: 许多餐厅正试图说服顾客选择更具可持续性的饮食，减少食用对环境不友好的肉类，转而选择更环保的菜肴。
customer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

customer.sentenceEn: Fondness for human warmth in catering to customers will give hope to employees who are afraid of losing jobs to robots.
customer.translationZh: 在服务客户时对人情味的青睐，将为那些担心被机器人取代的员工带来希望。
他们提高了顾客的环保意识。

cognitive.sentenceEn: The studies also showed that when given a cognitive task, older adults rely more heavily on previous knowledge than younger adults do.
cognitive.translationZh: 研究还表明，在执行认知任务时，老年人比年轻人更依赖先前的知识。
cognitive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

cognitive.sentenceEn: Strong social connections are important for cognitive functioning, motor function and a smoothly running immune system.
cognitive.translationZh: 良好的社会关系对认知功能、运动功能和免疫系统的正常运作都很重要。

cognitive.sentenceEn: These real health benefits include better cognitive functioning and lowered risk of gaining weight.
cognitive.translationZh: 这些切实的健康益处包括改善认知功能以及降低体重增加的风险。
cognitive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

cognitive.sentenceEn: Meanwhile, technology has quashed(使无效), one by one, claims that cognitive tasks require a human brain.
cognitive.translationZh: 与此同时，技术正逐一推翻那些认为认知任务必须依靠人类大脑才能完成的断言。
cognitive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

cognitive.sentenceEn: What did the researchers do in their review in the journal Trends in Cognitive Sciences?
cognitive.translationZh: 研究人员在《认知科学趋势》期刊上的综述中做了什么？

cognitive.sentenceEn: Older adults generally perform cognitive tasks much slower than young adults.
cognitive.translationZh: 老年人执行认知任务的速度通常比年轻人慢得多。

colleague.sentenceEn: This was significant because while previous research had suggested that unsociability might be harmless, Bowker and colleagues' paper showed that it could actually be beneficial.
colleague.translationZh: 这一发现意义重大，因为尽管先前的研究表明不爱社交可能并无害处，但Bowker及其同事的论文却显示，不爱社交实际上可能是有益的。

colleague.sentenceEn: A paper by Bowker and her colleagues was the first to show that a type of social withdrawal could have a positive effect—they found that creativity was linked specifically to unsociability.
colleague.translationZh: Bowker及其同事的一篇论文首次表明，某种类型的社交退缩可能产生积极影响——他们发现创造力与不合群特质存在特定关联。

colleague.sentenceEn: The debate centers around a system developed by Monteiro and colleagues that classifies foods by their degree of industrial processing, ranging from unprocessed to ultra-processed.
colleague.translationZh: 这场争论围绕着由Monteiro及其同事开发的一个系统展开，该系统根据食品的工业加工程度对其进行分类，范围从非加工食品到超加工食品。
colleague.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

colleague.sentenceEn: If you run to the office kitchen to get some relief with colleagues after a frustrating meeting, you're likely experiencing meeting recovery syndrome.
colleague.translationZh: 如果一场令人沮丧的会议后，你跑到办公室厨房和同事们一起放松一下，那么你很可能正在经历会议恢复综合征。

colleague.sentenceEn: How does the system developed by Monteiro and colleagues classify foods?
colleague.translationZh: Monteiro及其同事开发的系统如何对食物进行分类？

colleague.sentenceEn: Teachers are simply too busy to visit classes of their colleagues .
colleague.translationZh: 老师们实在太忙了，无暇去听同事的课。

contribute.sentenceEn: Boston College professor Thomas O'Connor thinks a contributing factor is Boston's history as a city where each new group of immigrants was treated with suspicion and exclusion.
contribute.translationZh: 波士顿学院教授托马斯·奥康纳认为，一个促成因素是波士顿的历史——这座城市中每一波新移民都曾遭受怀疑与排斥。
contribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

contribute.sentenceEn: Long working hours contribute to the feeling of "time poverty", which has an adverse effect on psychological well-being.
contribute.translationZh: 长时间工作导致了"时间贫困"感，这对心理健康产生了不利影响。
contribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

contribute.sentenceEn: Pesticide use on college campuses also contributes to our global climate crisis.
contribute.translationZh: 大学校园使用农药也加剧了全球气候危机。
contribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

contribute.sentenceEn: All of agriculture accounted for a total of 9 percent, but all of animal agriculture contributes less than half of this amount, representing 3.9 percent of the total greenhouse emission in the U.S.
contribute.translationZh: 农业整体占总量的9%，而畜牧业仅占其中不到一半，相当于美国温室气体总排放量的3.9%。

contribute.sentenceEn: What does the passage say long working hours contribute to?
contribute.translationZh: 这篇文章认为长时间工作会导致什么问题？

contribute.sentenceEn: They have contributed considerably to its popularity.
contribute.translationZh: 他们为其普及做出了相当大的贡献。

current.sentenceEn: New moms connect at baby story-times; elderly people, often facing difficult life transitions, attend events and find that they make new friends; teenagers meet up in libraries' teen spaces after school; and readers discuss current events in the periodicals room.
current.translationZh: 新手妈妈们通过婴儿故事会相互结识；老年人往往面临艰难的人生转折，他们参加活动并发现自己交到了新朋友；青少年放学后在图书馆的青少年专区相聚；读者们则在期刊阅览室讨论时事。

current.sentenceEn: My current research is mainly looking at factors like stress and how it affects our immune system.
current.translationZh: 我目前的研究主要关注压力等因素及其对我们免疫系统的影响。
current.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

current.sentenceEn: So the current projects that I'm quite excited about are looking at older people and factors that are important to them.
current.translationZh: 所以目前我相当兴奋的项目是关注老年人以及对他们而言重要的各种因素。
current.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

current.sentenceEn: Allowing participants to enter a simulated environment provides them with the opportunity to experience alternative realities which can prompt them to rethink their current beliefs.
current.translationZh: 让参与者进入模拟环境，能为他们提供体验另类现实的机会，这可能促使他们重新思考自己当前的信念。
current.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

current.sentenceEn: What does the man believe is the problem with the current American system of higher education?
current.translationZh: 这位男士认为当前美国高等教育体系存在什么问题？

current.sentenceEn: Their memory pushed them toward a current belief.
current.translationZh: 他们的记忆促使他们形成了当前的信念。

cultural.sentenceEn: But in an increasingly digital world, we see the role of libraries as community and cultural centers at times undervalued.
cultural.translationZh: 但在日益数字化的世界中，我们发现图书馆作为社区和文化中心的作用有时被低估了。

cultural.sentenceEn: Some of the specific ways in which libraries add value to our communities and serve as cultural centers for our patrons are community builders, centers for the arts, and champions of youth.
cultural.translationZh: 图书馆为社区创造价值并作为读者文化中心的具体方式包括：社区建设者、艺术中心和青少年倡导者。

cultural.sentenceEn: Strengthening neighborhoods and championing the cultural lives of communities are big responsibilities.
cultural.translationZh: 强化社区建设和倡导社区文化生活是重大责任。

cultural.sentenceEn: But it is precisely those shrinking budgets and the assault of technologically mediated life that make public libraries' cultural and community offerings more important than ever.
cultural.translationZh: 但正是这些日益缩减的预算和科技媒介生活的冲击，使得公共图书馆的文化及社区服务比以往任何时候都更加重要。

cultural.sentenceEn: Public libraries organize cultural events, often allowing people of different income levels to attend free of charge.
cultural.translationZh: 公共图书馆组织文化活动，通常允许不同收入水平的人免费参加。

cultural.sentenceEn: Take pride in its history and adhere to its cultural tradition.
cultural.translationZh: 以其历史为荣，坚守其文化传统。

conflict.sentenceEn: Conflicts between stray dogs and humans are a problem.
conflict.translationZh: 流浪狗与人类之间的冲突是一个问题。
conflict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

conflict.sentenceEn: This could have implications in reducing conflict between stray dogs and humans.
conflict.translationZh: 这可能有助于减少流浪狗与人类之间的冲突。
conflict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

conflict.sentenceEn: Treating stray dogs with sensitivity and respect, and giving them space, the researchers assert, can reduce much conflict .
conflict.translationZh: 研究人员断言，以敏感和尊重的态度对待流浪狗，并给予它们空间，可以大幅减少冲突。
conflict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

conflict.sentenceEn: Students — and adults for that matter — simply cannot understand the conflicts we have today without understanding what caused them in the first place.
conflict.translationZh: 学生们——其实对于成年人来说也是如此——如果不了解冲突产生的根源，就根本无法理解我们当今面临的这些冲突。
conflict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

conflict.sentenceEn: What do the researchers suggest we do to reduce conflicts between stray dogs and humans?
conflict.translationZh: 研究人员建议我们如何做才能减少流浪狗与人类之间的冲突？

conflict.sentenceEn: They persuaded them to put their conflict aside.
conflict.translationZh: 他们说服他们放下分歧。

consequence.sentenceEn: And if taken to an extreme, it also could have harmful nutritional consequences .
consequence.translationZh: 而且如果走向极端，还可能产生有害的营养后果。

consequence.sentenceEn: Simulators are most often utilized within industries such as nuclear power, aviation and surgery where failure results in disastrous consequences .
consequence.translationZh: 模拟器最常用于核电、航空和外科手术等行业，在这些领域中，失误可能导致灾难性后果。
consequence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

consequence.sentenceEn: This is because the number of women involved in legislative decisions has significant consequences for all the policies that governments enact.
consequence.translationZh: 这是因为参与立法决策的女性人数对政府制定的所有政策都有重大影响。
consequence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

consequence.sentenceEn: Study after study shows that inequity has had appalling consequences .
consequence.translationZh: 一项又一项研究表明，不平等已经造成了骇人听闻的后果。
consequence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

consequence.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say is a positive consequence of the age shift in childbearing?
consequence.translationZh: 演讲者认为生育年龄变化的积极后果是什么？

consequence.sentenceEn: He was astonished by its consequences .

creative.sentenceEn: Up until now, unless we work in the creative industry, we've found the idea of using "play" a bit childish.
creative.translationZh: 到目前为止，除非我们从事创意行业，否则总觉得把“玩乐”这个概念用在工作上有点幼稚。
creative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

creative.sentenceEn: But creative unsociability is a far cry from this.
creative.translationZh: 但创造性的不合群与此截然不同。

creative.sentenceEn: Solitude allows for the reflection and observation necessary for that creative process.
creative.translationZh: 独处为创作过程提供了必要的反思与观察空间。

creative.sentenceEn: In fact, Feist's research on both artists and scientists shows that one of the most prominent features of creative folks is their lesser interest in socialising.
creative.translationZh: 事实上，费斯特对艺术家和科学家的研究表明，富有创造力的人的一个最显著特征是他们对社交的兴趣较低。

creative.sentenceEn: Recent research shows for the first time that there is a specific link between being creative and being unsociable.
creative.translationZh: 最新研究首次表明，创造力与不合群之间存在特定联系。

creative.sentenceEn: It is a creative person's response to limitation.
creative.translationZh: 这是创意人士对局限的回应。

crisis.sentenceEn: But what if America's attendance crisis is about much more than students missing class?
crisis.translationZh: 但如果美国的出勤率危机远不止学生缺课这么简单呢？
crisis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

crisis.sentenceEn: Absence from school, and especially unexcused absence, matters mainly as a signal of many crises children and their families may be facing.
crisis.translationZh: 缺课，尤其是无故缺课，之所以重要，主要是因为它反映了儿童及其家庭可能面临的诸多危机。
crisis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

crisis.sentenceEn: In 2015, the U.S. secretary of education responded to this crisis , urging communities to support every student to attend every day and be successful in school.
crisis.translationZh: 2015年，美国教育部长针对这一危机作出回应，呼吁各社区支持每一位学生每天到校上课并在学业上取得成功。
crisis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

crisis.sentenceEn: Pesticide use on college campuses also contributes to our global climate crisis .
crisis.translationZh: 大学校园使用农药也加剧了全球气候危机。
crisis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

crisis.sentenceEn: Improved transport networks connecting the city to distant outlying areas will also help solve the housing crisis .
crisis.translationZh: 改善连接城市与偏远外围地区的交通网络也将有助于解决住房危机。

crisis.sentenceEn: They give a clear signal to children and their families of the crises they are likely to face in the future.
crisis.translationZh: 它们向儿童及其家庭清晰地预示了他们未来可能面临的危机。

complex.sentenceEn: The results suggest that dogs can understand complex gestures by simply watching humans.
complex.translationZh: 研究结果表明，狗只需观察人类就能理解复杂的手势。
complex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

complex.sentenceEn: In this increasingly diverse society we live in, solidarity takes on a complex and multifaceted character as it forms bonds of interdependence among unique individuals living in a fast-changing environment and working within a complex division of labor.
complex.translationZh: 在我们生活的这个日益多元化的社会中，团结呈现出一种复杂且多维的特征，它在快速变化的环境中以及复杂的社会分工背景下，将独特的个体联系在一起，形成相互依存的纽带。
complex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

complex.sentenceEn: One of the things I have come to understand, however, is that our identity is much more complex than we recognise at first glance.
complex.translationZh: 然而，我逐渐明白的一件事是，我们的身份远比乍看之下要复杂得多。
complex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

complex.sentenceEn: The tiny robot can bend, twist, crawl, walk, turn, and even jump without the use of complex hardware or special power.
complex.translationZh: 这个微型机器人无需复杂硬件或特殊动力，就能弯曲、扭转、爬行、行走、转向甚至跳跃。
complex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

complex.sentenceEn: There is a way to solve complex social and economic problems without abandoning social responsibility.
complex.translationZh: 我们完全可以在不放弃社会责任的前提下，解决复杂的社会和经济问题。

complex.sentenceEn: It changes its shape by complex hardware.
complex.translationZh: 它通过复杂的硬件改变形状。

concept.sentenceEn: They can generalize such abstract concepts as causal relationships and social roles from just a few examples.
concept.translationZh: 他们仅从少数几个例子中就能归纳出因果关系和社会角色等抽象概念。
concept.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

concept.sentenceEn: As a society, we idolize the concept of "losing friends on the road to success".
concept.translationZh: 作为一个社会整体，我们盲目崇拜那种“在通往成功的道路上注定会失去朋友”的观念。
concept.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

concept.sentenceEn: Our self-concept and identity are mental concepts that influence our behavior.
concept.translationZh: 我们的自我概念和身份认同是影响我们行为的心理概念。

concept.sentenceEn: Many laymen presume that there is a single standard way of speaking in each country, with one single standard accent, and that this perceived standard is inherently the best form of speech, but linguists(语言学家) often point out that the concept of a standard accent is better understood as an ideal rather than a reality.
concept.translationZh: 许多门外汉认为每个国家都有一种标准的说话方式和一种标准的口音，并觉得这种公认的标准形式在本质上就是语言的最佳形态。但语言学家经常指出，标准口音的概念与其说是一种现实，不如说是一个理想化的标准。
concept.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

concept.sentenceEn: Consistent constraints help you improve at connecting unrelated ideas and concepts .
concept.translationZh: 始终如一的限制有助于你提高将不相关的想法和概念联系起来的能力。
concept.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

concept.sentenceEn: They have advanced the concept of self-awareness to a higher level.
concept.translationZh: 他们将自我意识的概念提升到了一个更高的境界。

conduct.sentenceEn: Annual summer reading programs also have a positive impact on student performance and, according to a 2010 study conducted by Dominican University's Graduate School of Library and Information Science, students' reading skills get a boost from these popular nationwide events.
conduct.translationZh: 年度暑期阅读计划对学生表现也有积极影响。根据多米尼加大学图书馆与信息科学研究生院2010年的一项研究，这些在全国范围内广受欢迎的活动有助于提高学生的阅读能力。

conduct.sentenceEn: When Yoon conducted the same survey 15 years later, only 10% of respondents reported a love of cooking, 45% said they hated it and 45% had mixed feelings.
conduct.translationZh: 15年后，当尹（Yoon）再次进行同样的调查时，只有10%的受访者表示热爱烹饪，45%的人表示讨厌烹饪，另有45%的人则表示心情复杂。
conduct.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

conduct.sentenceEn: In the early 2000s, researcher Eddie Yoon conducted a survey to ascertain Americans' attitudes to cooking.
conduct.translationZh: 21 世纪初，研究员艾迪·尹（Eddie Yoon）开展了一项调查，旨在查明美国人对烹饪的态度。
conduct.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

conduct.sentenceEn: The problem lies in the fact that NASA conducted their tests in sealed containers that do not simulate the conditions in most people's homes or offices.
conduct.translationZh: 问题在于，NASA的测试是在密封容器中进行的，这些容器并不能模拟大多数人家庭或办公室的实际环境。
conduct.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

conduct.sentenceEn: Research conducted on artists and scientists indicates that creative people are less interested in hanging out with others.
conduct.translationZh: 针对艺术家和科学家的研究表明，富有创造力的人不太喜欢与他人交往。

conduct.sentenceEn: Supervisors conduct effective communication with frontline workers.
conduct.translationZh: 主管与一线员工进行有效沟通。

campaign.sentenceEn: Therefore, in order to avoid any conflict, we would need to ensure that both marketing campaigns do not overlap geographically.
campaign.translationZh: 因此，为避免任何冲突，我们需要确保这两项营销活动在地理上不重叠。

campaign.sentenceEn: Democratic politicians have tended to campaign on helping people left behind by economic growth.
campaign.translationZh: 民主党政治人物在竞选时，往往聚焦于帮助那些在经济增长中被落下的人群。
campaign.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

campaign.sentenceEn: Shortly thereafter, public initiatives and political campaigns led to strict regulations and new laws, including the Clean Air Act (1956).
campaign.translationZh: 此后不久，公众倡议和政治运动促成了严格的法规和新法律的出台，其中包括1956年的《清洁空气法案》。

campaign.sentenceEn: The campaign led to an impressive increase in product sales of more than 10%.
campaign.translationZh: 该活动使产品销量显著增长了10%以上。

campaign.sentenceEn: What can other companies learn from the example of the carrot promotion campaign ?
campaign.translationZh: 其他公司能从胡萝卜推广活动的例子中学到什么？

consumption.translationZh: 但这些地区的人均肉类消费量仍落后于发达国家。

consumption.translationZh: 一些活动人士甚至呼吁对肉类征税以减少其消费。

consumption.sentenceEn: While the mechanisms behind these associations are not fully understood, Monteiro argues that the existing evidence is sufficient to justify discouraging consumption of ultra-processed foods in dietary recommendations and government policies.
consumption.translationZh: 虽然这些关联背后的机制尚未完全明确，但蒙泰罗认为现有证据已足以支持在膳食建议和政府政策中劝阻超加工食品消费。
consumption.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

consumption.sentenceEn: Consumption of meat per person in developing countries is much less than that in countries like the U.S.
consumption.translationZh: 发展中国家的人均肉类消费量远低于美国等国家。

consumption.sentenceEn: Consumption stimulates the desire for higher wages.
consumption.translationZh: 消费刺激了对更高工资的渴望。

credit.translationZh: 值得肯定的是，粮农组织立即承认了自己的错误。

credit.translationZh: 在加利福尼亚州的 Kang Nam Tofu House 餐厅进行了为期八个月的测试后，Bear Robotics 公司将销售额增长 28% 归功于 Penny 机器人。

credit.sentenceEn: As you might imagine from all of this, few give credit to this side of the story.
credit.translationZh: 可想而知，很少有人会认可故事的这一面。

credit.sentenceEn: Instead of experiencing a benefaction(善行) as a good turn, people sometimes regard it as a mere payment of what they are owed, for which no one deserves any moral credit .
credit.translationZh: 人们有时不把善行视为一种善举，而是将其看作对方仅仅在偿还所欠自己的东西，因此认为这种行为不值得任何道德上的赞扬。

credit.sentenceEn: Why does the speaker give credit to the world's agricultural scientists?
credit.translationZh: 为什么演讲者要赞扬全球农业科学家？

contain.sentenceEn: But cows, sheep and other ruminant(反刍的) animals can break cellulose down and release the solar energy contained in this vast resource.
contain.translationZh: 但牛、羊和其他反刍动物能够分解纤维素，并释放这一巨大资源中蕴含的太阳能。

contain.sentenceEn: As one example, the energy in plants that livestock consume is most often contained in cellulose(纤维素), which is indigestible for humans and many other mammals.
contain.translationZh: 例如，牲畜食用的植物能量通常存在于纤维素中，而纤维素对于人类和许多其他哺乳动物来说是无法消化的。

contain.sentenceEn: My "challenge" was to click on each cell in the grid that contained a traffic sign.
contain.translationZh: 我的“任务”是点击网格中所有包含交通标志的单元格。
contain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

contain.sentenceEn: It is speculated to have been invented by the imagination of the said anonymous author at the Athens Weekly Banner in the aforementioned 1890 front page article titled "Deeded to Itself", which by the way contained several elements that are much more easily proved to be false.
contain.translationZh: 据推测，这是那位匿名作者在《雅典每周旗帜报》1890年那篇标题为《赠予自身》的头版文章中凭空捏造的，顺便说一句，该文章包含若干内容现已被轻易证实为虚假。

contain.sentenceEn: What do researchers find about people reading scientific articles containing jargon terms?
contain.translationZh: 研究人员发现人们阅读含有专业术语的科学文章时有什么发现？

contain.sentenceEn: It contains an assortment of nutrients.

code.translationZh: 科学家们希望，破解动植物的遗传密码能够帮助发现传染病的新疗法、延缓衰老、改良农业作物并创造新的生物材料。

code.translationZh: 这项针对全球60种不同文化的大规模研究发现，所有社群都遵循七种基本道德准则。

connection.sentenceEn: These examples are just a few of the many amazing things that public libraries around the United States (and the world) are doing to build and maintain strong community connections .

connection.sentenceEn: These are inspiring and hopefully will encourage librarians interested in community services and cultural outreach to make connections with each other, share ideas, and build partnerships.
connection.translationZh: 这些内容令人鼓舞，希望能激励那些对社区服务和文化推广感兴趣的图书馆员们相互建立联系、分享想法并建立合作伙伴关系。

connection.translationZh: 在图书馆里，促进社区联结的活动一直在发生。

candidate.sentenceEn: On the contrary, decades of research shows that female candidates raise as much money and win as often as male politicians with similar credentials.

candidate.sentenceEn: Algorithms could soon—if they don't already—have a better idea about which show you'd like to watch next and which job candidate you should hire than you do.

cell.sentenceEn: But as water disappears, the proteins self-assemble into long fibers that fill the cell's interior.

cell.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

cell.sentenceEn: It does damage to cells in some of the same ways that freezing, vacuum and radiation do.

cell.sentenceEn: The fibers support the cell's membranes(细胞膜) and proteins, preventing them from breaking or unfolding.

cell.sentenceEn: My "challenge" was to click on each cell in the grid that contained a traffic sign.

chemical.sentenceEn: The use of chemicals to get rid of insects or unwanted plant life can increase indirect emissions as they can include petroleum-based ingredients.
chemical.translationZh: 使用化学物质清除昆虫或多余植物可能会增加间接排放，因为这些化学物质可能含有石油基成分。

chemical.sentenceEn: Instead of using toxic chemicals , students working with HFC help out with weeding the campus grounds.
chemical.translationZh: 学生们没有使用有毒化学品，而是通过参与HFC项目帮助清理校园场地的杂草。
chemical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

chemical.sentenceEn: The system defines ultra-processed foods as those made using sequences of processes that extract substances from foods and alter them with chemicals in order to formulate the final product.
chemical.translationZh: 该系统将超加工食品定义为：通过一系列加工过程从食物中提取物质，并使用化学物质对其进行改造以形成最终产品的食品。
chemical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

chemical.sentenceEn: Since NASA published a paper in 1989 claiming that houseplants can soak up pollution and toxic chemicals , businesses and homeowners have increasingly invested in greenery to help clean their air.
chemical.translationZh: 自1989年美国国家航空航天局（NASA）发表论文称室内植物能够吸收污染物和有毒化学物质以来，企业和房主们越来越多地投资于绿植来帮助净化空气。
chemical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

chemical.sentenceEn: NASA found that certain plants could remove chemicals from the air, and even today, garden centers recommend the plants for air cleaning properties.
chemical.translationZh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）发现某些植物能够清除空气中的化学物质，即便在今天，园艺中心仍推荐这些植物用于空气净化。
chemical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

chemical.sentenceEn: Houseplants disperse chemical compounds more quickly with people moving around.
chemical.translationZh: 室内植物在有人活动的情况下会更快地释放化合物。

creativity.sentenceEn: Programs like ImaginOn in Charlotte, North Carolina, provide exciting models that take community partnership, creativity , and creation to a new level.
creativity.translationZh: 北卡罗来纳州夏洛特市的ImaginOn等项目提供了令人振奋的模式，将社区合作、创造力和创新提升到了新高度。

creativity.sentenceEn: "Evidence suggests that older adults show preserved, and at times enhanced, creativity as a function of enriched memories," the researchers write.
creativity.translationZh: 研究人员写道：“有证据表明，老年人的创造力会因丰富的记忆而保持甚至有时会增强。”
creativity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

creativity.sentenceEn: While this wealth of prior knowledge can make memory retrieval challenging, the researchers say it has its upsides—this life experience can aid with creativity and decision-making.
creativity.translationZh: 虽然丰富的先前知识会使记忆提取变得困难，但研究人员表示这也有其优势——这些生活经验有助于提升创造力和决策能力。
creativity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

creativity.sentenceEn: He has found that personality traits commonly associated with creativity are openness (receptiveness to new thoughts and experiences), self-confidence, and autonomy—which may include "a lack of concern for social norms" and "a preference for being alone".
creativity.translationZh: 他发现，通常与创造力相关的人格特质包括开放性（乐于接受新思想和新体验）、自信心和自主性——其中可能包括“不太在意社会规范”和“喜欢独处”。

creativity.sentenceEn: What did Marissa Mayer once write concerning creativity ?
creativity.translationZh: 玛丽莎·梅耶尔曾就创造力写过什么内容？

creativity.sentenceEn: They looked into the relationship between one's prior knowledge and creativity .
creativity.translationZh: 他们研究了一个人的先验知识与创造力之间的关系。

charge.sentenceEn: M: I'm sorry, but I'm not in charge of scheduling all logistics.
charge.translationZh: 男士：抱歉，我不负责所有物流的安排。
charge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

charge.sentenceEn: Despite the rising costs of concert and theater tickets, public library events (including concerts, author visits, and gallery displays) are often offered free of charge , enabling people of any income level to attend.
charge.translationZh: 尽管音乐会和戏剧门票价格不断上涨，但公共图书馆活动（包括音乐会、作家见面会和画廊展览）往往免费提供，使各收入水平的人都能参与。

charge.sentenceEn: It could charge a profitable markup by offering just a bit more technical equipment and professional service than competitors.
charge.translationZh: 通过仅提供比竞争对手稍多一些的技术设备和专业服务，它就能收取可观的加价。
charge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第15段，第4句

charge.sentenceEn: In addition to their courses, students are charged with running the 155-acre ranch and overseeing the functioning of the college.
charge.translationZh: 除课程学习外，学生们还负责管理这座155英亩的牧场，并监督学院的日常运作。

charge.sentenceEn: Public libraries organize cultural events, often allowing people of different income levels to attend free of charge .
charge.translationZh: 公共图书馆组织文化活动，通常允许不同收入水平的人免费参加。

charge.sentenceEn: The tuition they charge is not justified by the quality of their service.
charge.translationZh: 他们收取的学费与其提供的服务质量并不相称。

carbon.sentenceEn: Pesticide use also decreases the life in soil, hampering the ability of soils to absorb carbon or retain water and thus reducing campuses' ability to recover quickly from climate-related extreme weather events like droughts and floods.
carbon.translationZh: 农药的使用还会减少土壤中的生物活性，削弱土壤吸收碳和保持水分的能力，从而降低校园从干旱和洪水等气候相关极端天气事件中快速恢复的能力。
carbon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

carbon.sentenceEn: However, when they looked at transportation's carbon footprint, they ignored impacts on the climate from manufacturing vehicle materials and parts, assembling vehicles and maintaining roads, bridges and airports.
carbon.translationZh: 然而，在考察交通运输的碳足迹时，他们忽略了制造车辆材料和零部件、组装车辆以及维护道路、桥梁和机场对气候的影响。

carbon.sentenceEn: Leon Clarke, who helped author reports for the UN's Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, isn't an uncritical supporter of nuclear energy, but says it's a valuable option to have if we're serious about reaching carbon neutrality.
carbon.translationZh: 莱昂·克拉克曾参与撰写联合国政府间气候变化专门委员会的报告，他并非核能的无条件支持者，但他表示，如果我们真的想实现碳中和，核能是一个有价值的选择。
carbon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

carbon.sentenceEn: Today "nutrition is becoming a time bomb", says Azam-Ali, as growing carbon dioxide levels strip crops of their minerals.
carbon.translationZh: 阿扎姆-阿里表示，随着不断上升的二氧化碳水平剥夺了农作物中的矿物质，如今“营养正成为一颗定时炸弹”。

carbon.sentenceEn: It's one of multiple chambers where scientists are studying the impact of higher temperatures and carbon dioxide levels on the nutritional make-up of alternative crops.
carbon.translationZh: 这是多个试验舱之一，科学家们正在这里研究高温和二氧化碳浓度升高对替代作物营养成分的影响。

certainly.sentenceEn: Still, given projected population growth in the developing world, there will certainly be an opportunity for countries such as the United States to bring their sustainable livestock rearing practices to the table.
certainly.translationZh: 尽管如此，考虑到发展中世界的预计人口增长，美国等国家肯定有机会将其可持续畜牧业养殖实践引入讨论。

certainly.sentenceEn: This is certainly an example of how scientific findings can be misleading or misinterpreted over time.
certainly.translationZh: 这无疑是一个关于科学发现在时间推移中可能被误导或误解的例子。
certainly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

certainly.sentenceEn: "Climate change is going to mean almost certainly tastes are going to be forced to change," says Tim Lang, professor of food policy at City, University of London.
certainly.translationZh: 伦敦城市大学食品政策教授蒂姆·朗表示：“气候变化几乎肯定意味着人们将被迫改变饮食习惯。”

certainly.sentenceEn: And I certainly wouldn't be here without their support.

certainly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

certainly.sentenceEn: I would certainly say my parents have been a key factor.
certainly.translationZh: 我当然会说，我的父母一直是关键因素。

certainly.sentenceEn: Big clouds of ash from volcanic eruptions or fires can do the trick, but it doesn't happen often, and the stars would certainly have to align for two such rare instances to occur at once.

commercial.sentenceEn: It is designed for domestic use, but a commercial version is planned that opens up the possibility of restaurant kitchens automating even highly technically challenging tasks.
commercial.translationZh: 该产品专为家庭使用而设计，但其计划推出的商业版本将使餐厅厨房实现极具技术挑战的任务自动化成为可能。

commercial.sentenceEn: It's crept up on us in the 60 years since advertisers started to target the young and found that they could recruit them to a commercial assault on their parents.
commercial.translationZh: 自广告商开始将年轻人作为目标群体，并发现可以利用他们向父母发起商业攻势以来，这一现象在60年间悄然蔓延。
commercial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

commercial.sentenceEn: By the 1850s, commercial trapping of passenger pigeons was proceeding at an unprecedented pace.
commercial.translationZh: 到19世纪50年代，旅鸽的商业捕捉正以前所未有的速度进行。
commercial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

commercial.sentenceEn: Commercial content is there for a reason: to elicit purchasing behavior.
commercial.translationZh: 商业内容的存在是有原因的：为了诱发购买行为。

completely.sentenceEn: I am not saying this would mean beauty is completely objective, just that there could possibly be general objective principles at work, i.e., beauty is not simply in the eye of the beholder.

concerned.sentenceEn: Foxes are moderately concerned with their own goals and about their relationships with other people.
concerned.translationZh: 狐狸型的人对自己的目标和与他人的关系都抱有适度的关注。

concerned.sentenceEn: The space agency was primarily concerned about keeping the air fresh for astronauts cut off in biospheres or space stations and helping to combat "sick building syndrome", which had become a problem due to the super insulated and energy efficient offices of the late 1970s.
concerned.translationZh: 航天局最初主要关注的是为与世隔绝的生物圈或空间站中的宇航员保持空气清新，以及帮助解决20世纪70年代末因超隔热、节能办公室而出现的"病态建筑综合症"问题。
concerned.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

concerned.sentenceEn: But conservationists are most concerned about those varieties that are threatened due to habitat loss and fragmentation, which makes it impossible for them to migrate.

critical.sentenceEn: "We are at a critical crossroads as a species where we must rapidly reform our mindsets and behaviour to act in less selfish ways," he said.

currently.sentenceEn: The world population is currently projected to reach 9.8 billion by 2050.

currently.sentenceEn: The restaurant industry is currently suffering a severe shortage of skilled chefs — a deficit of 11,000, according to the skills agency People 1st.

citizen.sentenceEn: To demand that governments set the 'happiness' of citizens as their highest priority is to demand that they view citizens as ends in themselves.

citizen.sentenceEn: In a recently published article, philosopher Julian Baggini suggests we should focus on 'real wealth' for citizens , which does not depend on GDP growth.

citizen.sentenceEn: Of course, governments cannot impose life satisfaction on citizens .

citizen.sentenceEn: As long as the economy is their priority, governments need go no further than ensuring citizens' continued productivity.

citizen.sentenceEn: Tiny colleges focus on educating students to become well-rounded citizens instead of seeking their own expansion.

campus.sentenceEn: In her second year, Charlene Duong learned of the use of poisonous, synthetic pesticides on her college campus .

campus.sentenceEn: Instead of using toxic chemicals, students working with HFC help out with weeding the campus grounds.

campus.sentenceEn: Pesticide use on college campuses also contributes to our global climate crisis.

campus.sentenceEn: Along with a couple of classmates, Charlene did a quick web search and discovered a small but growing movement led by the organization, Herbicide-Free Campus (HFC), to rid college campuses of artificial herbicides(灭草剂).

campus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

campus.sentenceEn: "This work reminds me to be in the present moment as I play my role in reducing herbicide use and keeping my campus safe and healthy," says Charlene.
campus.translationZh: 夏琳说：“这项工作提醒我，在为减少除草剂使用、保障校园安全健康贡献力量时，要活在当下。”
campus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

campus.translationZh: 那里矗立着一片广阔的大学校园。

conventional.sentenceEn: Invariably, over the next 10 years, jobs will go in conventional bricks-built restaurants, not least because automation will boost their rapidly growing rival: delivery.
conventional.translationZh: 在未来的十年里，传统实体餐厅的岗位必将逐步缩减，这在很大程度上是因为自动化将助力其飞速成长的竞争对手：外卖行业。

conventional.sentenceEn: When people face scarcity, they give themselves the freedom to use resources in less conventional ways because they have to.
conventional.translationZh: 当人们面临资源匮乏时，他们不得不给自己以更大的自由度，以非常规方式使用资源。
conventional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

conventional.sentenceEn: Two papers published today in the American Journal of Clinical Nutrition outline the case for and against using the concept of ultra-processed foods to help inform dietary guidelines beyond conventional food classification systems.
conventional.translationZh: 今日发表在《美国临床营养学杂志》上的两篇论文，探讨了在传统食品分类系统之外，是否应使用超加工食品概念为膳食指南提供信息的支持与反对观点。
conventional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

conventional.sentenceEn: The conventional wisdom held that productivity growth was the only route to higher wages.
conventional.translationZh: 传统观点认为，生产率增长是提高工资的唯一途径。
conventional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

conventional.sentenceEn: What is the basis for higher wages according to the conventional wisdom?
conventional.translationZh: 根据传统观点，提高工资的基础是什么？

conventional.sentenceEn: Its industrial south is used to running factories on conventional energy supplies.
conventional.translationZh: 其南部工业区习惯使用传统能源供电的工厂运营模式。

capacity.sentenceEn: Libraries serve in these capacities and are more than just about information.
capacity.translationZh: 图书馆不仅承担着这些功能，其意义也远不止于信息本身。

capacity.sentenceEn: The practice is based on an insight first described in ancient Buddhist texts that human beings have the capacity to observe experience without being caught up in it.
capacity.translationZh: 这一实践基于古代佛教文献中首次描述的一种洞见，即人类有能力在观察体验的同时而不陷入其中。
capacity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

capacity.sentenceEn: Nuclear energy, being far cleaner than oil, gas and coal, is a natural option, especially where hydroelectric capacity is limited.
capacity.translationZh: 核能比石油、天然气和煤炭清洁得多，是一种自然的选择，尤其是在水力发电能力有限的地区。
capacity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

capacity.sentenceEn: But the researchers' calculation showed it would take 10 to 1,000 plants per square meter of floor space to compete with the air cleaning capacity of a building's air handling system or even just a couple of open windows in a house.
capacity.translationZh: 但研究人员的计算表明，要与建筑物空气处理系统甚至只是家中几扇打开的窗户的空气净化能力相媲美，每平方米地面空间需要10到1000株植物。
capacity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

capacity.sentenceEn: Aristotle argued that the capacity for making practical judgments depends on regularly making them—on habit and practice.
capacity.translationZh: 亚里士多德认为，做出实际判断的能力取决于不断地进行判断——依赖于习惯和实践。
capacity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

capacity.sentenceEn: Its grid infrastructure's capacity has fallen behind its development of green energy.
capacity.translationZh: 其电网基础设施的容量已落后于绿色能源的发展。

central.sentenceEn: I imagine someone from your office called our central office and I'm the engineer designated to your case.
central.translationZh: 我想应该是您办公室有人联系了我们的总部，而我是负责您这个案子的工程师。
central.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

central.sentenceEn: The post-work theorists believe that work should not hold a central position in our lives or take up so much of our time.
central.translationZh: 后工作理论家认为，工作不应在我们的生活中占据中心位置，也不应占用我们如此多的时间。
central.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

central.sentenceEn: Bags with no destination code or identification tag are shipped to a central warehouse, and undergo a comprehensive baggage tracing process over the next 90 days.
central.translationZh: 没有目的地代码或识别标签的行李将被运往中心仓库，并在接下来的 90 天内接受全面的行李追踪程序。
central.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

central.sentenceEn: You may feel as if you are an independent individual, acting autonomously in the world; that you have an unchanging inner self that persists throughout your lifetime, acting as a central anchor-point with the world changing around you.
central.translationZh: 你可能会觉得自己是一个独立的个体，在世界上自主行动；你拥有一个终生不变的内在自我，在周围世界不断变化的同时，作为一个核心锚点存在。
central.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

central.sentenceEn: Marconi was central to our present-day understanding of communication.
central.translationZh: 马可尼是我们现代通信理解的核心人物。

central.sentenceEn: It has played a central role in attracting international applicants.
central.translationZh: 这种教育模式在吸引国际申请者方面一直发挥着核心作用。

characteristic.sentenceEn: Considering your decision through these different characteristics will enable you to see that you have more choices.
characteristic.translationZh: 从这些不同的维度来审视你的决策，将使你意识到自己其实拥有更多选择。

characteristic.sentenceEn: To overcome this kind of internal obstacle, recall your other positive traits and personality characteristics .
characteristic.translationZh: 要克服这类内在障碍，请回想一下你其他的积极特质和人格特征。

characteristic.sentenceEn: Not only are moms making up less of the population, but their characteristics are changing too, and in a way that might be linked to their proportional decline.
characteristic.translationZh: 母亲在人口中的占比不仅在下降，她们的特征也在发生变化，而这种变化可能与其占比下降有关。
characteristic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

characteristic.sentenceEn: In addition, effective dialogue generally has another important characteristic : symmetry.
characteristic.translationZh: 此外，有效的对话通常还有另一个重要特征：对称性。
characteristic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

characteristic.sentenceEn: What is characteristic of people with drawing talent?
characteristic.translationZh: 有绘画天赋的人有什么特点？

characteristic.sentenceEn: It embraces the characteristics of different individuals.
characteristic.translationZh: 它包容不同个体的特点。

client.sentenceEn: Take my client Ryan, a leader at a technology company.
client.translationZh: 以我的客户瑞安为例，他是一家科技公司的领导者。

client.sentenceEn: W: My client has a couple of other prospective marketing deals from companies in the Middle East.
client.translationZh: 女：我的客户还有几个来自中东公司的潜在营销合作机会。
client.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

client.sentenceEn: Are you sure you want to make a sponsorship deal for your clients , or not?
client.translationZh: 您确定要为您的客户达成赞助协议吗？
client.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

client.sentenceEn: But as I'm sure you understand, we hold our clients' best interests to be of the utmost concern.
client.translationZh: 但我相信您能理解，我们始终将客户的最大利益放在首位。
client.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

client.sentenceEn: Those offers, should they materialize, would exclusively employ my client's image in the Middle East only.
client.translationZh: 若这些合作意向能够落实，它们将仅在中东地区使用我客户的形象。
client.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

client.sentenceEn: One of the author's clients found it hard to give up a design project, in which she had put in a lot of time and effort.
client.translationZh: 作者的一位客户发现，要放弃一个投入了大量时间和精力的设计项目并非易事。

compete.sentenceEn: There are competing visions of the best way to arrive at a solution.
compete.translationZh: 关于达成解决方案的最佳途径，存在着不同的观点。
compete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

compete.sentenceEn: But the researchers' calculation showed it would take 10 to 1,000 plants per square meter of floor space to compete with the air cleaning capacity of a building's air handling system or even just a couple of open windows in a house.
compete.translationZh: 但研究人员的计算表明，要与建筑物空气处理系统甚至只是家中几扇打开的窗户的空气净化能力相媲美，每平方米地面空间需要10到1000株植物。
compete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

compete.sentenceEn: It will not comprehend that there are competing interests outside of health and fitness.
compete.translationZh: 它无法理解健康和健身之外还存在其他相互竞争的利益。
compete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第18句

compete.sentenceEn: When Diageo, a British drinks giant, built a brewery in western Kenya, it wanted to use local crops to make a beer cheap enough to compete with illicit home brew.
compete.translationZh: 当英国饮料巨头帝亚吉欧公司在肯尼亚西部建立 brewery 时，它希望使用当地农作物酿造价格足够低廉的啤酒，以与非法家庭自酿酒竞争。

compete.sentenceEn: Initially, we compete for the attention of our parents.
compete.translationZh: 最初，我们为了获得父母的关注而竞争。
compete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

compete.sentenceEn: They have long been competing with chain hotels.
compete.translationZh: 长期以来，他们一直与连锁酒店竞争。

celebrity.sentenceEn: Americans are obsessed with celebrity chefs.
celebrity.translationZh: 美国人痴迷于明星主厨。
celebrity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

celebrity.sentenceEn: Networking is key if you want to become a celebrity in the world of museums and galleries.
celebrity.translationZh: 如果你想在博物馆和画廊界成为名人，人脉是关键。
celebrity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

celebrity.sentenceEn: So, well, at first sight it may appear that working for a celebrity is very glamorous.
celebrity.translationZh: 嗯，乍一看，为名人工作似乎非常光鲜亮丽。
celebrity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

celebrity.sentenceEn: M: Meg, I loved being an athlete, but I didn't love being a celebrity .
celebrity.translationZh: 约翰：梅格，我热爱当运动员，但我不喜欢做名人。
celebrity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

celebrity.sentenceEn: More CGI-recreated images of deceased celebrities are expected to appear on screen.
celebrity.translationZh: 预计将有更多计算机生成的已故名人影像出现在银幕上。

contact.sentenceEn: If someone stops caring about people and cuts off all contact , this could point to an irrational neglect of social relations.
contact.translationZh: 如果一个人不再关心他人并断绝所有联系，这可能表明其对社会关系存在非理性的忽视。

contact.sentenceEn: But as long as you have regular social contact , you are choosing solitude rather than being forced into it, you have at least a few good friends and your solitude is good for your well-being or productivity, there's no point agonising over how to fit a square personality into a round hole.
contact.translationZh: 但只要你有正常的社交往来，是主动选择独处而非被迫独处，至少有几个好朋友，并且这种独处对你的身心健康或工作效率有益，那么就没必要纠结如何把方方正正的性格硬塞进圆洞里了。

contact.sentenceEn: And make sure your name is on the bag, along with your phone number, so an agent can contact you.
contact.translationZh: 请务必在包上标明您的姓名和电话号码，以便工作人员与您联系。
contact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

contact.sentenceEn: While finding solutions for loneliness is highly personal, research suggests the best interventions are those that involve meaningful social contact at least once a week.
contact.translationZh: 虽然解决孤独问题的方法高度个性化，但研究表明，最佳干预措施是每周至少进行一次有意义的社交接触。
contact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

contact.sentenceEn: Elizabeth Lev believes increased contact with more wildlife helps conserve biodiversity.
contact.translationZh: 伊丽莎白·莱夫认为，增加与更多野生动物的接触有助于保护生物多样性。

contact.sentenceEn: Contact the airport staff to find our missing bag.
contact.translationZh: 联系机场工作人员寻找我们丢失的行李。

critic.sentenceEn: Many critics of animal agriculture are quick to point out that if farmers raised only plants, they could produce more pounds of food and more calories per person.
critic.translationZh: 许多动物农业的批评者很快指出，如果农民只种植植物，他们可以为每个人生产更多磅的食物和更多卡路里。

critic.sentenceEn: M: The assortments of accessories in this collection have had quite the impact on critics .
critic.translationZh: 男士：这个系列的配饰组合对评论家产生了相当大的影响。
critic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

critic.sentenceEn: The idea that governments should focus on happiness has its critics .
critic.translationZh: 认为政府应专注于提升幸福感的观点也受到了一些批评。
critic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

critic.sentenceEn: Our guest today is Frank Jones, a critic of our education system, and the author of a new book, How to Reform Our Universities.
critic.translationZh: 今天我们的嘉宾是弗兰克·琼斯，他是教育系统评论家，也是新书《如何改革我们的大学》的作者。
critic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

critic.sentenceEn: According to one critic , the audience's warm response would encourage the musicians to do a better job.
critic.translationZh: 一位评论家表示，观众的热烈反响会鼓励音乐家们表现得更好。

critic.sentenceEn: He works as a literary critic .

centre.sentenceEn: "However, we have one more big myth to dispose of: that we exist as independent selves at the centre of a subjective universe.
centre.translationZh: 然而，我们还需要破除一个重大迷思：即我们作为独立的自我存在于一个主观宇宙的中心。
centre.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

centre.sentenceEn: "A significant milestone in the cultural evolution of human minds was the acceptance that the Earth is not the centre of the universe, the so-called Copernican Revolution," he writes.
centre.translationZh: 他写道：“人类思想文化演进的一个重要里程碑是接受地球并非宇宙中心这一观点，即所谓的哥白尼革命。”
centre.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

centre.sentenceEn: Just as Copernicus realised the Earth is not the centre of the universe, Professor Oliver said society urgently needs a Copernican-like revolution to understand people are not detached beings but rather part of one connected identity.
centre.translationZh: 奥利弗教授表示，正如哥白尼认识到地球并非宇宙中心一样，社会迫切需要一场类似哥白尼式的革命，以理解人类并非孤立存在的个体，而是一个相互关联的整体的组成部分。
centre.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

centre.sentenceEn: In the bowels of CFF's third dome, lab manager Gomathy Sethuraman opens a window into the centre 's "crown jewels", revealing vines of winged beans growing under a bright yellow light.
centre.translationZh: 在CFF第三穹顶的内部，实验室经理戈马西·塞图拉曼打开了一扇通往该中心“皇冠上的明珠”的窗户，展示着在明亮的黄色灯光下生长的四棱豆藤蔓。

centre.sentenceEn: What does Professor Tom Oliver think of the idea that we exist as independent selves at the centre of a subjective universe?
centre.translationZh: 汤姆·奥利弗教授如何看待我们作为独立自我存在于主观宇宙中心这一观点？

centre.sentenceEn: It helps reduce traffic jams in the city centre .
centre.translationZh: 它在很大程度上缓解了市中心的交通拥堵。

classical.sentenceEn: Although there are many great composers of classical music like Bach, Beethoven and Handel, none of these artists' music seems to have the same health effects as Mozart's does.
classical.translationZh: 尽管有许多伟大的古典音乐作曲家，如巴赫、贝多芬和亨德尔，但这些艺术家的音乐似乎都不具备与莫扎特音乐相同的健康效果。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

classical.sentenceEn: Whether classical music is something that you listen to on a regular basis or not, it wouldn't hurt to take time out of your day to listen to music that you find soothing.
classical.translationZh: 无论你是否经常听古典音乐，每天抽出一点时间听听让你感到舒缓的音乐总是有益无害的。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

classical.sentenceEn: If you're looking to alleviate stress, you might want to give classical music a try.
classical.translationZh: 如果你想缓解压力，不妨试试古典音乐。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

classical.sentenceEn: One study found that students who had trouble sleeping slept better while they were listening to classical music.
classical.translationZh: 一项研究发现，有睡眠障碍的学生在听古典音乐时睡眠质量有所改善。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

classical.sentenceEn: It is generally accepted that there should be no disturbance from the audience during classical music performance.
classical.translationZh: 人们普遍认为，古典音乐演出期间不应有来自观众的干扰。

classical.sentenceEn: Classical music aims to evolve, build audiences without alienating old guard
classical.translationZh: 古典音乐旨在革新发展，在不疏远老听众的同时拓展新观众

combine.sentenceEn: When shrinking municipal budgets combine with the nonstop technological revolution, public library services that focus on building communities face-to-face, inspiring and educating patrons about art, literature, and music, and helping patrons engage in civil discourse can seem old-fashioned.
combine.translationZh: 当不断缩减的市政预算遇上永不停歇的技术革命，那些专注于面对面社区建设、启发和教育读者了解艺术、文学和音乐，以及帮助读者参与公民对话的公共图书馆服务，似乎显得有些过时了。

combine.sentenceEn: These, combined with a rapidly rising world population, give us plenty of compelling reasons to continue to work for greater efficiencies in animal agriculture.
combine.translationZh: 这些因素，再加上世界人口的迅速增长，为我们继续致力于提高畜牧业效率提供了充分的有力理由。

combine.sentenceEn: Combined with machine learning of anticipated order volumes and the minute-by-minute cooking data generated by systems such as QSR, that robot fleet could deliver almost instantly.
combine.translationZh: 结合对预期订单量的机器学习，以及由 QSR 等系统生成的每分钟烹饪数据，该机器人机群几乎可以实现即时交付。

combine.sentenceEn: Especially when combined with an "I'm not a quitter" mentality, feeling like we have more control over an event or person than we do puts us at risk of doubling down when we should pull out.
combine.translationZh: 当我们觉得自己对某件事或某个人的控制力超出了实际情况时，尤其是再加上那种‘我绝不轻言放弃’的心态，往往会让我们在理应抽身时反而选择孤注一掷。

combine.sentenceEn: The higher rate of employment, combined with limited housing supply, did not make it any easier to buy a house.
combine.translationZh: 就业率上升，加上住房供应有限，并未使购房变得更容易。

combine.sentenceEn: Elementary schoolchildren will be frustrated when taught with several methods combined .
combine.translationZh: 如果同时采用多种方法教小学生阅读，他们会感到困惑。

carefully.sentenceEn: What looks at times like chaos is in fact a carefully orchestrated plan: Each morning, the Westwood teams meet to hammer out a personalized program for every student the team will focus on that day.
carefully.translationZh: 有时看似混乱的局面，实则是经过精心策划的安排：每天早晨，韦斯特伍德团队都会开会，为当天要重点关注的每位学生制定个性化方案。
carefully.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

carefully.sentenceEn: Instead, people cope with challenging climates and ecological contexts by carefully copying others.
carefully.translationZh: 相反，人类通过仔细模仿他人来应对具有挑战性的气候和生态环境。
carefully.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

carefully.sentenceEn: Oddly, the children carefully copied all the steps to open the box, even when they could see that the stick had no practical effect.
carefully.translationZh: 奇怪的是，孩子们会仔细模仿打开盒子的所有步骤，即便他们明明可以看到那根棍子并没有实际作用。
carefully.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

carefully.sentenceEn: Who is more at fault, Bass asks, the professional archaeologist who carefully excavates a site and never publishes on it or the treasure hunter who locates a submerged wreck, salvages part, conserves part, and publishes a book on the operation?
carefully.translationZh: 巴斯问道：一位专业考古学家精心发掘了遗址却从不发表研究成果，与一位找到水下沉船、打捞部分文物、保存部分文物并出版相关著作的寻宝者相比，谁的过失更大？

carefully.sentenceEn: We need to carefully examine our lives and our fears, and to ask ourselves whether our attitudes come from our personal knowledge and experience or from rumors and fear of the unknown.
carefully.translationZh: 我们需要仔细审视自己的生活和恐惧，并问问自己：我们的态度是源于亲身的了解和经历，还是源于谣言和对未知的恐惧。
carefully.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

carefully.sentenceEn: They meet challenges by imitating others carefully .
carefully.translationZh: 人类通过仔细模仿他人来应对挑战。

chain.sentenceEn: One 2011 study showed that in branches of a pizza chain where employees were more passive, outgoing bosses were associated with higher profits.
chain.translationZh: 2011年的一项研究显示，在员工较为被动的披萨连锁店分店中，外向的老板与更高的利润相关联。

chain.sentenceEn: By investing in neglected local plants, countries can reduce their reliance on imported crops and their carbon-heavy supply chains .
chain.translationZh: 通过投资被忽视的本土植物，各国可以减少对进口作物及其高碳供应链的依赖。

chain.sentenceEn: Gratitude for the anonymous men and women who make up the supply chain rarely makes its way into our consciousness.
chain.translationZh: 我们很少会想到要感谢那些构成供应链的无名男女。

chain.sentenceEn: There is scarcely a single commodity in any American household that isn't dependent for its manufacture and sale, through one supply chain or another, on scores of different people spread out across the entire globe.
chain.translationZh: 美国家庭中的任何一种商品，其生产和销售几乎都要通过这样或那样的供应链，依赖遍布全球的众多不同人员。

chain.sentenceEn: For Moss, this puts the notion of "fast food" in an entirely new light as this isn't limited to fast food chains -almost 90% of food products in grocery stores are processed foods.
chain.translationZh: 在莫斯看来，这为“快餐”概念赋予了全新的含义——这一概念并不局限于快餐连锁店，因为杂货店中近90%的食品都是加工食品。
chain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第8句

chain.sentenceEn: They have long been competing with chain hotels.
chain.translationZh: 长期以来，他们一直与连锁酒店竞争。

clearly.sentenceEn: Adherence to these principles, along with a commitment to truthful dialogue, can help every student better appreciate how far we've come and more clearly see the roads we have yet to travel.
clearly.translationZh: 遵循这些原则并致力于真诚对话，可以帮助每一位学生更好地认识到我们已经取得的成就，并更清晰地看到我们仍需前行的道路。
clearly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

clearly.sentenceEn: "Since our bodies are essentially made anew every few weeks, the material in them alone is clearly insufficient to explain the persistent thread of an identity."
clearly.translationZh: 既然我们的身体每隔几周就基本上会更新一次，那么显然仅凭体内的物质不足以解释身份认同这一持续存在的脉络。
clearly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

clearly.sentenceEn: The next account was in 1906, again in the Athens Weekly Banner, again very clearly copying the original account, only slightly reworded, the 19th century equivalent of re-posts when the audience has forgotten about the original.
clearly.translationZh: 下一次记载出现在1906年，同样刊登于《雅典每周旗帜报》，同样是对原始记载的明显抄袭，仅做了些许文字修改，这相当于19世纪版的“重新发布”——当读者已经忘记原始内容时的再次分享。

clearly.sentenceEn: This featured another account very clearly just copying the original article published about a decade before, only slightly reworded.
clearly.translationZh: 这篇特别报道明显是另一个账号在抄袭大约十年前发表的原创文章，只是稍作了文字修改。

clearly.sentenceEn: They are clearly in a state of high arousal.
clearly.translationZh: 他们显然处于高度兴奋的状态。
clearly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

clearly.sentenceEn: The alien finds the audience in the movie theatre clearly in a state of ______.
clearly.translationZh: 外星人发现电影院里的观众显然处于一种______的状态。

context.sentenceEn: Maybe it's flexible and adaptable based on social context .
context.translationZh: 也许它会根据社会背景灵活调整。
context.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

context.sentenceEn: This explains why the first question we will be asked in any new social context is 'What do you do?' and according to how we answer, snobs will either welcome us with broad smiles, or leave us in the cold.
context.translationZh: 这就解释了为什么在任何新的社交场合，我们被问到的第一个问题总是'你是做什么的？'，而根据我们的回答，势利之人要么会笑脸相迎，要么就会对我们冷眼相待。
context.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

context.sentenceEn: The evolution of traffic light signals could not have a more appropriate context than Motor City.
context.translationZh: 交通信号灯的演进，没有比在‘汽车之城’更合适的背景了。

context.sentenceEn: The researchers concede that this research was about changes to mostly moderate beliefs—it's likely the findings would be different in the context of changes to extreme or deeply held beliefs.
context.translationZh: 研究人员承认，这项研究主要关注的是对中度信念的改变——如果研究对象是极端或根深蒂固的信念变化，结果很可能会有所不同。
context.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

context.sentenceEn: A new study looks at the relationship between meaning and happiness in the context of financial resources.
context.translationZh: 一项新研究探讨了在经济资源背景下意义与幸福之间的关系。
context.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

context.sentenceEn: They tend to place people in a social context .
context.translationZh: 他们倾向于将人置于社会背景中考虑。

constantly.sentenceEn: The true answer to snobbery is not to say that there is no such thing as a better or worse person, but to insist that better or worse exist in constantly unexpected places and carry none of the outward signs of distinction.
constantly.translationZh: 真正克服势利的方法，不是否认人与人之间存在优劣之分，而是坚持认为：优劣之别往往出现在最意想不到的地方，且从不带有任何外在的区分标志。
constantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

constantly.sentenceEn: One reason is the belief that we should accept who we are and not constantly strive to improve ourselves.
constantly.translationZh: 一个原因是认为我们应该接受自己本来的样子，而不是不断努力去提升自己。
constantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

constantly.sentenceEn: Nurturing a few solid relationships without feeling the need to constantly populate your life with endless chatting ultimately may be better for you.
constantly.translationZh: 精心培养几段稳固的关系，不必总觉得需要让生活充斥着没完没了的闲聊，这最终可能对你更好。

constantly.sentenceEn: Professor Oliver argues there are around 37 trillion cells in the body but most have a lifespan of just a few days or weeks, so the material "us" is constantly changing.
constantly.translationZh: 奥利弗教授认为，人体内约有37万亿个细胞，但大多数细胞的寿命只有几天或几周，因此构成“我们”的物质处于不断变化之中。
constantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

constantly.sentenceEn: Why does Professor Tom Oliver claim that the material "us" is constantly changing?
constantly.translationZh: 为什么汤姆·奥利弗教授声称“我们”这种物质在不断变化？
它们正处于不断的完善之中。

consume.sentenceEn: As one example, the energy in plants that livestock consume is most often contained in cellulose(纤维素), which is indigestible for humans and many other mammals.
consume.translationZh: 例如，牲畜食用的植物能量通常存在于纤维素中，而纤维素对于人类和许多其他哺乳动物来说是无法消化的。

consume.sentenceEn: This anecdotal evidence matches the conclusions of the study, which found no evidence that dietary diversity promotes healthy body weight or optimal eating patterns, and limited evidence that eating a variety of foods is actually associated with consuming more calories, poor eating patterns and weight gain.
consume.translationZh: 这一轶事证据与研究结论相符，该研究没有发现饮食多样性能促进健康体重或优化饮食习惯的证据，且仅有有限证据表明，摄入多种食物实际上与摄入更多热量、不良饮食习惯和体重增加有关。
consume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

consume.sentenceEn: But recent studies show that 70% of American adults have lost the ability to naturally compensate for the calories they consume ; worse still, a significant number of them report diminishing hunger halfway through an eating session, but, by the end of the meal, they feel the same or higher levels of hunger than when they sat down.
consume.translationZh: 但最近的研究表明，70%的美国成年人已经失去了对所摄入卡路里进行自然代偿的能力；更糟糕的是，相当一部分人表示，在进食过程中饥饿感会有所减轻，但用餐结束时，他们的饥饿感却与坐下就餐时相同，甚至更强烈。
consume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

consume.sentenceEn: But Morton was one of the world's first conservationists, stating, "For prosperity, we ought to plant as many forests as we have exhausted and consumed ".
consume.translationZh: 但莫顿是世界上最早的环保主义者之一，他曾说：“为了繁荣，我们应当种植与我们消耗和用尽的同样多的森林。”
consume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

consume.sentenceEn: Environmentalists try hard to make people consume less meat to combat climate change.
consume.translationZh: 环保人士努力促使人们减少肉类消费，以应对气候变化。

consume.sentenceEn: They tend to consume larger portions of unhealthy food.
consume.translationZh: 他们倾向于摄入更大量的健康程度较低的食物。

content.sentenceEn: M: I mean, do you know if its contents have been copied and saved somewhere else?
content.translationZh: 我是说，你知道它的内容有没有被复制保存到其他地方吗？
content.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

content.sentenceEn: Never store foods with high water content here, because the water within them can and will freeze, effectively ruining them.
content.translationZh: 请勿在此存放高水分含量的食物，因为其中的水分会结冰，从而导致食物变质。
content.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

content.sentenceEn: Airlines inventory their mishandled baggage, and many use a database to match the contents with owners' descriptions.
content.translationZh: 航空公司会对处理不当的行李进行清点，许多公司还会使用数据库将行李内物品与失主的描述进行匹配。
content.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

content.sentenceEn: Children who read the electronic books also commented more on the content and learned more new words than the children who read printed books.
content.translationZh: 与阅读纸质书籍的孩子相比，阅读电子书的孩子对内容的评价更多，并且学到了更多新词汇。
content.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

content.sentenceEn: Extra features in electronic books may increase children's participation with them; however, if these features don't draw attention to the educational content , they may not serve as a supportive feature.
content.translationZh: 电子书中的额外功能可能会增加儿童的参与度；然而，如果这些功能无法引导儿童关注教育内容，它们可能无法起到辅助作用。
content.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

content.sentenceEn: Why should we never store foods with high water content at the back of the bottom shelf?
content.translationZh: 为什么我们不应该将高水分含量的食物存放在底层架子的后部？

court.sentenceEn: You need to remember that courts , like all bureaucracies really, can be very messy, frustrating, and expensive.
court.translationZh: 你要记住，法庭和所有官僚机构一样，实际上可能非常混乱、令人沮丧且耗资巨大。
court.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

court.sentenceEn: For this reason, it's usually better to resolve problems outside of court whenever possible.
court.translationZh: 因此，只要有可能，最好在法庭外解决问题。
court.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

court.sentenceEn: That said, to date, none of the original tree's other children have petitioned the courts for their share of the land, so it seems all good.
court.translationZh: 话虽如此，到目前为止，这棵原始树的其他“子女”都没有向法院申请分割土地，所以目前看来一切顺利。

court.sentenceEn: Should you always practise serving from the exactly same location on the court , aiming at the same spot?
court.translationZh: 你是否应该总是站在球场的完全相同位置发球，并瞄准同一个落点？
court.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

court.sentenceEn: Why does the man say it's usually better to resolve problems outside of court whenever possible?
court.translationZh: 为什么这位男士说只要有可能，通常最好在法庭外解决问题？

court.sentenceEn: Courts can be frightening and arbitrary.
court.translationZh: 法庭可能令人恐惧且带有随意性。

cultivate.sentenceEn: Excessive media exposure, including television, can displace exploratory activities such as play and parent-child interactions, which are believed to be key to cultivating curiosity in kids.
cultivate.translationZh: 过度的媒体曝光，包括看电视，会挤占探索性活动的时间，如玩耍和亲子互动，而这些活动被认为是培养孩子好奇心的关键。
cultivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

cultivate.sentenceEn: Perils of tech cities are currently being cultivated across the US, and indeed around the world.
cultivate.translationZh: 如今，科技城市所面临的隐患正在全美乃至全球各地滋生。

cultivate.sentenceEn: That's why, when determining how to create a better work-life balance, we need to consider not only how to balance work and family demands, but also how to cultivate and sustain supportive friendships.
cultivate.translationZh: 因此，在思考如何更好地平衡工作与生活时，我们不仅要考虑如何协调工作与家庭的需求，还应思考如何培养和维系有益的友谊。
cultivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

cultivate.sentenceEn: And while no one would argue for cultivating a false sense of blessedness, there is mounting evidence that counting our blessings is one of the best habits we can develop to promote mental and physical health.
cultivate.translationZh: 当然，没有人会主张刻意培养虚假的幸福感，但越来越多的证据表明，细数生活中的幸事是我们能够养成的最有益身心健康的习惯之一。

cultivate.sentenceEn: It may turn out to be better for one to cultivate a few steady relationships than to busy themselves socialising.
cultivate.translationZh: 与其忙于社交，不如用心经营几个稳定的关系，这可能会更好。

character.sentenceEn: If so, then maybe persistence isn't simply a character trait.
character.translationZh: 如果真是这样，那么坚持不懈或许不只是一种性格特质。
character.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

character.sentenceEn: In this increasingly diverse society we live in, solidarity takes on a complex and multifaceted character as it forms bonds of interdependence among unique individuals living in a fast-changing environment and working within a complex division of labor.
character.translationZh: 在我们生活的这个日益多元化的社会中，团结呈现出一种复杂且多维的特征，它在快速变化的环境中以及复杂的社会分工背景下，将独特的个体联系在一起，形成相互依存的纽带。
character.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

character.sentenceEn: The character traits held for every kind of community, be they traditional hunter gatherers or advanced civilizations, helping to uphold civilized society and foster social cooperation, researchers found.
character.translationZh: 研究人员发现，无论是传统的狩猎采集者群体还是先进文明社会，各类社群都具备一些共同的性格特征，这些特征有助于维护文明社会并促进社会合作。
character.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

character.sentenceEn: Your intentional aspirational goals will also include striving to be your personal best—a person of "good" character , integrity, and trustworthiness.
character.translationZh: 你有意识的远大目标还应包括努力成为最好的自己——一个品格“优良”、正直可靠的人。
character.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

character.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the clever and deceitful characters in a comedy of manners?
character.translationZh: 关于风尚喜剧（或译：世态喜剧）中的聪明狡黠角色，我们能了解到什么？

character.sentenceEn: Judge people on the basis of their distinctive character traits.
character.translationZh: 根据人们独特的性格特征来评判他们。

conclude.sentenceEn: This ended up in the glamorous, luminous look that concluded the show.
conclude.translationZh: 这最终呈现出一种迷人而光彩照人的造型，为整场秀画上了完美句号。
conclude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

conclude.sentenceEn: Kim concludes that "rags-to-riches entertainment media are an important cultural force that promotes and perpetuates beliefs in upward mobility".
conclude.translationZh: 金得出结论：“白手起家类娱乐媒体是一种重要的文化力量，它宣扬并 perpetuates 人们对向上流动的信念。”
conclude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

conclude.sentenceEn: "We hope this work will spark people's curiosity and generate more work on the topic," concludes Raviv.
conclude.translationZh: 拉维夫总结道：“我们希望这项工作能激发人们的好奇心，并推动更多关于这一主题的研究。”
conclude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

conclude.sentenceEn: It is reasonable to conclude that spending is praiseworthy, supposing it is not beyond your means.
conclude.translationZh: 如果消费不超出自己的经济能力，那么认为消费值得称赞是合理的。
conclude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第9句

conclude.sentenceEn: All societies are held together by seven universal moral rules, which include deferring to superiors and respecting the property of others, Oxford University has concluded .
conclude.translationZh: 牛津大学的研究结论是，所有社会都由七条普遍道德准则维系，其中包括服从上级和尊重他人财产。
conclude.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

conclude.sentenceEn: The FAO concluded that farm animals were producing more greenhouse gases than all modes of transportation combined.
conclude.translationZh: 联合国粮农组织得出结论，农场动物产生的温室气体比所有交通工具的总和还要多。

contract.sentenceEn: Two months working on nothing but the same contract is a little tough.
contract.translationZh: 整整两个月只忙于这一份合同，确实有些难熬。
contract.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

contract.sentenceEn: And I wish to sign the agreement pending one small change to be made to the contract .
contract.translationZh: 我希望签署协议，但前提是合同需要做一处小修改。
contract.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

contract.sentenceEn: We therefore comb through the fine details of all contracts , rest assured, we all appreciate your firm's patience.
contract.translationZh: 因此，我们正在仔细梳理所有合同的细节。请放心，我们都非常感谢贵公司的耐心等待。
contract.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

contract.sentenceEn: Short-term contracts were granted to local businessmen to act as postmasters.
contract.translationZh: 联邦政府与当地商人签订短期合同，委托他们担任邮政局长。
contract.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

contract.sentenceEn: What does the man have to do on signing the contract ?
contract.translationZh: 男士在签订合同时必须做什么？

contract.sentenceEn: Give the man some good news regarding the contract .
contract.translationZh: 把关于合同的好消息告诉那个人。

complicated.sentenceEn: Which is to say: you are far more likely to remember a complicated password if you know you'll frequently be using it to log into an account than you are to remember a simple password for an account that you don't expect to log into very often.
complicated.translationZh: 也就是说：对于一个你需要经常登录的账户，即使密码复杂，你记住它的可能性也远大于记住一个不常登录账户的简单密码。
complicated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

complicated.sentenceEn: With my family situation getting more complicated and the end of my university education nearing, persisting with Art History just doesn't seem the right choice.
complicated.translationZh: 随着家庭情况日益复杂，大学毕业也日渐临近，坚持攻读艺术史似乎不再是正确的选择。
complicated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

complicated.sentenceEn: In the real world, things are more complicated .
complicated.translationZh: 但现实世界要复杂得多。
complicated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

complicated.sentenceEn: Ditching the web at large, however, is a far more subtle and complicated prospect.
complicated.translationZh: 然而，完全脱离互联网却是一个更加微妙和复杂的问题。
complicated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

complicated.sentenceEn: At a robot-powered US company, complicated tasks still have to be performed by humans.
complicated.translationZh: 在一间由机器人驱动的美国公司，复杂的任务仍须由人工完成。

complicated.sentenceEn: It gives rise to a complicated division of labor.
complicated.translationZh: 这导致了复杂的社会分工。
