combination.sentenceEn: He was able to do this because of a combination of factors—most important, timing and opportunity—but the single-mindedness and determination with which he carried out his self-imposed mission was fundamentally character-based; millions of Marconi's contemporaries had the same class, gender, race, and colonial privilege as he, but only a handful did anything with it.
combination.translationZh: 他之所以能做到这一点，是多种因素共同作用的结果——其中最重要的是时机和机遇——但他执行自我设定使命时所展现的专注与决心，本质上源于他的性格特质。与马可尼同时代的数百万人拥有与他相同的阶级、性别、种族和殖民特权，但只有极少数人能善用这些优势。

combination.sentenceEn: Why does Tenette Smith think a combination of teaching methods is ineffective?
combination.translationZh: 为什么特内特·史密斯认为混合教学方法是无效的？

congress.sentenceEn: Having more women in Congress also fosters a greater sense of connection between female voters and government.
congress.translationZh: 国会中女性议员数量的增加也促进了女性选民与政府之间更强的联系感。
congress.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

congress.sentenceEn: Achieving gender equality in Congress is an important goal.
congress.translationZh: 在国会实现性别平等是一项重要目标。
congress.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

congress.sentenceEn: In order for women to gain half of the seats in Congress , more women need to run, especially on Republican tickets.
congress.translationZh: 要让女性在国会中获得半数席位，需要有更多女性参选，尤其是代表共和党参选。
congress.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

congress.sentenceEn: In the next Congress , there will be 107 female Democratic lawmakers and 42 female Republican lawmakers in the Senate and House combined.
congress.translationZh: 在下一届国会中，参众两院将共有107名民主党女性议员和42名共和党女性议员。
congress.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

congress.sentenceEn: In 1997 Congress requested the National Institute of Child Health and Human Development and the Department of Education to convene a National Reading Panel to end the "reading wars" and synthesize the evidence.
congress.translationZh: 1997年，美国国会要求美国国家儿童健康与人类发展研究所和教育部组建国家阅读专门小组，以终结这场“阅读之争”并综合相关证据。
congress.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

congress.sentenceEn: Some in US Congress have gone so far as to suggest forgiving up to $50,000 in debt per student borrower, but does forgiving student debt necessarily correlate to helping the economically disadvantaged?
congress.translationZh: 美国国会中甚至有人提议，每位学生借款人可获得高达5万美元的债务减免，但减免学生债务就一定意味着能帮助经济困难群体吗？
congress.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

consensus.sentenceEn: While there is strong scientific consensus around most existing guidelines, one question has recently stirred debate: should consumers be warned to avoid ultra-processed foods?
consensus.translationZh: 虽然科学界对大多数现有指南有着强烈共识，但最近有一个问题引发了争议：是否应该警告消费者避免超加工食品？
consensus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

consensus.sentenceEn: There's no consensus in today's science community about how much we can infer from a look, a facial expression or a hand gesture.
consensus.translationZh: 当今科学界对于从一个眼神、一个面部表情或一个手势中能推断出多少信息尚未达成共识。

consensus.sentenceEn: The general consensus is that it mostly comes down to stress and reduced food consumption, not mental exhaustion.
consensus.translationZh: 普遍共识是，这主要归因于压力和食物摄入减少，而非脑力透支。
consensus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

consensus.sentenceEn: This can create unnecessary delays as you hold meetings trying to achieve a consensus .
consensus.translationZh: 当你为了达成共识而召开会议时，这可能会造成不必要的延误。
consensus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

consensus.sentenceEn: There is general consensus among experts that willpower alone cannot guarantee one's success in changing and maintaining a habit.
consensus.translationZh: 专家们普遍认为，仅凭意志力无法保证一个人成功改变并保持习惯。

consensus.sentenceEn: There is less consensus on objects shaped by human craft.
consensus.translationZh: 对于人工制造的物品，人们的共识较少。

contrary.sentenceEn: On the contrary , decades of research shows that female candidates raise as much money and win as often as male politicians with similar credentials.
contrary.translationZh: 相反，数十年的研究表明，在资历相似的情况下，女性候选人募集的资金与男性政客相当，当选率也不相上下。
contrary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

contrary.sentenceEn: But contrary to all the self-proclaimed success experts, doing it alone does not make you more successful or any better than someone who achieved it with the help of others.
contrary.translationZh: 但与那些自封的成功专家所言相反，单打独斗并不会让你比那些在他人帮助下获得成就的人更成功，也不会让你显得更高人一等。
contrary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第5句

contrary.sentenceEn: Contrary to seeing AI as a tool, some musicians consider it to be hugely detrimental to the music scene.
contrary.translationZh: 与将人工智能视为工具的观点相反，一些音乐家认为它对音乐界极为不利。
contrary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

contrary.sentenceEn: On the contrary , when people stay at large resorts or on cruise ships, they make most of their purchases there, leaving local communities little opportunity to benefit from tourist spending.
contrary.translationZh: 相反，当人们入住大型度假村或乘坐游轮时，他们的大部分消费都发生在这些场所内，这使得当地社区几乎没有机会从游客消费中获益。
contrary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

contrary.sentenceEn: On the contrary , compelling tourists to make a financial contribution to the places they visit beyond their personal consumption should be part of a wider cultural shift.
contrary.translationZh: 相反，促使游客在个人消费之外，为其到访的地方做出经济贡献，应当成为更广泛文化转变的一部分。
contrary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

contrary.sentenceEn: It is contrary to logic to claim the name of wolf moon originates from the cultures of American Indians.
contrary.translationZh: 声称狼月这一名称起源于美洲印第安人文化是不合逻辑的。

cooperate.sentenceEn: They are usually good at cooperating with people and understanding the needs of others.
cooperate.translationZh: 他们通常擅长与人合作并理解他人的需求。
cooperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

cooperate.sentenceEn: When playing with others, they don't cooperate because they do not realize there are different roles and perspectives.
cooperate.translationZh: 与他人玩耍时，他们不会合作，因为他们没有意识到存在不同的角色和视角。

cooperate.sentenceEn: At first, the tribe member, named Gonzalez, was very reluctant to cooperate .
cooperate.translationZh: 起初，这位名叫冈萨雷斯的部落成员极不情愿合作。
cooperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

cooperate.sentenceEn: When the health insurance industry was still cooperating in reform efforts, its trade group offered to provide standardized forms for automated processing.
cooperate.translationZh: 当健康保险行业仍在配合改革工作时，其行业协会曾提议提供标准化表格以实现自动化处理。

cooperate.sentenceEn: The officials are glad to cooperate with her by showing her the products that are available.
cooperate.translationZh: 这些官员很乐意与她合作，向她展示各种可供选购的产品。
cooperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第12句

cooperate.sentenceEn: They cannot prosper without cooperating with each other.
cooperate.translationZh: 不相互合作，他们就无法获得繁荣。

counterpart.sentenceEn: Women who have children begin to see their salaries slip behind their male counterparts .
counterpart.translationZh: 生育子女的女性开始发现自己的薪资落后于男性同行。
counterpart.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

counterpart.sentenceEn: My counterpart and I agreed we might never ascertain the actual facts of the matter; quite likely there were elements of truth in both employees' stories.
counterpart.translationZh: 我和对方一致认为，我们可能永远无法查明此事的真相；很可能这两名员工的说法中都包含一定的属实成分。
counterpart.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

counterpart.sentenceEn: We also have accepted the idea that college presidents, and their many vice-presidents, should be paid like their counterparts in the business world and that higher education requires an elaborate, up-to-date technology infrastructure.
counterpart.translationZh: 我们还接受了这样一种观念：大学校长及其众多副校长的薪酬应当与商界对应职位相当，并且高等教育需要复杂先进的技术基础设施。

counterpart.sentenceEn: In fact, bilingual individuals outperform their monolingual counterparts on a variety of cognitive tasks, such as following complex instructions, and switching to new instructions.
counterpart.translationZh: 事实上，在各种认知任务中，双语者的表现都优于单语者，例如遵循复杂指令和切换到新指令等任务。

counterpart.sentenceEn: What did the speaker and his counterpart do when the two employees gave different accounts of the same event?
counterpart.translationZh: 当两名员工对同一事件的叙述不一致时，演讲者及其同行是如何处理的？

counterpart.sentenceEn: They became rivals of their Parisian counterparts .
counterpart.translationZh: 她们成为了与巴黎同行相抗衡的对手。

curiosity.sentenceEn: "We hope this work will spark people's curiosity and generate more work on the topic," concludes Raviv.
curiosity.translationZh: 拉维夫总结道：“我们希望这项工作能激发人们的好奇心，并推动更多关于这一主题的研究。”
curiosity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

curiosity.sentenceEn: Researchers assessed hours of daily television exposure and frequency of parent-screen-time conversation among 1,500 preschoolers, and then measured early childhood curiosity in kindergarten.
curiosity.translationZh: 研究人员评估了1500名学龄前儿童的每日电视接触时长和父母-屏幕时间对话频率，随后测量了这些儿童在幼儿园时期的早期好奇心。
curiosity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

curiosity.sentenceEn: "Our findings reinforce the importance of parent conversation to promote early childhood development and curiosity ," said lead author Prachi Shah at University of Michigan Health C.S. Mott Children's Hospital.
curiosity.translationZh: 密歇根大学健康中心C.S. Mott儿童医院的主要作者普拉奇·沙阿表示：“我们的研究结果强调了父母对话对促进儿童早期发展和好奇心的重要性。”
curiosity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

curiosity.sentenceEn: As a new study suggests, the more parents engaged in conversation with preschoolers during TV time, the more likely those children were to have higher curiosity levels when they reached kindergarten.
curiosity.translationZh: 一项新研究表明，父母在孩子看电视时与学龄前儿童的交流越多，这些孩子进入幼儿园时的好奇心水平就越有可能更高。
curiosity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

curiosity.sentenceEn: Excessive media exposure, including television, can displace exploratory activities such as play and parent-child interactions, which are believed to be key to cultivating curiosity in kids.
curiosity.translationZh: 过度的媒体曝光，包括看电视，会挤占探索性活动的时间，如玩耍和亲子互动，而这些活动被认为是培养孩子好奇心的关键。
curiosity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

curiosity.sentenceEn: Parents' talking with them during TV time raises their curiosity levels.
curiosity.translationZh: 父母在看电视时与孩子交谈能提高他们的好奇心。

cyberloafing.sentenceEn: This behavior, called cyberloafing , is believed to cost employers up to $85 billion a year in lost productivity.
cyberloafing.translationZh: 这种被称为“网络摸鱼”的行为，据信每年给雇主造成高达850亿美元的 productivity损失。
cyberloafing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

cyberloafing.sentenceEn: But is cyberloafing actually effective at reducing employee stress levels?
cyberloafing.translationZh: 但是，网络摸鱼真的能有效减轻员工的压力水平吗？
cyberloafing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

cyberloafing.sentenceEn: This suggests that cyberloafing acts as a sort of relief valve for workers, helping them recover from stressful experiences.
cyberloafing.translationZh: 这表明，网络摸鱼对员工而言就像是一种泄压阀，帮助他们从充满压力的经历中恢复过来。
cyberloafing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第9句

cyberloafing.sentenceEn: The majority of cyberloafing research focuses on ways to prevent employees from engaging in this behavior through interventions such as internet monitoring and computer use policies.
cyberloafing.translationZh: 大多数关于网络摸鱼的研究都侧重于通过互联网监控和计算机使用政策等干预措施来防止员工出现这种行为。
cyberloafing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

cyberloafing.sentenceEn: What does most cyberloafing research focus on?
cyberloafing.translationZh: 大多数网络摸鱼研究关注什么？

cyberloafing.sentenceEn: Cyberloafing is a sign of workers' laziness.
cyberloafing.translationZh: 网络摸鱼是员工懒惰的表现。

caution.sentenceEn: Steady Yellow Arrows maintain the normal yellow light caution in three-light signals, meaning to stop or prepare to stop.
caution.translationZh: 常亮黄箭头信号灯的作用与普通三色信号灯中的黄灯相同，起到警告作用，意味着应当停车或准备停车。

caution.sentenceEn: Flashing Yellow lights mean yield or signal caution , like outside of a fire station.
caution.translationZh: 黄灯闪烁表示礼让或警示，例如在消防局门外。

caution.sentenceEn: Green means it's safe to proceed (though you should still exercise caution ).
caution.translationZh: 绿色代表可以安全通行（但仍应保持警惕）。

caution.sentenceEn: The researchers, however, exercise caution by warning no one single response is the perfect remedy.
caution.translationZh: 然而，研究人员也谨慎地警告说，没有任何单一的应对措施是完美的解决方案。
caution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

caution.sentenceEn: Workers have to take extra caution executing their duties.
caution.translationZh: 工人们在执行任务时必须格外小心。

census.sentenceEn: According to my analysis of data from the Census Bureau, the decline of American motherhood is real, occurring very quickly, and may continue for some time yet.
census.translationZh: 根据我对人口普查局数据的分析，美国母亲角色的衰落是真实存在的，其发生速度很快，并且可能还会持续一段时间。
census.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

census.sentenceEn: Census data has shown Australians come from more than 200 countries.
census.translationZh: 人口普查数据显示，澳大利亚人的出生地超过200个国家。
census.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

census.sentenceEn: Sure enough, the Census Bureau just released data showing that online retail sales surged 15.2 percent between the first quarter of 2015 and the first quarter of 2016.
census.translationZh: 果然，美国人口普查局刚刚发布的数据显示，2015年第一季度至2016年第一季度期间，在线零售额激增了15.2%。

census.sentenceEn: It is certain that the Census procedures, which lump the online sales of major traditional retailers like Walmart with "non-store retailers" like food trucks can mask major changes in individual retail categories.
census.translationZh: 可以肯定的是，人口普查局的统计方法将沃尔玛等主要传统零售商的线上销售额与食品卡车等“无店铺零售商”的销售额混为一谈，这可能掩盖了各个零售品类的重大变化。

census.sentenceEn: What does the speaker conclude from her analysis of the Census Bureau's data?
census.translationZh: 演讲者通过分析人口普查局的数据得出了什么结论？

census.sentenceEn: It has not improved as much as reported by the Census Bureau.
census.translationZh: 其改善程度并未达到人口普查局所报告的水平。

chef.sentenceEn: Americans are obsessed with celebrity chefs .
chef.translationZh: 美国人痴迷于明星主厨。
chef.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

chef.sentenceEn: Perhaps the principles of cooking organization can be extended to help even those of us who aren't top chefs .
chef.translationZh: 或许烹饪组织的原则可以推广开来，帮助我们这些并非顶级厨师的人。
chef.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

chef.sentenceEn: They set up their chef whites.
chef.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第9句

chef.sentenceEn: Rather than having a chef shouting out diners' orders, the QSR system automatically distributes those orders across screens.
chef.translationZh: QSR（快餐餐厅）系统不再需要厨师大声喊出顾客的订单，而是会自动将这些订单分配到各个显示屏上。

chef.sentenceEn: There is an acute shortage of experienced chefs in the catering industry and automated cooking is expected to fill the gap.
chef.translationZh: 餐饮行业面临资深厨师严重短缺的问题，而自动化烹饪有望填补这一缺口。

chef.sentenceEn: They hire very few distinguished chefs .
chef.translationZh: 他们很少聘请杰出的厨师。

coding.sentenceEn: "We teach algebra because it's important and we should teach foreign language and coding for the same reason. Exposure to a wide breadth of subjects and material results in well-rounded students who are able to make informed decisions … about what they want to pursue."
coding.translationZh: 我们教授代数是因为它很重要，而我们教授外语和编程也应出于同样的原因。广泛接触各类学科和知识能够培养出全面发展的学生，使他们能够就自己想要追求的方向做出明智的决定。

coding.sentenceEn: "I think the opportunity to give people a choice is important," says Florida state Senator Jeremy Ring, who introduced a bill last year that would allow Florida students to choose between foreign language and coding classes for the purpose of university admissions requirements, "I think if you're going to give two years of language in high school, you might as well do computer coding ."
coding.translationZh: 佛罗里达州参议员杰里米·林表示：“我认为给予人们选择的机会非常重要。”他去年提出了一项法案，允许佛罗里达学生在满足大学入学要求时，在外语课程和编程课程之间做出选择。“我认为，如果要在高中学习两年语言课程，那还不如学习计算机编程。”

coding.sentenceEn: Some states have considered allowing students to forgo(放弃) foreign language for coding classes, despite opposition from educators.
coding.translationZh: 尽管遭到教育工作者的反对，一些州已在考虑允许学生放弃外语课程，转而选择编程课程。

coding.sentenceEn: Texas passed a bill in 2013 that allows students to substitute computer coding only after they have attempted and performed poorly in a foreign language class.
coding.translationZh: 德克萨斯州于2013年通过一项法案，允许学生只有在尝试学习外语课程但表现不佳后，才能用计算机编程课替代外语课。

coding.sentenceEn: One U.S. state senator proposed that high school students be allowed to study either foreign language or computer coding .
coding.translationZh: 一位美国州参议员提议允许高中生选择学习外语或计算机编程。

coding.sentenceEn: Is computer coding a foreign language?
coding.translationZh: 计算机编程算是一门外语吗？

consist.sentenceEn: Based on their findings, the researchers endorse a diet consisting of a limited number of healthy foods such as vegetables, fruits, grains, and poultry.
consist.translationZh: 基于研究发现，研究人员支持由有限种类健康食物组成的饮食，如蔬菜、水果、谷物和禽肉。
consist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

consist.sentenceEn: Reflecting on his own college education, President Garfield once commented that an ideal college would consist of nothing more than the legendary teacher Mark Hopkins on one end of a log and a student on the other.
consist.translationZh: 加菲尔德总统在反思自己的大学教育时曾评论道，理想的大学不过是传奇教师马克·霍普金斯和一名学生分别坐在一根原木的两端而已。

consist.sentenceEn: They choose an area of the island with the best Internet reception and set up a makeshift(临时凑合的) medical center which consists of plastic stools and small tables borrowed from the locals' homes, a tent in case of rain and a sheet that is strung up to give the patients privacy during their session.
consist.translationZh: 他们会选择岛上网络信号最好的区域，搭建一个临时医疗中心。这个中心由向当地人借来的塑料凳子和小桌子、一个防雨用的帐篷，以及一块为患者就诊时提供隐私保护而拉起的布单组成。

consist.sentenceEn: And some nights, Terauds said, "at least a third" of the audience consists of students who have purchased cheaper tickets.
consist.translationZh: 特劳兹说，有些夜晚，"至少三分之一"的观众是购买了低价票的学生。

consist.sentenceEn: Although Rapp's practices may sound extreme, he is part of a growing movement, consisting largely of tech industry workers who claim that such radical tactics will help them live better and longer.
consist.translationZh: 尽管拉普的做法听起来可能有些极端，但他却是一个日益壮大的运动的一份子。这个运动主要由科技行业工作者组成，他们声称这种激进策略能帮助他们活得更好、更长久。
consist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

consist.sentenceEn: Their food mainly consists of small animals and fish.
consist.translationZh: 它们的食物主要包括小型动物和鱼类。

consistently.sentenceEn: There are other benefits, both mental and physical, to staying consistently active that we should not disregard.
consistently.translationZh: 保持规律运动对身心健康都有其他不容忽视的好处。
consistently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

consistently.sentenceEn: So why bother exercising consistently throughout your life?
consistently.translationZh: 那么，为什么还要坚持终身锻炼呢？
consistently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

consistently.sentenceEn: New research looked at people who increased their exercise levels after their 40s beyond levels they had when they were younger and those individuals showed declines in their risk of early mortality which were similar to those of people who exercised consistently throughout their lives.
consistently.translationZh: 最新研究显示，在40岁后增加锻炼强度、甚至超过年轻时期水平的人群，其早逝风险的降幅与终身坚持锻炼的人群相似。
consistently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

consistently.sentenceEn: In fact, there has never been a single standard that's been fully agreed upon — and broadcast outlets across the spectrum have never consistently held to those standards anyway.
consistently.translationZh: 事实上，从来没有一个完全一致的统一标准——而且无论如何，各行各业的广播机构也从未始终如一地遵守过这些标准。
consistently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

consistently.sentenceEn: What's more, since actions strongly determine thoughts and feelings, when a person consistently acts sarcastically it may only serve to heighten their underlying hostility and insecurity.
consistently.translationZh: 更重要的是，由于行为强烈影响思想和感受，当一个人持续以讽刺的方式行事时，这只会加剧其内心深处的敌意和不安全感。
consistently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

consistently.sentenceEn: What happens when a person consistently acts sarcastically?
consistently.translationZh: 如果一个人总是用讽刺的方式说话行事，会发生什么？

constant.sentenceEn: This constant need to succeed has blinded us from seeing through the whirlwind of change that accompanies our everyday lives.
constant.translationZh: 这种对成功的不断渴求，让我们在日常生活的变革旋涡中迷失了双眼。
constant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

constant.sentenceEn: The idea that hungry, howling wolves were such a universal constant in January that all of North America with its different cultures, geographies, and languages spontaneously came up with the same nickname is illogical.
constant.translationZh: 认为饥饿嚎叫的狼群是一月份的普遍现象，以至于拥有不同文化、地理环境和语言的整个北美大陆会不约而同地想出同一个昵称，这种想法是不合逻辑的。

constant.sentenceEn: He said my constant questioning of him and his decisions was the most obvious example he could give.
constant.translationZh: 他说我总是质疑他和他的决定，这是他能举出的最明显的例子。
constant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

constant.sentenceEn: Amid all the changes, one feature remained constant —the postal service.
constant.translationZh: 历经种种变迁，有一项事物始终未变——邮政服务。
constant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

constant.sentenceEn: The question of who will bear the cost of lifelong learning is a topic of constant debate.
constant.translationZh: 谁将承担终身学习的费用，这是一个长期争论的话题。

constant.sentenceEn: Women are under constant pressure to keep up with beauty models.
constant.translationZh: 女性一直承受着紧跟 beauty models 的压力。

corporate.sentenceEn: He was also a skilled and sophisticated organizer, an entrepreneurial innovator, who mastered the use of corporate strategy, media relations, government lobbying, international diplomacy, patents, and prosecution.
corporate.translationZh: 他还是一位技艺高超、精明老练的组织者，一位富有创业精神的创新者，精通企业战略、媒体关系、政府游说、国际外交、专利申请以及专利诉讼。

corporate.sentenceEn: It wasn't until I entered the corporate world that I realized, for me at least, being friends with colleagues didn't emerge as a priority at all.
corporate.translationZh: 直到进入职场，我才意识到，至少对我而言，与同事交朋友根本不是什么优先事项。
corporate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

corporate.sentenceEn: The main building is topped with a Georgian Tower with four sculptures of the mythical winged horse, the magazine's corporate logo.
corporate.translationZh: 主楼顶部是一座乔治亚风格的塔楼，上面有四座神话中的飞马雕塑，这是该杂志的企业标志。
corporate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

corporate.sentenceEn: There, his students of "citizen statistics" learn to analyze public information like the federal budget and corporate reports.
corporate.translationZh: 在这门课上，他那些学习'公民统计学'的学生们学习分析联邦预算和公司报告等公共信息。
corporate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

corporate.sentenceEn: What did the author realize when he re-entered the corporate world?
corporate.translationZh: 作者重新进入职场时意识到了什么？

corporate.sentenceEn: They are vital to corporate culture.
corporate.translationZh: 它们对企业文化至关重要。

costly.sentenceEn: In other fields, human skill will seem costly and redundant.
costly.translationZh: 在其他领域，人类的技能将显得昂贵且多余。
costly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

costly.sentenceEn: Typically, such screening is done by humans in the lab, which is both costly and slow.
costly.translationZh: 通常情况下，此类筛选由实验室人员手动完成，既昂贵又耗时。
costly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第11句

costly.sentenceEn: Yet for many island inhabitants—some of Bangladesh's poorest—paying for health care is a costly ordeal.
costly.translationZh: 然而对许多岛上居民——其中一些是孟加拉国最贫困的人群——而言，支付医疗费用是一场经济重负。

costly.sentenceEn: In addition to the likely negative long-term impact on sales, this verbal trick sends a message that innovations in farming and food processing are unwelcome, eventually leading to less efficiency, fewer choices for consumers, and ultimately, more costly food products.
costly.translationZh: 除了可能对销售产生长期负面影响外，这种文字游戏还传递出农业和食品加工创新不受欢迎的信号，最终会导致效率降低、消费者选择减少，并且最终会使食品价格上涨。
costly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

costly.sentenceEn: The author came to see how costly college education could be when she was trying to choose a university to attend.
costly.translationZh: 作者在选择大学时才意识到大学教育的费用有多高。

costly.sentenceEn: They can be costly and inefficient.
costly.translationZh: 它们可能成本高昂且效率低下。

cycle.sentenceEn: This will require the Republican Party as a whole to prioritize recruiting women—and not just for one election cycle , but in a sustained way.
cycle.translationZh: 这将要求共和党作为一个整体优先招募女性——而且不仅仅是为了一个选举周期，而是要以持续的方式进行。
cycle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

cycle.sentenceEn: This common behavior can create vicious cycles of detachment even as we try to connect with others.
cycle.translationZh: 这种普遍的行为往往会导致恶性循环，即便是在我们试图与他人建立联系时，也可能会产生疏离感。
cycle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

cycle.sentenceEn: The moon cycle is 29.53 days long on average, so in most months we still end up with a single new moon and a single full one.
cycle.translationZh: 月相周期平均为29.53天，因此在大多数月份中，我们通常仍然只会看到一次新月和一次满月。

cycle.sentenceEn: One is the fact that expressing gratitude encourages others to continue being generous, thus promoting a virtuous cycle of goodness in relationships.
cycle.translationZh: 其一，表达感激之情能鼓励他人继续保持慷慨，从而在人际关系中促成一个良性的善行循环。

cycle.sentenceEn: High-stakes fights over shipwrecks pit archaeologists against treasure hunters in a vicious cycle of accusations.
cycle.translationZh: 围绕沉船的高风险争夺战使考古学家与寻宝者陷入相互指责的恶性循环。

cycle.sentenceEn: "We have been in this cycle of environmental generational amnesia for a long time, where the baseline keeps shifting and we don't even realize what we're losing until it's gone. If we can get people to understand how much meaning and value can come from having more experiences with more wild forms of nature, then maybe we can stop this cycle and move toward conserving and restoring what we have left."
cycle.translationZh: 我们长期处于这种环境代际遗忘的循环中，环境基准不断变化，直到失去后我们才意识到自己究竟失去了什么。如果我们能让人们理解，更多地体验更原始的自然形态能带来多少意义和价值，那么或许我们就能打破这个循环，转而保护和恢复我们所剩的自然环境。

cite.sentenceEn: Though government hospitals are free, many people hesitate to go, citing long commutes, endless lines and questionable diagnoses.
cite.translationZh: 尽管政府医院提供免费医疗服务，但许多人仍犹豫是否前往，他们提到路途遥远、排队漫长以及诊断结果可信度不高等问题。

cite.sentenceEn: Well, the researchers cited a marketing campaign designed to reverse the sales decline of carrots.
cite.translationZh: 研究人员引用了一项旨在扭转胡萝卜销量下滑的营销活动。
cite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

cite.sentenceEn: The AAP doesn't cite positive evidence that infants actually get something out of this kind of "conversation", the way that they clearly do from live social interaction.
cite.translationZh: 美国儿科学会并没有引用确凿证据表明婴儿能从这类“对话”中获得什么，不像他们从真实的社交互动中那样明显有所收获。
cite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

cite.sentenceEn: Edwards cites widespread backlash to the digital recreation of Carrie Fisher as a young Princess Leia in Rogue One, a trick later repeated in the recent Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, which was filmed after Fisher's death in 2016.
cite.translationZh: 爱德华兹提到，在《侠盗一号》中对凯丽·费雪饰演的年轻莱娅公主进行数字重现引发了广泛的反对之声。这一技术后来在近期的《星球大战：天行者崛起》中再次使用，而该片的拍摄是在费雪2016年去世之后进行的。

cite.sentenceEn: But Gigi Luk at Harvard cites at least one brain-imaging study on adolescents that shows similar changes in brain structure when compared with those who are bilingual from birth, even when they didn't begin practicing a second language in earnest before late childhood.
cite.translationZh: 但哈佛大学的吉吉·陆引用了至少一项针对青少年的脑成像研究，该研究显示，即使这些青少年在童年后期才开始认真学习第二语言，他们的大脑结构变化也与那些从出生起就接触双语的人相似。

cite.sentenceEn: What does the author want to show by citing English teacher Jeff Hall's experience?
cite.translationZh: 作者引用英语教师杰夫·霍尔的经历想要说明什么？

clinical.sentenceEn: Two papers published today in the American Journal of Clinical Nutrition outline the case for and against using the concept of ultra-processed foods to help inform dietary guidelines beyond conventional food classification systems.
clinical.translationZh: 今日发表在《美国临床营养学杂志》上的两篇论文，探讨了在传统食品分类系统之外，是否应使用超加工食品概念为膳食指南提供信息的支持与反对观点。
clinical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

clinical.sentenceEn: I myself have been a shop assistant, a waitress, a student, a graduate, and a clinical psychologist.
clinical.translationZh: 我自己曾做过店员、服务员、学生、毕业生，现在是一名临床心理学家。
clinical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

clinical.sentenceEn: Michael Brustein, a clinical psychologist in Manhattan, says when he first began practicing in 2007, he was surprised by how prevalent perfectionism was among his clients, despite how little his graduate training had focused on the phenomenon.
clinical.translationZh: 曼哈顿临床心理学家迈克尔·布鲁斯坦表示，2007年初执业时，他惊讶地发现完美主义在客户中如此普遍，尽管他的研究生培训对此现象关注甚少。

clinical.sentenceEn: These findings help us to further understand some of our clinical trials research findings, where we show that individuals with recurrent depression benefit particularly from self-awareness-based cognitive therapy.
clinical.translationZh: 这些发现有助于我们进一步理解我们的一些临床试验研究结果，其中表明，患有复发性抑郁症的个体特别受益于基于自我觉察的认知疗法。
clinical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

clinical.sentenceEn: A clinical psychologist finds perfectionism is widespread among his clients.
clinical.translationZh: 一位临床心理学家发现完美主义在他的客户中十分普遍。

clinical.sentenceEn: It compels them to visit a clinical psychologist.
clinical.translationZh: 这迫使他们去看临床心理学家。

combat.sentenceEn: To combat this sense of impersonal sameness, travelers are taking advantage of in-home hospitality or Bed and Breakfast arrangements.
combat.translationZh: 为了应对这种千篇一律的疏离感，旅行者们开始选择民宿或提供床位及早餐的家庭旅馆。
combat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

combat.sentenceEn: In the 21st century, the term has evolved to capture the need to combat human-made climate change.
combat.translationZh: 在21世纪，这个术语的含义已经演变，以反映应对人为气候变化的必要性。
combat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

combat.sentenceEn: The space agency was primarily concerned about keeping the air fresh for astronauts cut off in biospheres or space stations and helping to combat "sick building syndrome", which had become a problem due to the super insulated and energy efficient offices of the late 1970s.
combat.translationZh: 航天局最初主要关注的是为与世隔绝的生物圈或空间站中的宇航员保持空气清新，以及帮助解决20世纪70年代末因超隔热、节能办公室而出现的"病态建筑综合症"问题。
combat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

combat.sentenceEn: And here's the problem: if people mistakenly believe that hard work is all that is needed for individuals to make a better life for themselves, they may be less supportive of policies that could actually combat inequality.
combat.translationZh: 问题就出在这里：如果人们错误地认为，仅凭努力工作就能让个人过上更好的生活，他们可能就不会那么支持那些真正能够解决不平等问题的政策。
combat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

combat.sentenceEn: According to the speaker, what can we do to combat unexpected delays?
combat.translationZh: 根据发言者所说，我们可以做些什么来应对意外延误？
对抗细菌对抗生素的耐药性

commission.sentenceEn: The federal government commissioned private wagons to carry the mail.
commission.translationZh: 联邦政府委托私人马车运送邮件。
commission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

commission.sentenceEn: One suggestion from the commission is a network of teacher-led "creativity collaboratives", along the lines of existing maths hubs(中心), with the aim of supporting teaching for creativity through the school curriculum.
commission.translationZh: 该委员会的一项建议是建立由教师主导的“创造力协作组织”网络，仿照现有的数学中心模式，旨在通过学校课程支持创造力教学。
commission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

commission.sentenceEn: This mysterious—but teachable—quality is creativity, the subject of a recently-published report by Durham Commission on Creativity and Education.
commission.translationZh: 这种神秘却可教的特质就是创造力，它也是杜伦创造力与教育委员会近期发布报告的主题。
commission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

commission.sentenceEn: Earlier this year, the EAT-Lancet Commission released its global report on nutrition and called for a global shift to a more plant-based diet and for "substantially reducing consumption of animal source foods."
commission.translationZh: 今年早些时候，EAT-柳叶刀委员会发布了其全球营养报告，呼吁全球转向更加以植物为基础的饮食，并“大幅减少动物源食品的消费”。
commission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

commission.sentenceEn: What would the EAT-Lancet Commission 's report do to many people in countries like India?
commission.translationZh: EAT-柳叶刀委员会的报告会对印度等国的许多人产生什么影响？

commission.sentenceEn: It commissioned private wagons to carry the mail.
commission.translationZh: 联邦政府委托私人马车运送邮件。

compel.sentenceEn: Instead, they should compel us to address our shared issues head-on.
compel.translationZh: 相反，它们应当促使我们正视并解决共同面临的问题。
compel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

compel.sentenceEn: Some employ their persuasive vocabulary and influential communication style to win workplace arguments by compelling people to perform the intended action.
compel.translationZh: 有些人会运用他们富有说服力的词汇和具有影响力的沟通方式，通过迫使他人按其意图行事来赢得职场争论。
compel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

compel.sentenceEn: But thankfully, for those people compelled almost entirely by this specific form of motivation, the news isn't all bad, or bad at all.
compel.translationZh: 但值得庆幸的是，对于那些几乎完全受这种特定动机驱使的人来说，情况并非全是坏事，甚至可以说一点也不坏。
compel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

compel.sentenceEn: On the contrary, compelling tourists to make a financial contribution to the places they visit beyond their personal consumption should be part of a wider cultural shift.
compel.translationZh: 相反，促使游客在个人消费之外，为其到访的地方做出经济贡献，应当成为更广泛文化转变的一部分。
compel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

compel.sentenceEn: The demand for energy resources may compel renegotiation of Antarctica's treaties before their expiration.
compel.translationZh: 对能源资源的需求可能迫使人们在南极洲条约到期前重新谈判。

compel.sentenceEn: It is compelled to address its historical social issues.
compel.translationZh: 它被迫去解决自身历史遗留的社会问题。

competitor.sentenceEn: It could charge a profitable markup by offering just a bit more technical equipment and professional service than competitors .
competitor.translationZh: 通过仅提供比竞争对手稍多一些的技术设备和专业服务，它就能收取可观的加价。
competitor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第15段，第4句

competitor.sentenceEn: Competitors introduce new products, economy might enter a recession, customer preferences differ over time, and more.
competitor.translationZh: 竞争对手推出新产品，经济可能陷入衰退，客户偏好也会随着时间推移而变化，诸如此类。
competitor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

competitor.sentenceEn: Farmland species perform valuable ecosystem services, by preying on insects that are our competitors for crops.
competitor.translationZh: 农田蜘蛛物种通过捕食那些与我们争夺农作物的昆虫，提供着宝贵的生态系统服务。
competitor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

competitor.sentenceEn: "Growing economic power, growing influence on local markets all over the world, and a growing concern of competitors and consumers altogether have made it happen now."
competitor.translationZh: 日益增强的经济实力、对全球各地本地市场日益扩大的影响力，以及竞争对手和消费者与日俱增的担忧，共同促成了当前局面的形成。
competitor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

competitor.sentenceEn: As the soft drink gained in popularity, it faced a growing number of competitors —counterfeits even trying to copy Coke's logo.
competitor.translationZh: 随着这款软饮日益流行，它面临的竞争对手也越来越多——甚至出现了仿冒品试图复制可口可乐的标志。
competitor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

competitor.sentenceEn: They use effective tactics to defeat their competitors .
competitor.translationZh: 他们运用有效的战术击败对手。

convert.sentenceEn: This included emissions from fertilizer production, converting land from forests to pastures, growing feed, and direct emissions from animals (manure as well as expelling of gas from the stomach) from birth to death.
convert.translationZh: 这包括化肥生产的排放、将森林土地转为牧场的排放、饲料种植的排放，以及动物从出生到死亡期间的直接排放（包括粪便和肠胃排气）。

convert.sentenceEn: I'm a late convert to the idea of tiny colleges, and I fully understand the need for many diverse types of educational institutions.
convert.translationZh: 我是后来才转而支持小型学院理念的，并且我完全理解多样化教育机构存在的必要性。

convert.sentenceEn: If the farm is well managed and has enough land, and the desire to convert is sincere, a relationship can begin.
convert.translationZh: 如果农场管理得当，拥有足够的土地，并且转型的意愿真诚，双方就可以开始建立合作关系。

convert.sentenceEn: Another grass-fed booster spurring farmers to convert is EPIC, which makes meat-based protein bars.
convert.translationZh: 另一个推动农民转型的草饲倡导者是EPIC，这家公司生产肉类蛋白棒。

convert.sentenceEn: Joseph has learned that a farmer has to have a certain mindset to successfully convert .
convert.translationZh: 约瑟夫认识到，农民要成功转型，必须具备特定的思维模式。

convert.sentenceEn: They have trouble converting face datasets into the right format.
convert.translationZh: 他们难以将人脸数据集转换为正确格式。

convey.sentenceEn: The deed read, "W. H. Jackson for and in consideration of the great affection which he bears the said tree, and his great desire to see it protected has conveyed unto the said oak tree entire possession of itself and of all land within eight feet of it on all sides."
convey.translationZh: 地契上写道：'W·H·杰克逊出于对上述橡树的深厚感情，以及他渴望看到其得到保护的强烈愿望，特将该橡树本身及其四周各八英尺范围内所有土地的完整所有权，转让给上述橡树。'

convey.sentenceEn: Our brains respond to language expressing facts differently than they do to words conveying possibility, scientists at New York University have recently found.
convey.translationZh: 纽约大学的科学家最近发现，我们的大脑对表达事实的语言和传达可能性的词语会做出不同的反应。
convey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

convey.sentenceEn: As well as being on trend, and with a much better ring to it than synthetic leather, the vegan label does convey an important extra distinction.
convey.translationZh: 除了紧跟潮流，而且比“合成皮革”这个说法听起来悦耳得多之外，“纯素”标签还传达了一个重要的额外含义。
convey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

convey.sentenceEn: Lastly, have a good idea of what your role will be and try and convey the idea that you're flexible.
convey.translationZh: 最后，要清楚了解你应聘岗位的职责，并努力传达你具备灵活性的特质。
convey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

convey.sentenceEn: What message does the author try to convey at the end of the passage?
convey.translationZh: 作者在文章结尾试图传达什么信息？

convey.sentenceEn: Try to understand what messages they convey .
convey.translationZh: 尝试理解它们试图传递的信息。

criticism.sentenceEn: This criticism may ultimately discourage people from doing good deeds.
criticism.translationZh: 这种批评最终可能会阻碍人们行善。
criticism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

criticism.sentenceEn: The second is that the criticism will, theoretically, help the organization I'm leaving to improve, making sure employees of the future are less likely to encounter what I did?
criticism.translationZh: 第二个是，理论上这些批评会帮助我即将离开的这家公司改进，确保未来的员工不太可能遇到我所经历的问题？
criticism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

criticism.sentenceEn: But criticism over the original state of the building is likely to intensify over coming days.
criticism.translationZh: 但在未来几天，关于这座建筑原本状况的批评可能会愈演愈烈。

criticism.sentenceEn: The news was met with excitement by those keen to see Dean digitally brought back to life for only his fourth film, but it also drew sharp criticism .
criticism.translationZh: 这一消息让那些渴望看到迪恩通过数字技术复活、出演他仅有的第四部电影的人们兴奋不已，但也招致了尖锐批评。

criticism.sentenceEn: What is one of the criticisms directed at the early research on solitude?
criticism.translationZh: 针对早期独处研究的批评意见之一是什么？

criticism.sentenceEn: It has met much criticism from environmentalists.
criticism.translationZh: 它遭到了环保主义者的诸多批评。

characterize.sentenceEn: It is a bond characterized by cooperative practices and strengthened by the concern for the well-being of others or the common good.
characterize.translationZh: 这是一种以合作实践为特征，并通过对他人的福祉或共同利益的关怀而得以加强的关系纽带。
characterize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第8句

characterize.sentenceEn: Broadly speaking, a community in which people feel grateful to one another is likely to be a more pleasant place to live than one characterized by mutual suspicion and resentment.
characterize.translationZh: 广义而言，一个人们彼此心怀感激的社区，很可能比一个充满相互猜疑与怨恨的社区更适宜居住。

characterize.sentenceEn: It is characterized by two main attributes: not being satisfied by eating, and having a desire to stay sedentary(久坐不动的).
characterize.translationZh: 这种现象有两个主要特征：进食无法带来满足感，以及渴望久坐不动。
characterize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

characterize.sentenceEn: As a result, a wild imagination has characterized the history of our species.
characterize.translationZh: 因此，狂野的想象力成为了我们人类物种历史的鲜明特征。
characterize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

characterize.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the "natural world" characterized by Thomas Hobbes?
characterize.translationZh: 关于托马斯·霍布斯所描述的“自然世界”，我们能了解到什么？

cigarette.sentenceEn: Investigative reporter Michael Moss says processed food is engineered to hook you, not unlike alcohol, cigarettes , or other harmful substances.
cigarette.translationZh: 调查记者迈克尔·莫斯表示，加工食品经过精心设计，旨在让你上钩，这与酒精、香烟或其他有害物质并无二致。
cigarette.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

cigarette.sentenceEn: A man required medical attention after he applied a lighted cigarette to a bear's nose.
cigarette.translationZh: 一名男子将点燃的香烟凑到熊鼻子上后，不得不接受医疗救治。
cigarette.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

cigarette.sentenceEn: The Wallaces didn't accept advertising in the US edition until 1955 and even then they didn't allow any ads for cigarettes , liquor or drugs.
cigarette.translationZh: 华莱士夫妇直到1955年才开始在美国版杂志上接受广告，即便如此，他们也不允许刊登任何香烟、酒类或药品广告。
cigarette.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

cigarette.sentenceEn: Our phones are like cigarettes —something to do when we're anxious, bored or when our fingers need something to toy with.
cigarette.translationZh: 我们的手机就像香烟——当我们焦虑、无聊，或者手指需要摆弄点什么的时候，它就派上用场了。

cigarette.sentenceEn: In what way does Michael Moss think processed food is comparable to alcohol and cigarettes ?
cigarette.translationZh: 迈克尔·莫斯认为加工食品在哪些方面可与酒精和香烟相提并论？

cigarette.sentenceEn: It has little to do with the quality or taste of cigarettes .
cigarette.translationZh: 这与香烟的品质或口味几乎毫无关系。

circumstance.sentenceEn: One such circumstance always comes back to me.
circumstance.translationZh: 我总会想起其中一个场景。
circumstance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

circumstance.sentenceEn: While you may be able to influence other people and various circumstances , you can't force them to change or go your way.
circumstance.translationZh: 虽然你或许能够影响他人和各种环境，但你无法强迫他们做出改变或完全顺从你的意愿。

circumstance.sentenceEn: The third one to avoid is using the same strategies in different circumstances .
circumstance.translationZh: 第三点需要避免的是在不同情况下使用相同的策略。

circumstance.sentenceEn: And yet, robbed of the engagement with our neighbors and with our local communities that our ancestors were forced into by circumstance , we feel ourselves to be more and more independent of one another.
circumstance.translationZh: 然而，当我们不再像先辈那样因环境所迫而必须与邻里和当地社区紧密交往时，我们却感觉彼此间的独立性越来越强了。

circumstance.sentenceEn: Under what circumstances do people tend to lie?
circumstance.translationZh: 人们在什么情况下容易撒谎？

circumstance.sentenceEn: They persist even when circumstances have changed.
circumstance.translationZh: 即便情况已经发生变化，刻板印象依然存在。

civil.sentenceEn: When shrinking municipal budgets combine with the nonstop technological revolution, public library services that focus on building communities face-to-face, inspiring and educating patrons about art, literature, and music, and helping patrons engage in civil discourse can seem old-fashioned.
civil.translationZh: 当不断缩减的市政预算遇上永不停歇的技术革命，那些专注于面对面社区建设、启发和教育读者了解艺术、文学和音乐，以及帮助读者参与公民对话的公共图书馆服务，似乎显得有些过时了。

civil.sentenceEn: The decline of civil discourse stems in part from the fact that it is so easy for people to watch news about, buy products from, and engage—in both the virtual and real worlds—only with those of similar backgrounds and ideologies.
civil.translationZh: 公民话语的衰落，部分源于人们可以轻易地只关注与自己背景和意识形态相似者的新闻、购买他们的产品，并在虚拟和现实世界中仅与这类人互动。

civil.sentenceEn: By both actively promoting civil discourse through these programs, and modeling and upholding the principles of free inquiry and expression for all, libraries help individuals rediscover the importance of and increased need for civil discourse in American life.
civil.translationZh: 图书馆通过这些项目积极促进文明对话，并为所有人树立和坚持自由探究与表达的原则，帮助个人重新认识到文明对话在美国生活中的重要性和日益增长的必要性。

civil.sentenceEn: The ongoing conservative civil war often degenerates into content-free tribal warfare, but trade is a rare exception.
civil.translationZh: 持续不断的保守派内战常常演变成缺乏实质内容的派系之争，但贸易问题却是一个罕见的例外。

civil.sentenceEn: Why does the author mention the Spanish Civil War at the beginning of the passage?
civil.translationZh: 作者为何在文章开头提及西班牙内战？

civil.sentenceEn: He mainly wrote about historical subjects such as the Civil War.
civil.translationZh: 他主要撰写关于内战等历史题材的作品。

cognition.sentenceEn: A recent study exploring aesthetic taste was published in Cognition .
cognition.translationZh: 一项探索审美趣味的最新研究发表在《认知》期刊上。
cognition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

cognition.sentenceEn: Lea and a colleague examined more than 300 studies of dog cognition , comparing the studies' results with those from research into other animals.
cognition.translationZh: 利娅和一位同事对300多项犬类认知研究进行了分析，并将这些研究结果与针对其他动物的研究结果进行了比较。
cognition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

cognition.sentenceEn: Though a significant body of research has examined dog cognition previously, the authors of this new study found little to warrant the volume of work that has been devoted to the topic.
cognition.translationZh: 尽管此前已有大量研究探讨过狗的认知能力，但这项新研究的作者发现，这些研究投入的工作量与研究价值并不相称。
cognition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

cognition.sentenceEn: Zachary Silver, an American researcher, believes the authors of the new study overstated the idea that an excessive amount of research has been devoted to dogs, as the field of dog cognition is young, and there is much to be learned about how dogs think.
cognition.translationZh: 美国研究员扎卡里·西尔弗认为，这项新研究的作者夸大了“过多研究都投入到狗身上”这一观点，因为狗认知研究领域尚处于起步阶段，关于狗的思维方式还有很多有待探索。
cognition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

cognition.sentenceEn: What view of many dog owners win support from researchers studying dog cognition ?
cognition.translationZh: 许多狗主人的什么观点得到了研究狗认知的研究人员的支持？

cognition.sentenceEn: Dogs have the cognition for telling right from wrong.
cognition.translationZh: 狗具有分辨是非的认知能力。

concentrate.sentenceEn: It's a way of concentrating their mind to only focus on the aspects that they need to be working on at the moment, to kind of rid themselves of distractions.
concentrate.translationZh: 这是一种集中注意力的方法，让他们只专注于此刻需要处理的事务，从而摆脱各种干扰。
concentrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

concentrate.sentenceEn: And of those physicians, many are concentrated in cities: 70% of the country's population live in rural areas, yet less than 20% of health workers practice there.
concentrate.translationZh: 而在这些医生中，许多人都集中在城市：全国70%的人口居住在农村地区，但在那里执业的卫生工作者却不到20%。

concentrate.sentenceEn: Among these children, Schneider has found that those who were enthusiastic about music and who practiced voluntarily showed improvements in hearing ability, as well as in more general competencies, such as the ability to concentrate .
concentrate.translationZh: 在这些儿童中，施耐德发现那些对音乐充满热情且自愿练习的孩子，其听力能力有所提高，同时在更广泛的能力方面也表现出进步，例如专注力。

concentrate.sentenceEn: It's just that suddenly at university you are expected to behave like an adult, that means concentrating on the direction of your life in general and your own academic performance specifically.
concentrate.translationZh: 只是到了大学，你会突然被期望表现得像个成年人，这意味着你要总体关注自己的人生方向，同时也要具体专注于自己的学业表现。
concentrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

concentrate.sentenceEn: Bilingual speakers often do better than monolinguals in completing certain tasks because they can concentrate better on what they are doing.
concentrate.translationZh: 双语者在完成某些任务时往往比单语者表现更好，因为他们能更好地专注于正在做的事情。

concentrate.sentenceEn: It concentrates our mind on our personal feelings, happy or scary.
concentrate.translationZh: 它使我们全神贯注于个人的情感，无论是快乐还是恐惧。

confirm.sentenceEn: It's most appropriate to discuss a disability when they reply to confirm an interview.
confirm.translationZh: 最适合谈论残疾问题的时机是在回复确认面试的时候。
confirm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

confirm.sentenceEn: Nicola Sturgeon's speech last Tuesday setting out the Scottish government's legislative programme for the year ahead confirmed what was already pretty clear.
confirm.translationZh: 尼古拉·斯特金上周二发表的阐述苏格兰政府来年立法计划的演讲，证实了一些早已相当明确的事情。
confirm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

confirm.sentenceEn: That study failed to confirm Schellenberg's findings, producing no evidence that music lessons improved math and literacy skills.
confirm.translationZh: 该研究未能证实舍伦贝格的发现，没有证据表明音乐课能提高数学和读写能力。

confirm.sentenceEn: In follow-up interviews this was confirmed numerous times as woman after woman indicated that "being there when needed was taken for granted."
confirm.translationZh: 在后续访谈中，这一点得到了多次证实，一位又一位女性表示，“在需要时朋友会在身边，这是理所当然的事。”
confirm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

confirm.sentenceEn: Scholars sought to refine his theory and empirically confirm his views.
confirm.translationZh: 学者们试图完善他的理论并用实证方法证实他的观点。

confirm.sentenceEn: This finding was already confirmed by the most prestigious scientists in the world.
confirm.translationZh: 这一发现已得到世界上最权威科学家的证实。

criticize.sentenceEn: Instead of deliberating and criticizing yourself, focus instead on what you can learn from this situation.
criticize.translationZh: 与其反复纠结并自我批评，不如将注意力转向你能从这种情况中学到什么。

criticize.sentenceEn: A person living with an other-oriented perfectionist might feel criticized by the perfectionist spouse for not doing household chores exactly the "right" way.
criticize.translationZh: 与具有他人导向型完美主义倾向的人共同生活的人，可能会因为家务没有完全按照“正确”方式完成而受到这位完美主义伴侣的批评。

criticize.sentenceEn: He believes archaeologists need to do a better job themselves instead of routinely criticizing treasure hunters.
criticize.translationZh: 他认为考古学家自身需要做得更好，而不是一味批评寻宝者。

criticize.sentenceEn: A few weeks ago, a well-meaning professor tried to explain the physiological process behind viruses and the human body in a tweet and was immediately criticized for a mistake in his information.
criticize.translationZh: 几周前，一位善意的教授试图在推特上解释病毒与人体背后的生理过程，却因信息有误而立即受到批评。
criticize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

criticize.sentenceEn: But sometimes, the good guys also get punished or criticized , specifically because they are so good.
criticize.translationZh: 但有时候，好人也会受到惩罚或批评，而这恰恰是因为他们太好了。
criticize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

criticize.sentenceEn: Why has the Oscars ceremony been criticized ?
criticize.translationZh: 奥斯卡颁奖典礼为何受到批评？

crowded.sentenceEn: While the researchers focus primarily on the difficulties that these disorderly, crowded memories may pose, they also highlight a few situations in which these same memory patterns may be useful.
crowded.translationZh: 虽然研究人员主要关注这些混乱、碎片化的记忆可能带来的困难，但他们也强调了在某些情况下，这些相同的记忆模式可能是有用的。
crowded.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

crowded.sentenceEn: We need to build an effective high-speed commuting system linking the high-priced and crowded Bay Area with the low-priced and low-density Central Valley.
crowded.translationZh: 我们需要建立一个高效的高速通勤系统，将房价高昂且拥挤的湾区与房价低廉且人口密度低的中央谷地连接起来。

crowded.sentenceEn: W: I'm going to sound like an idiot, because I used to complain to you all the time about how crowded our dormitory room was, and about all the things they did to irritate me, like watching movies late at night without headphones, or talking loudly early in the morning.
crowded.translationZh: 女：说出来可能有点傻，因为我以前总是跟你抱怨宿舍有多挤，抱怨她们那些让我抓狂的事，比如晚上不戴耳机看电影到很晚，或者大清早大声说话。
crowded.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

crowded.sentenceEn: In his book, A Whole New Life, novelist Reynolds Price recalls that his doctors chose a crowded hallway as the place to tell him he might have a tumor on his spinal cord.
crowded.translationZh: 小说家雷诺兹·普赖斯在其著作《全新人生》中回忆道，他的医生们选择在一条拥挤的走廊里告诉他，他的脊髓上可能长了肿瘤。
crowded.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

crowded.sentenceEn: On a chilly December afternoon, Wardian wove through Washington's crowded sidewalks on the way home from his full-time job as an international ship broker.
crowded.translationZh: 十二月一个寒冷的下午，沃迪安结束了他作为国际船舶经纪人的全职工作，在华盛顿拥挤的人行道中穿梭着回家。

crowded.sentenceEn: They frequently suffer from disorderly crowded memories.
crowded.translationZh: 他们常常受混乱而繁多的记忆困扰。

calculate.sentenceEn: Calculate transit time between activities and then add 10 to 30 minutes for unexpected delays.
calculate.translationZh: 计算各项活动之间的交通时间，然后额外预留10到30分钟以应对意外延误。
calculate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

calculate.sentenceEn: The researchers also calculated the clean air delivery rate for plants in the studies they analyzed and found that the rate at which plants disperse the compounds was well below the usual rate of air exchange in a normal building, caused by the movement of people coming and going, opening doors and windows.
calculate.translationZh: 研究人员还计算了他们所分析研究中植物的洁净空气输送率，发现植物驱散化合物的速率远低于普通建筑物中通常的空气交换率，后者是由人员往来、门窗开关等活动引起的。
calculate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

calculate.sentenceEn: It is incredibly difficult to calculate how much dead stock currently goes to waste.
calculate.translationZh: 目前究竟有多少积压库存被白白浪费，这一数字极难计算。

calculate.sentenceEn: He'll never calculate faster, never drive better, or even fly more safely.
calculate.translationZh: 他永远不会计算得更快，不会驾驶得更好，甚至也不会飞得更安全。
calculate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

calculate.sentenceEn: Such courses, Hacker argues, are a remedy for the numerical illiteracy of adults who have completed high-level math like algebra but are unable to calculate the price of, say, a carpet by area.
calculate.translationZh: 哈克认为，这类课程能够解决成年人的数学盲问题——这些人虽然学完了代数等高等数学课程，却连计算地毯面积价格这类问题都做不到。
calculate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

calculate.sentenceEn: The International Monetary Fund calculates that countries can generate substantial fiscal revenues by eliminating fossil fuel subsidies and levying carbon charges that capture the domestic damage caused by emissions.
calculate.translationZh: 国际货币基金组织测算，各国可通过取消化石燃料补贴并征收能反映排放造成的国内损害的碳费用，来获得可观的财政收入。

catastrophe.sentenceEn: Like many, Charlene experiences climate anxiety—a chronic fear of a climate catastrophe —and was, at the time, looking for an outlet.
catastrophe.translationZh: 和许多人一样，夏琳患有气候焦虑症——一种对气候灾难的长期恐惧——并且当时正在寻找一个宣泄的途径。
catastrophe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

catastrophe.sentenceEn: This is no wonder, when the news focuses on reporting catastrophes , terrorist attacks, wars, and famines.
catastrophe.translationZh: 这不足为奇，因为新闻总是聚焦于报道灾难、恐怖袭击、战争和饥荒。
catastrophe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

catastrophe.sentenceEn: M: Well, it's not a catastrophe .
catastrophe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

catastrophe.sentenceEn: Jean-Michel Leniaud, the president of the scientific council at the National Heritage Institute, said: "What happened was bound to happen. The lack of adequate maintenance and daily attention to such a majestic building is the cause of this catastrophe ."
catastrophe.translationZh: 国家遗产研究所科学委员会主席让-米歇尔·勒尼奥表示：“所发生的一切是必然的。对这样一座宏伟建筑缺乏足够的维护和日常关注是这场灾难的原因。”

catastrophe.sentenceEn: News of the Notre Dame Cathedral catastrophe instantly caught media attention throughout the world.
catastrophe.translationZh: 巴黎圣母院的灾难新闻立即引起了全球媒体的关注。

catastrophe.sentenceEn: The news focuses on reporting catastrophes that occur across the world.
catastrophe.translationZh: 新闻侧重于报道世界各地发生的灾难。

cater.sentenceEn: I was thinking of having it cater to high-end consumers in large cities.
cater.translationZh: 我当时在考虑将其定位为面向大城市高端消费者的产品。
cater.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第15段，第3句

cater.sentenceEn: By sanctioning this watered-down version of college, universities are " catering to the social and educational needs of wealthy students at the expense of others" who won't enjoy the financial backing or social connections of richer students once they graduate.
cater.translationZh: 通过认可这种"缩水版"的大学教育，高校正在"迎合富裕学生的社交和教育需求，却牺牲了其他学生的利益"——这些学生毕业后将无法享有富裕学生所拥有的经济支持或社会关系。
cater.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

cater.sentenceEn: Plus, we live in a culture that caters to the late-nighter, from 24-hour grocery stores to online shopping sites that never close.
cater.translationZh: 此外，我们生活在一种迎合熬夜者的文化中——从24小时营业的杂货店到永不关门的在线购物网站。
cater.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

cater.sentenceEn: Fondness for human warmth in catering to customers will give hope to employees who are afraid of losing jobs to robots.
cater.translationZh: 在服务客户时对人情味的青睐，将为那些担心被机器人取代的员工带来希望。

cater.sentenceEn: It caters to students and teachers.

charity.sentenceEn: Once that happens, the bags are donated to charity , sold at auction, or purchased by a company which sells them to the public.
charity.translationZh: 一旦发生这种情况，这些包会被捐赠给慈善机构，或通过拍卖售出，抑或由某家公司收购后再向公众出售。
charity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

charity.sentenceEn: Although many cultures are moving towards more liberal, less hierarchical organizations, the new research suggests that traditional power structures and basic values of charity and brotherhood are the cornerstones of successful societies.
charity.translationZh: 尽管许多文化正朝着更加自由、层级更少的组织形式发展，但新研究表明，传统权力结构以及慈善与友爱等基本价值观才是成功社会的基石。
charity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

charity.sentenceEn: I will group together all those arguments that place a moral requirement on people to give to charity , despite the fact that there is wide disagreement as to the extent of that moral requirement.
charity.translationZh: 我将把所有认为人们在道德上有义务向慈善机构捐款的论点归为一类，尽管对于这种道德义务的程度存在广泛分歧。
charity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

charity.sentenceEn: These are the central problems to questions of charity though charity also includes many other areas such as assisting the elderly.
charity.translationZh: 这些是慈善问题的核心，但慈善也包括许多其他领域，如帮助老年人。
charity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

charity.sentenceEn: Why did Audrey Hepburn devote much of her life to charity after her acting career?
charity.translationZh: 奥黛丽·赫本在演艺生涯结束后为什么要将她生命中的大部分时间投入到慈善事业中？

charity.sentenceEn: They are regularly donated to charity organizations.
charity.translationZh: 这些钱通常会捐赠给慈善机构。

classic.sentenceEn: For decades, B&Bs have been the classic way to visit Europe, especially the British Isles.
classic.translationZh: 几十年来，入住 B&B 旅馆一直是游览欧洲（尤其是英伦三岛）的经典方式。
classic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

classic.sentenceEn: She says certain " classics concerts" dedicated to the old masters will always exist, but not every program has to feature Beethoven and Brahms—or even a stage and seats.
classic.translationZh: 她说，某些致敬古典大师的"经典音乐会"将永远存在，但并非每场演出都必须以贝多芬和勃拉姆斯为特色——甚至不一定非要有舞台和座椅。

classic.sentenceEn: Psychologists have been battling charges that they don't do "real" science for some time—in large part because many findings from classic experiments have proved unreproducible.
classic.translationZh: 长期以来，心理学家一直面临着他们从事的不是'真正的'科学的指责——这在很大程度上是因为许多经典实验的结果被证明无法重复。

classic.sentenceEn: Now, I never worry about what I'm wearing in the morning even if I do get a bit tired of just wearing the same classic pieces.
classic.translationZh: 现在，我早上再也不用为穿什么而烦恼了，即便我确实对一直穿这些经典款有些厌倦。
classic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

classic.sentenceEn: It is a bitterly ironic thing to learn on the 20th anniversary of Whiten's classic study.
classic.translationZh: 在怀滕这项经典研究迎来20周年之际了解到这一点，真是极具讽刺意味。
classic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

classic.sentenceEn: They have been the classic way to visit Europe.
classic.translationZh: 这一直是游览欧洲的经典方式。

committee.sentenceEn: Students chair both the admissions and the curriculum committees .
committee.translationZh: 招生委员会和课程委员会均由学生担任主席。

committee.sentenceEn: Furthermore, ethics committees should make it mandatory for researchers to share their results with the public.
committee.translationZh: 此外，伦理委员会应强制要求研究人员向公众分享其研究成果。
committee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

committee.sentenceEn: All of these points and more showed up in the Dietary Guidelines Advisory Committee's scientific report, released last February.
committee.translationZh: 所有这些观点以及更多内容都出现在去年2月发布的膳食指南咨询委员会的科学报告中。
committee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

committee.sentenceEn: "I can't imagine if there's any other acting job in the world where you don't know what show you're in, when you're hired," says voice actor Keythe Farley, who chairs the SAG-AFTRA negotiating committee .
committee.translationZh: “我无法想象，世界上还有哪种表演工作是在你被聘用时，却不知道自己要参演什么作品的。”美国演员工会-美国广播电视艺人联合会谈判委员会主席、配音演员基思·法利说道。
committee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

committee.sentenceEn: "It's a very small number of games that would trigger this secondary compensation issue," said voice actor Crispin Freeman, who's a member of the union's negotiating committee .
committee.translationZh: 工会谈判委员会成员、配音演员克里斯平·弗里曼表示：“能够触发这种追加酬金机制的游戏数量其实非常少。”
committee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

committee.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the Dietary Guidelines Advisory Committee 's scientific report?
committee.translationZh: 我们从膳食指南咨询委员会的科学报告中了解到什么？

comprehensive.sentenceEn: The problem was that analysts from the FAO used a comprehensive life-cycle assessment to study the climate impact of livestock, but a different method when they analyzed transportation.
comprehensive.translationZh: 问题在于，联合国粮农组织(FAO)的分析师在研究畜牧业对气候的影响时使用了全面的生命周期评估方法，而在分析交通运输时却采用了另一种不同的方法。

comprehensive.sentenceEn: Bags with no destination code or identification tag are shipped to a central warehouse, and undergo a comprehensive baggage tracing process over the next 90 days.
comprehensive.translationZh: 没有目的地代码或识别标签的行李将被运往中心仓库，并在接下来的 90 天内接受全面的行李追踪程序。
comprehensive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

comprehensive.sentenceEn: Drawing from around 200 papers to compile their comprehensive list, Mroz and his team may now hold a remedy to the largely undefined problem of MRS.
comprehensive.translationZh: 通过参考约200篇论文来编制这份全面清单，Mroz及其团队如今可能掌握了解决MRS这一界定尚不明确问题的方法。

comprehensive.sentenceEn: The study published in Current Anthropology is the largest and most comprehensive and widespread survey of morals ever conducted and aimed to find out whether different societies had different versions of morality.
comprehensive.translationZh: 发表在《当代人类学》上的这项研究是迄今为止规模最大、最全面且最广泛的道德观念调查，旨在探究不同社会是否存在不同版本的道德体系。
comprehensive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

comprehensive.sentenceEn: Gathering data, unearthing and meticulously preserving and examining finds, verifying identity and origin, piecing together the larger story, and writing and publishing a comprehensive paper or book can take decades.
comprehensive.translationZh: 收集数据、发掘并精心保存和检查发现物、验证其身份和来源、拼凑完整的历史故事，以及撰写并发表一篇全面的论文或书籍，这整个过程可能需要数十年时间。

concede.sentenceEn: The authors of the study concede that some might interpret the study's findings to mean that they can delay starting an exercise program but this would be a mistake.
concede.translationZh: 研究报告的作者们承认，有些人可能会将研究结果解读为可以推迟开始锻炼计划，但这种观点是错误的。
concede.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

concede.sentenceEn: The researchers concede that this research was about changes to mostly moderate beliefs—it's likely the findings would be different in the context of changes to extreme or deeply held beliefs.
concede.translationZh: 研究人员承认，这项研究主要关注的是对中度信念的改变——如果研究对象是极端或根深蒂固的信念变化，结果很可能会有所不同。
concede.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

concede.sentenceEn: But those researchers concede that's probably in the distant future.
concede.translationZh: 但这些研究人员承认，这很可能还是遥远的未来。
concede.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

concede.sentenceEn: The authors of the paper concede that research on the subject isn't complete, but they argue that their work supports the value of a college education.
concede.translationZh: 该论文的作者承认，关于这一课题的研究尚未完成，但他们认为自己的研究支持大学教育的价值。
concede.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

concede.sentenceEn: What did the researchers concede concerning their findings?
concede.translationZh: 研究人员对他们的发现做出了什么让步？

concede.sentenceEn: Concede the advice is perfectly reasonable.
concede.translationZh: 承认这些建议是完全合理的。

confusion.sentenceEn: But the science teacher, he said, wouldn't have known about the confusion on her own.
confusion.translationZh: 但他说，那位科学老师自己本不会察觉到这种困惑。
confusion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

confusion.sentenceEn: Doing a poor job communicating science to the public will only create confusion and widen the gap between science and society, a gap that scientists are trying to close.
confusion.translationZh: 向公众传播科学时表现不佳，只会造成混乱并扩大科学与社会之间的鸿沟——这正是科学家们正努力弥合的鸿沟。
confusion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

confusion.sentenceEn: It is text that enables us to "uncover lies, confusions and overgeneralizations, and to detect abuses of logic and common sense. It also means to weigh ideas, to compare and contrast assertions, to connect one generalization to another."
confusion.translationZh: 正是文字使我们能够“揭露谎言、澄清混乱、识别过度概括，并察觉逻辑与常识的滥用。文字还能让我们权衡观点、比较对照不同论断、并将各种概括关联起来。”
confusion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

confusion.sentenceEn: Piaget not only believed that children were "egocentric" in the sense that they were unable to differentiate between their own viewpoint and that of others; he was also convinced that their thinking was characterized by systematic errors and confusions .
confusion.translationZh: 皮亚杰不仅认为儿童是'自我中心的'——即他们无法区分自己与他人的观点；他还坚信，儿童的思维具有系统性错误和混乱的特征。

confusion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

confusion.sentenceEn: Science teachers will hardly know the confusion they create without a performance appraisal.
confusion.translationZh: 如果没有绩效考核，科学教师们很难意识到自己造成了怎样的困惑。

constraint.sentenceEn: With constraints , you dedicate your mental energy to acting more resourcefully.
constraint.translationZh: 在限制条件下，你会投入脑力，更具创造性地行动。
constraint.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

constraint.sentenceEn: Believe it or not, human creativity benefits from constraints .
constraint.translationZh: 信不信由你，人类的创造力反而会从约束中受益。
constraint.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

constraint.sentenceEn: Marissa Mayer, former vice president for search products and user experience at Google, once wrote in a publication on Bloomberg, " Constraints shape and focus problems and provide clear challenges to overcome; Creativity thrives best when constrained."
constraint.translationZh: 谷歌前搜索产品与用户体验副总裁玛丽莎·梅耶尔曾在彭博社的一篇文章中写道：“约束塑造并聚焦问题，提供明确的挑战去克服；创造力在受约束时才能蓬勃发展。”
constraint.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

constraint.sentenceEn: Consistent constraints help you improve at connecting unrelated ideas and concepts.
constraint.translationZh: 始终如一的限制有助于你提高将不相关的想法和概念联系起来的能力。
constraint.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

constraint.sentenceEn: Even with constraints , it is possible for some creative developers to take the CubeSat technology in directions that result in harmful outcomes.
constraint.translationZh: 即使存在限制，一些富有创造力的开发者仍有可能将立方体卫星技术引向导致有害结果的方向。

constraint.sentenceEn: They begin to think of the benefits of constraints .
constraint.translationZh: 他们开始思考限制条件带来的好处。

contemporary.sentenceEn: One of the challenges of practicing mindfulness in our contemporary world is that there has been a profound transformation in human attention.
contemporary.translationZh: 在当今世界练习正念所面临的挑战之一，是人类的注意力已经发生了深刻的转变。
contemporary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

contemporary.sentenceEn: It is also one with which contemporary psychology and medicine are just beginning to catch up.
contemporary.translationZh: 这也是当代心理学和医学才刚刚开始理解的一种智慧。

contemporary.sentenceEn: Whatever it is, you cannot but recognize the effect competition is exerting in academics and many other areas of contemporary life.
contemporary.translationZh: 无论竞争是后天习得的还是人类行为中的遗传因素，你都不得不承认它在学术界和当代生活的诸多其他领域所产生的影响。
contemporary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

contemporary.sentenceEn: "I don't think there's anything wrong with an audience showing their enthusiasm for a proper moment by applauding, showing their joy," Greenberg said, noting that the stuffiness in concert halls is "one aspect of contemporary concert etiquette" he doesn't understand.
contemporary.translationZh: 格林伯格说：“我认为观众在适当的时候通过鼓掌来表达热情和喜悦并没有什么不妥。”他指出，音乐厅里的这种刻板拘谨是“当代音乐会礼仪中”他无法理解的一个方面。

contemporary.sentenceEn: What does the author think is easy to see in many areas of contemporary life?
contemporary.translationZh: 作者认为在当代生活的许多领域中什么是显而易见的？

contemporary.sentenceEn: Modest students are generally more attentive than their contemporaries .
contemporary.translationZh: 谦逊的学生通常比同龄人更专注。

convenience.sentenceEn: However, what people save in convenience , they lose in cash.
convenience.translationZh: 然而，人们在省去麻烦的同时，却在金钱上蒙受了损失。
convenience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第12句

convenience.sentenceEn: Have we been conditioned to accept a world governed by "smart" tech, trading convenience to the point where we become a bit like machines ourselves?
convenience.translationZh: 我们是否已经被训练去接受一个由“智能”技术统治的世界，并为了追求便利，甚至在某种程度上将自己也变得像机器一样？
convenience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

convenience.sentenceEn: Now that more and more people care about what they put in their bodies and are wanting to eat healthier, these companies are finding it really difficult to meet that new demand because of their own addiction to making these convenience foods.
convenience.translationZh: 如今，越来越多的人开始关注自己摄入体内的食物，并希望吃得更健康。然而，由于这些公司自身已对生产这些 convenience foods（方便食品）上瘾，他们发现很难满足这种新需求。
convenience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

convenience.sentenceEn: For convenience's sake, one-third of rural households visit unqualified village doctors, who rely on unscientific methods of treatment, according to a 2016 study in the peer-reviewed journal Global Health Action.
convenience.translationZh: 根据2016年发表在同行评审期刊《全球健康行动》上的一项研究，为图方便，三分之一的农村家庭会求助于不合格的乡村医生，这些医生采用不科学的治疗方法。

convenience.sentenceEn: Many employers are eager to provide telemedicine service as a benefit to their employees because of its convenience .
convenience.translationZh: 许多雇主热衷于将远程医疗服务作为一项福利提供给员工，因为它十分便捷。

convenience.sentenceEn: They are hooked on manufacturing convenience foods.
convenience.translationZh: 这些公司沉迷于生产方便食品。

coral.sentenceEn: Hugh Possingham, director of the Centre of Excellence for Environmental Decisions at the University of Queensland, points out that little more than half of the Coral Sea reserve is proposed as "no take" area, in which all fishing would be banned.
coral.translationZh: 昆士兰大学环境决策卓越中心主任休·波辛厄姆指出，珊瑚海保护区中仅有略超过一半的区域被提议设为"禁捕区"，在这些区域内所有捕鱼活动都将被禁止。
coral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

coral.sentenceEn: The Coral Sea reserve would cover almost 990 000 square kilometres and stretch as far as 1 100 kilometres from the coast.
coral.translationZh: 珊瑚海保护区将覆盖近99万平方公里，从海岸向外延伸达1100公里。
coral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

coral.sentenceEn: Home to virgin reefs, rare sharks and vast numbers of exotic fish, the Coral Sea is a unique haven of biodiversity off the northeastern coast of Australia.
coral.translationZh: 珊瑚海位于澳大利亚东北海岸附近，拥有原始珊瑚礁、珍稀鲨鱼和大量奇异鱼类，是一个独特的生物多样性天堂。
coral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

coral.sentenceEn: An alliance of campaigning conservation groups argues that more of the Coral Sea should receive this level of protection.
coral.translationZh: 一个积极活动的环保组织联盟认为，珊瑚海应有更大范围获得这一级别的保护。
coral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

coral.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the passage about the Coral Sea?
coral.translationZh: 从文章中我们能了解到关于珊瑚海的哪些信息？

coral.sentenceEn: Make a new proposal to protect the Coral Sea.
coral.translationZh: 制定一项保护珊瑚海的新提案

crave.sentenceEn: I never really crave sweet things or any fancy delicacies.
crave.translationZh: 我从不怎么渴求甜食或任何精致的珍馐。
crave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

crave.sentenceEn: Research shows that we're all born liking sweet things and desire to eat them, but we aren't born knowing what the sweet things we crave look like.
crave.translationZh: 研究表明，我们生来就喜欢甜食并渴望品尝它们，但我们并非天生就知道自己渴望的甜食是什么样子的。
crave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第13句

crave.sentenceEn: Memory, nostalgia(怀旧) in particular, plays a big role in the foods we crave .
crave.translationZh: 记忆，尤其是怀旧之情，在我们对食物的渴望中扮演着重要角色。
crave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

crave.sentenceEn: Craving for a male heir, James and Mary both came to Bath and soon after produced a son, which bred many conspiracy theories about who was the real father of their offspring.
crave.translationZh: 詹姆斯和玛丽渴望有一位男性继承人，于是双双来到巴斯，不久后果然诞下一子，这便引发了诸多关于孩子真正父亲身份的阴谋论。
crave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

crave.sentenceEn: What does the author say plays a key role in the foods we crave ?
crave.translationZh: 作者认为什么在我们渴望的食物中起着关键作用？

crave.sentenceEn: He craves attention from the media.
crave.translationZh: 他渴望得到媒体的关注。

creature.sentenceEn: In other words, the creature can endure conditions that don't even exist on Earth.
creature.translationZh: 换句话说，这种生物能够忍受地球上根本不存在的环境条件。
creature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

creature.sentenceEn: According to the researchers of the new study, stray dogs are intelligent creatures .
creature.translationZh: 这项新研究的研究人员表示，流浪狗是聪明的生物。
creature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

creature.sentenceEn: Because we are creatures of habit, it's natural to assume that when we do manage to adopt and sustain a desirable behavior, that same strategy will work when we want to make another behavior change.
creature.translationZh: 因为我们是习惯的产物，所以很自然地会认为，当我们成功养成并维持一种理想行为时，同样的策略也适用于我们想要做出的其他行为改变。

creature.sentenceEn: A new study, however, has shown that what psychologists call same-different discrimination is present in creatures generally seen as unintelligent: newborn ducklings(小鸭).
creature.translationZh: 然而，一项新研究表明，心理学家所说的异同辨别能力存在于通常被认为不聪明的生物中：新生小鸭。
creature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

creature.sentenceEn: As they become more and more predictable, the creatures inhabiting the increasingly AI-mediated world will become less and less like us.
creature.translationZh: 随着人类变得越来越可预测，这些居住在日益由人工智能主导的世界中的生命将变得越来越不像我们。
creature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

creature.sentenceEn: Why does the author say the creatures living in the more and more AI-mediated world will become increasingly unlike us?
creature.translationZh: 为什么作者说生活在日益由人工智能介导的世界中的生物将变得越来越不像我们？

cure.sentenceEn: With its links to organisational efficiency and employee wellbeing, MRS has attracted the attention of psychologists aware of the need to understand its precise causes and cures .
cure.translationZh: 由于与组织效率和员工福祉息息相关，管理退缩综合征（MRS）引起了心理学家的关注，他们意识到有必要了解其确切成因和解决方法。

cure.sentenceEn: As a child, I remember thinking how great it would be to serve the community and cure people!
cure.translationZh: 小时候，我记得曾想过能为社区服务、治愈病人该有多好！
cure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

cure.sentenceEn: Most large supermarket chains have cured ham in little packets, but in Spain you can buy a whole leg.
cure.translationZh: 大多数大型连锁超市都有小包装的西班牙火腿，但在西班牙你可以买到一整只火腿腿。
cure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第16段，第3句

cure.sentenceEn: The impact of a basic discovery on human health can be exaggerated so that the public thinks a miraculous cure is a few months to years away when in reality the significance of the study is far more limited.
cure.translationZh: 一项基础发现对人类健康的影响可能被夸大，以至于公众认为神奇的治愈方法只需几个月到几年就能实现，而实际上这项研究的意义要有限得多。
cure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

cure.sentenceEn: What does the woman say about cured ham?
cure.translationZh: 这位女士说了关于西班牙火腿的什么内容？

cure.sentenceEn: It has had no effective cure so far.
cure.translationZh: 迄今为止，该病尚无有效治愈方法。

cattle.sentenceEn: So why not raise cattle here?
cattle.translationZh: 那为什么不在这儿养牛呢？
cattle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第7句

cattle.sentenceEn: So, if done right, it should be very profitable to raise our own cattle .
cattle.translationZh: 所以，如果做得好，我们自己养牛应该会非常有利可图。
cattle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第4句

cattle.sentenceEn: Located on a working cattle ranch on the California-Nevada border, Deep Springs is a private, residential, two-year college for men, committed to educating students for "a life of service to humanity."
cattle.translationZh: 深泉学院坐落于加利福尼亚州与内华达州边境的一个经营性牧场上，是一所私立寄宿制男子两年制学院，致力于培养学生为“服务人类的一生”做好准备。

cattle.sentenceEn: When floods come in the spring, sheep, cattle and deer are often trapped by rising waters and often drown.
cattle.translationZh: 春季洪水来临时，绵羊、牛和鹿常常被上涨的洪水困住，进而溺水身亡。
cattle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

cattle.sentenceEn: Last summer, Massachusetts grass-fed beef advocate John Smith launched Big Picture Beef, a network of small grass-fed beef farms in New England and New York that is projected to bring to market 2,500 head of cattle from 125 producers this year.
cattle.translationZh: 去年夏天，马萨诸塞州草饲牛肉倡导者约翰·史密斯创办了“全景牛肉”（Big Picture Beef），这是一个由新英格兰和纽约州小型草饲牛肉农场组成的网络，预计今年将向市场供应来自125家生产商的2500头牛。

cattle.sentenceEn: One tiny American college situated on a cattle farm is devoted to educating students to serve mankind throughout their lives.
cattle.translationZh: 美国一所位于牧场的小型学院致力于培养学生终身服务人类。

chat.sentenceEn: Nurturing a few solid relationships without feeling the need to constantly populate your life with endless chatting ultimately may be better for you.
chat.translationZh: 精心培养几段稳固的关系，不必总觉得需要让生活充斥着没完没了的闲聊，这最终可能对你更好。

chat.sentenceEn: Similarly, an occasional dash of sarcastic wit can spice up a chat and add an element of humor to it.
chat.translationZh: 同样，偶尔的一丝讽刺意味的机智言辞能为聊天增添趣味，注入幽默元素。
chat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

chat.sentenceEn: The humans stand up and leave the room, chatting and laughing, and showing signs of pleasure.
chat.translationZh: 人们站起身，谈笑着离开了房间，脸上洋溢着愉悦的神情。
chat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

chat.sentenceEn: For babies younger than 18 months, AAP still says no screens at all are the best idea—with one notable exception: Live video chat .
chat.translationZh: 对于18个月以下的婴儿，美国儿科学会（AAP）仍然认为完全不接触屏幕是最佳做法，但有一个明显的例外：实时视频聊天。
chat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

chat.sentenceEn: Only those who forced themselves to chat because it was required by the experiment found out what a pleasant experience it could be.
chat.translationZh: 只有那些因实验要求而强迫自己聊天的人，才发现这可能是一种多么愉快的体验。
chat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

chat.sentenceEn: What do families think of live video chat according to surveys?
chat.translationZh: 根据调查，家庭对视频聊天有什么看法？

collapse.sentenceEn: Ghana taxed cocoa(可可粉) exports so heavily that production collapsed by half between the 1960s and 1980s, despite a jump in the global price of cocoa.
collapse.translationZh: 加纳对可可出口课以重税，导致其产量在20世纪60年代至80年代间锐减一半，尽管当时可可的全球价格大幅上涨。

collapse.sentenceEn: The cathedral is owned by the French state and has been at the centre of a years-long dispute over who should finance restoration work of the collapsing staircases, crumbling statues and cracked walls.
collapse.translationZh: 这座大教堂为法国国家所有，多年来一直处于一场争议的中心：谁该为修复那些摇摇欲坠的楼梯、日渐破损的雕像和布满裂缝的墙壁出资。

collapse.sentenceEn: As hundreds of tourists and Parisians stood and watched the flames leaping from the roof, there was shock and tears as the cathedral spire caught fire, burned and then collapsed into itself.
collapse.translationZh: 数百名游客和巴黎市民驻足凝望，眼睁睁看着火焰从屋顶窜出，当大教堂的尖顶起火燃烧并最终轰然坍塌时，人群中充满了震惊和泪水。

collapse.sentenceEn: If the wooden frame of the towers had caught fire, it could have sent the bells—the largest of which, the Emmanuel Bell, weighs 13 tons—crashing down, potentially causing the collapse of both towers.
collapse.translationZh: 如果塔楼的木质框架起火，就可能导致这些钟——其中最大的“ Emmanuel 钟”重达13吨——轰然坠落，进而可能造成两座塔楼坍塌。

collapse.sentenceEn: Once again people began to argue whether Notre Dame Cathedral was going to collapse even without the fire.
collapse.translationZh: 人们再次开始争论，即使没有这场火灾，巴黎圣母院是否也会倒塌。

collapse.sentenceEn: The roof of their cottage collapsed in the flood.
collapse.translationZh: 他们小屋的屋顶在洪水中坍塌了。

comfort.sentenceEn: Many see friendships as a comfort blanket: a shoulder to cry on, a reliable soul to confide in.
comfort.translationZh: 许多人将友谊视为一种慰藉：它是可以倚靠哭泣的肩膀，也是可以倾诉心声的可靠伴侣。
comfort.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

comfort.sentenceEn: Many people seek comfort in the snacks they remember from childhood.
comfort.translationZh: 许多人在他们记忆中的童年零食中寻求慰藉。
comfort.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

comfort.sentenceEn: Dogs also help people relax, and they can be a particular comfort to those with chronic diseases.
comfort.translationZh: 狗狗还能帮助人们放松心情，对慢性病患者而言更是一种特殊的慰藉。
comfort.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

comfort.sentenceEn: These days, they're equipped with all the modern comforts .
comfort.translationZh: 如今的房车都配备了各种现代化的舒适设施。
comfort.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

comfort.sentenceEn: And there is some evidence that this helps kids of all backgrounds gain comfort with diversity and different cultures.
comfort.translationZh: 并且有证据表明，这有助于不同背景的孩子轻松接纳多样性和不同文化。

comfort.sentenceEn: It has a lot to do with the comforts they provide.
comfort.translationZh: 这与它们提供的舒适感有很大关系。

commit.sentenceEn: On this Martin Luther King Day and beyond, let's commit to working together to disrupt the status quo.
commit.translationZh: 在这个马丁·路德·金纪念日及未来，让我们致力于共同努力，打破现状。
commit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

commit.sentenceEn: San Francisco and the Bay Area have long been committed to values which embrace inclusion and rejection of mainstream culture.
commit.translationZh: 旧金山及整个湾区长期以来一直秉持包容接纳与抵制主流文化的价值观。

commit.sentenceEn: Located on a working cattle ranch on the California-Nevada border, Deep Springs is a private, residential, two-year college for men, committed to educating students for "a life of service to humanity."
commit.translationZh: 深泉学院坐落于加利福尼亚州与内华达州边境的一个经营性牧场上，是一所私立寄宿制男子两年制学院，致力于培养学生为“服务人类的一生”做好准备。

commit.sentenceEn: W: Loads of people are committing to this trend full time.
commit.translationZh: 很多人都全身心投入到这种潮流中，把它当成了全职生活方式。
commit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

commit.sentenceEn: Wardian started saving for the trip in 2014, connecting with sponsors and getting approval from his wife, Jennifer, before committing .
commit.translationZh: 沃迪安从2014年开始为这次旅程存钱，在最终确定参加前，他联系了赞助商并征得了妻子詹妮弗的同意。

commit.sentenceEn: Find out why he committed the offense.
commit.translationZh: 反思该行为是出于恶意，还是由冒犯者生活中的困境所导致

compound.sentenceEn: The researchers also calculated the clean air delivery rate for plants in the studies they analyzed and found that the rate at which plants disperse the compounds was well below the usual rate of air exchange in a normal building, caused by the movement of people coming and going, opening doors and windows.
compound.translationZh: 研究人员还计算了他们所分析研究中植物的洁净空气输送率，发现植物驱散化合物的速率远低于普通建筑物中通常的空气交换率，后者是由人员往来、门窗开关等活动引起的。
compound.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

compound.sentenceEn: Many of the studies did show a reduction in the concentration of volatile organic compounds over time, which is likely why people have seized on them to praise the air purifying virtues of plants.
compound.translationZh: 许多研究确实表明，随着时间的推移，挥发性有机化合物的浓度有所降低，这可能就是为什么人们会抓住这一点来赞扬植物的空气净化功效。
compound.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

compound.sentenceEn: Artificial intelligence is also able to predict if compounds are likely to be toxic.
compound.translationZh: 人工智能还能够预测化合物是否可能具有毒性。
compound.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第15句

compound.sentenceEn: It can screen hundreds of millions of compounds to identify a few interesting candidates that require experimental testing.
compound.translationZh: 它能够筛选数亿种化合物，以识别出少数需要实验测试的潜在候选化合物。
compound.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第14句
