compound.sentenceEn: Researchers have identified a potent new antibiotic compound using artificial intelligence.
compound.translationZh: 研究人员利用人工智能发现了一种强效新型抗生素化合物。
compound.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

compound.sentenceEn: Houseplants disperse chemical compounds more quickly with people moving around.
compound.translationZh: 室内植物在有人活动的情况下会更快地释放化合物。

comprehension.sentenceEn: In fact, multiple studies have found that electronic books support story comprehension and vocabulary gains beyond what is provided by printed books.
comprehension.translationZh: 事实上，多项研究发现，电子书在促进故事理解和词汇积累方面的效果，甚至超过了纸质书籍。
comprehension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

comprehension.sentenceEn: After this, the students answered some questions to test their comprehension and memory of the text.
comprehension.translationZh: 之后，学生们回答了一些问题，以测试他们对文本的理解和记忆。
comprehension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

comprehension.sentenceEn: The panel found that phonics, along with explicit instruction in phonemic(音位的) awareness, fluency and comprehension , worked best.
comprehension.translationZh: 该委员会发现，将自然拼读法与音位意识、阅读流畅度和阅读理解能力的明确教学相结合，效果最佳。
comprehension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

comprehension.sentenceEn: When the background speech was in a language unfamiliar to participants, there was little if any hindrance of reading comprehension .
comprehension.translationZh: 当背景语音使用参与者不熟悉的语言时，阅读理解几乎不会受到任何阻碍。
comprehension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

comprehension.sentenceEn: What did some American researchers find about students' reading comprehension in the presence of background noise?
comprehension.translationZh: 一些美国研究人员关于学生在有背景噪音的情况下的阅读理解有什么发现？

comprehension.sentenceEn: It has to do with short-term memory for listening comprehension .
comprehension.translationZh: 这与用于听力理解的短期记忆有关。

convenient.sentenceEn: Those little bins on the inside of refrigerator doors are convenient , but they don't maintain a consistent temperature, so definitely refrain from putting perishable foods in there.
convenient.translationZh: 冰箱门内侧的那些小储物格虽然方便，但温度不稳定，所以千万不要把易腐食品放在那里。
convenient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

convenient.sentenceEn: Ultra-processed foods are characteristically designed to be cheap, tasty, and convenient ; examples include soft drinks and candy, packaged snacks and pastries, ready-to-heat products, and reconstituted meat products.
convenient.translationZh: 超加工食品的特点是价格低廉、味道鲜美且食用方便；例如软饮料、糖果、包装零食、糕点、即热食品和重组肉制品。
convenient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

convenient.sentenceEn: Berries and nuts are a convenient and nutritious snack.
convenient.translationZh: 浆果和坚果是一种方便又营养的零食。
convenient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

convenient.sentenceEn: Overall, Moss outlines the industry's dependence on making their products inexpensive, super delicious, and incredibly convenient for consumers.
convenient.translationZh: 总体而言，莫斯阐述了食品行业对产品策略的依赖——即生产价格低廉、美味可口且对消费者而言极其便利的食品。
convenient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

convenient.sentenceEn: The mothers are concerned they are dealing with indigestion, but it's because they are feeding the children packaged chips which are cheap and convenient .
convenient.translationZh: 母亲们担心孩子是消化不良，但实际上是因为她们经常给孩子吃那些廉价又方便的包装薯片。

convenient.sentenceEn: The smart card provides more convenient travel, and passengers simply top up their cards and tap them to get in and out the subway.
convenient.translationZh: 智能卡为乘客提供了更便捷的出行方式，乘客只需为卡充值，然后轻轻一刷即可进出地铁站。
convenient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

council.sentenceEn: The Urban Libraries Council released a report detailing the unique ways in which libraries can further sustainability at the local level.
council.translationZh: 城市图书馆理事会发布了一份报告，详细阐述了图书馆在地方层面促进可持续发展的独特方式。

council.sentenceEn: Studies show that bilingualism(双语) correlates with cognitive development, intelligence, memory and problem solving abilities, according to the American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages.
council.translationZh: 美国外语教学委员会表示，研究表明双语能力与认知发展、智力、记忆力和解决问题的能力相关联。

council.sentenceEn: However, after a lifetime of moving within the circles of power, he was unable to break with authority, and served Mussolini faithfully (as president of Italy's national research council and royal academy, as well as a member of the Fascist Grand Council ) until the day he died—conveniently—in 1937, shortly before he would have had to take a stand in the conflict that consumed a world that he had, in part, created.
council.translationZh: 然而，在权力圈子中周旋了一生之后，他已无法与权威决裂，而是一直忠实地为墨索里尼效力（担任意大利国家研究委员会主席、皇家科学院院长以及法西斯大委员会成员），直至1937年他"适时"离世——就在他即将不得不对那场吞噬了一个部分由他亲手创造的世界的冲突表明立场之前不久。

council.sentenceEn: The existence of new revenue streams for some but not all councils is complicated, and businesses are often opposed, fearing higher costs will make them uncompetitive.
council.translationZh: 部分而非所有地方议会拥有新收入来源的情况很复杂，企业往往持反对态度，担心成本增加会削弱其竞争力。
council.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

council.sentenceEn: Scottish councils are set to be the first in the UK with the power to levy charges on visitors, with Edinburgh likely to lead the way.
council.translationZh: 苏格兰地方议会将成为英国首个有权向游客征收费用的议会，爱丁堡很可能会率先行动。
council.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

council.sentenceEn: Voice his complaints to the city council .
council.translationZh: 向市议会表达他的不满

craft.sentenceEn: One reason for this is that such people are likely to spend sustained time alone working on their craft .
craft.translationZh: 其中一个原因是，这类人可能会花费大量时间独自钻研自己的技艺。

craft.sentenceEn: The Sunken Military Craft Act of 2004, a US federal act, protects any vessel that was on a military mission, allowing the originating country to claim their ship even centuries later.
craft.translationZh: 2004年《沉没军事舰艇法案》是一项美国联邦法案，它保护所有执行过军事任务的舰艇，允许其原产国即使在数百年后仍可对其船只提出所有权主张。

craft.sentenceEn: Writing is not an easy craft to master.
craft.translationZh: 写作并非一门容易掌握的技艺。
craft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

craft.sentenceEn: The dream of personalised flight is still vivid in the minds of many inventors, some developing cycle-powered craft , others pouring money into jetpacks(喷气飞行背包).
craft.translationZh: 个性化飞行的梦想在众多发明家心中依然鲜活，有人在研发人力飞行器，也有人斥资研发喷气飞行背包。
craft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

craft.sentenceEn: In 2009 an old Russian craft slammed into a communications satellite, creating a cloud of hundreds of pieces of debris and putting other hardware at risk.
craft.translationZh: 2009年，一艘俄罗斯旧航天器与一颗通信卫星相撞，产生了由数百块碎片组成的云团，使其他太空设备陷入危险。
craft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

craft.sentenceEn: There is less consensus on objects shaped by human craft .
craft.translationZh: 对于人工制造的物品，人们的共识较少。

cue.sentenceEn: When 3 p. m. comes around, that's your cue to pour yourself a cup of hot water and drink that tea, instead of walking to the vending machine.
cue.translationZh: 下午三点一到，你就该给自己倒杯热水泡茶喝，而不是走去自动售货机。

cue.sentenceEn: The basal ganglia, the brain region linked to our performance of habits, is most active at the beginning of a behavior, when the habit is cued , and at the end, when it's rewarded.
cue.translationZh: 基底神经节是与我们习惯执行相关的大脑区域，它在行为开始时（习惯被触发时）和结束时（获得奖励时）最为活跃。

cue.sentenceEn: Is it that participants can't discern what the flavor is, and so rely on visual cues ?
cue.translationZh: 是不是参与者无法辨别味道，因此依赖视觉线索？
cue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

cue.sentenceEn: Some of this discrepancy could be because the observers used only audio clips, and thus could not read cues like body language, but there are probably other explanations, as people should be able to hear when a participant is being kind versus being rude.
cue.translationZh: 这种差异的部分原因可能是观察者仅使用了音频片段，因此无法读取肢体语言等线索，但可能还有其他解释，因为人们应该能够听出参与者表现得友善还是粗鲁。
cue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

cue.sentenceEn: Companies' advertising is cueing us to remember those products and we want those products constantly.
cue.translationZh: 企业的广告不断提示我们想起这些产品，让我们对它们产生持续的渴望。
cue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

cutting.sentenceEn: Hence, it's no wonder that sarcasm is often preceded by the word " cutting " and that it hurts.
cutting.translationZh: 因此，难怪人们常用“尖锐”一词来形容讽刺，而讽刺确实伤人。
cutting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

cutting.sentenceEn: Sarcastic statements are expressed in a cutting manner; witty remarks are delivered with undisguised and harmless humor.
cutting.translationZh: 讽刺性言论往往尖酸刻薄；而诙谐的话语则带着毫不掩饰却又无伤大雅的幽默。
cutting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第4句

cutting.sentenceEn: But the Paris Conference nevertheless marked a historic step toward the recognition of the need for action on climate change, the cutting of carbon emissions, and world cooperation.
cutting.translationZh: 但巴黎气候大会仍然标志着人类在认识气候变化应对必要性、削减碳排放以及开展全球合作方面迈出了历史性的一步。

cutting.sentenceEn: My company, Kaggle, operates on the cutting edge of machine learning.
cutting.translationZh: 我的公司Kaggle处于机器学习的前沿领域。
cutting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

cutting.sentenceEn: If so, you've probably pondered the question a psychologist, James Cutting , asked himself: How does a work of art come to be considered great?
cutting.translationZh: 如果是这样，你可能思考过心理学家詹姆斯·卡廷曾问过自己的问题：一件艺术作品如何会被视为伟大之作？

cutting.sentenceEn: In his experiment, Cutting found that his subjects liked lesser known works better than canonical works because of more exposure.
cutting.translationZh: 在实验中，卡特发现，由于接触次数更多，受试者更喜欢那些不太知名的作品，而非经典作品。

cape.sentenceEn: Hence, the sparkling cape was paired with a traditional power suit you would typically see in a business setting.
cape.translationZh: 因此，这件闪亮的披风搭配了一套传统的权力套装，这种套装在商务场合中极为常见。
cape.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

cape.sentenceEn: The dazzling cape deployed at the end of the show, for example, bewildered many in the audience.
cape.translationZh: 例如，表演结束时展开的那件耀眼披风让许多观众感到困惑。
cape.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

cape.sentenceEn: Using glitter, I drew similar intricate patterns onto the velvet cape .
cape.translationZh: 我用闪光粉在天鹅绒披风上绘制了类似的精致图案。
cape.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

cape.sentenceEn: In May 2016, a salvor named Bobby Pritchett, president of Global Marine Exploration (GME) in Tampa, Florida, announced that he had discovered scattered remains of a ship buried a kilometer off Cape Canaveral.
cape.translationZh: 2016年5月，佛罗里达州坦帕市全球海洋探索公司（GME）总裁、打捞员鲍比·普里切特宣布，他在卡纳维拉尔角外一公里处发现了一艘沉船的散落残骸。

cape.sentenceEn: Nearly 64 kilometers of undeveloped beach and 648 square kilometers of protected refuge fan out from the cape's sandy shores.
cape.translationZh: 从卡纳维拉尔角的沙滩延伸出去的，是近64公里长的原始海滩和648平方公里的受保护保护区。

cape.sentenceEn: Make velvet capes look both majestic and masculine.
cape.translationZh: 让天鹅绒斗篷既显威严又不失阳刚之气

catastrophic.sentenceEn: Drying is pretty catastrophic for most living things.
catastrophic.translationZh: 对于大多数生物而言，脱水是相当致命的。
catastrophic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

catastrophic.sentenceEn: This simulation gives the child crucial information about how to avoid becoming prey, and children tend to find that kind of activity deeply satisfying, presumably because it gives them a safe experience of a potentially catastrophic scenario.
catastrophic.translationZh: 这种模拟为孩子提供了关于如何避免成为猎物的重要信息，而孩子们往往发现这类活动非常令人满足，可能是因为它让他们在安全的环境中体验了潜在的灾难性情景。
catastrophic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

catastrophic.sentenceEn: While the term AI conjures up anxieties about killer robots or catastrophic levels of unemployment, there are other, deeper implications.
catastrophic.translationZh: 虽然“人工智能”一词会让人联想到对杀人机器人或灾难性失业水平的焦虑，但它还存在其他更深层次的影响。
catastrophic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

catastrophic.sentenceEn: Experts have said that it suggests a " catastrophic failure" of technology.
catastrophic.translationZh: 专家表示，这表明了技术的“灾难性失败”。
catastrophic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

catastrophic.sentenceEn: It is urgent for governments to increase the cost of using fossil fuels to an appropriate level to lessen the catastrophic effects of climate change.
catastrophic.translationZh: 各国政府亟需将化石燃料的使用成本提高到适当水平，以减轻气候变化可能造成的灾难性影响。

catastrophic.sentenceEn: It is causing catastrophic levels of unemployment.
catastrophic.translationZh: 它正在造成灾难性的失业水平。

changing.sentenceEn: However, it's not just factories that are seeing losses—software and information technology are also having a dramatic impact on jobs most people think are secure from the forces of a rapidly- changing economy.
changing.translationZh: 然而，并非只有工厂出现岗位流失——软件和信息技术也正对那些多数人认为能在快速变化的经济浪潮中安然无恙的工作产生巨大冲击。
changing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

changing.sentenceEn: The many changing factors of the relationship need to be acknowledged, rather than hoping that the mere passage of time will magically connect parents to their adult children.
changing.translationZh: 我们需要承认亲子关系中诸多不断变化的因素，而不是寄希望于仅仅通过时间的流逝就能神奇地拉近父母与成年子女的距离。
changing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

changing.sentenceEn: Civilian aviation is being disrupted, not by the age-old desires for speed, romanticism and glamour, but by the pressing need to respond to a changing climate.
changing.translationZh: 民用航空正在经历变革，推动其变革的并非人们对速度、浪漫与魅力的长久渴望，而是应对气候变化的迫切需求。
changing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

changing.sentenceEn: Other efforts to increase the use of electric vehicles include plans to build over 1 million hybrid and electric car battery changing stations across the country.
changing.translationZh: 为推广电动汽车使用，德国还计划在全国建设超过100万个混合动力和电动汽车电池更换站。
changing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

changing.sentenceEn: In future traditional luxury brands will have to adapt their business strategies to the changing concepts of luxury.
changing.translationZh: 未来，传统奢侈品牌将不得不调整其商业策略，以适应不断变化的奢侈概念。

changing.sentenceEn: It reflects our changing status in society.
changing.translationZh: 它反映了我们在社会中不断变化的地位。

channel.sentenceEn: We instead suggest using unexcused absence from school as a signal to channel resources to the children and families who need them most.
channel.translationZh: 相反，我们建议将无故缺课作为一种信号，以便将资源导向最需要帮助的儿童和家庭。
channel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

channel.sentenceEn: Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and countless other social channels provide a quick and simple way to glimpse into a job candidate's personal life—both the positive and negative sides of it.
channel.translationZh: Facebook、Twitter、LinkedIn以及无数其他社交平台提供了一种快速简便的方式，让人们得以窥见求职者的个人生活——包括其积极和消极的方面。
channel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

channel.sentenceEn: W: Oh, yeah, we should let the staff know the channels of communication, you know, who they can contact or direct questions to about these changes?
channel.translationZh: 女：哦，对了，我们应该让员工知道沟通渠道，你知道的，关于这些变动他们可以联系谁或向谁提问？
channel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

channel.sentenceEn: Science journalism is the main channel for the popularization of scientific information among the public.
channel.translationZh: 科学新闻是向公众普及科学信息的主要渠道。
channel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

channel.sentenceEn: The first woman to cross the English Channel was Gertrude Ederle in 1926.
channel.translationZh: 1926年，格特鲁德·埃德勒（Gertrude Ederle）成为首位横渡英吉利海峡的女性。
channel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

channel.sentenceEn: She succeeded in swimming across the English Channel .
channel.translationZh: 她成功横渡了英吉利海峡。

chimpanzee.translationZh: 毕竟，我们可不是黑猩猩。
chimpanzee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

chimpanzee.sentenceEn: Fewer than 300,000 wild chimpanzees live in a few forested corners of Africa today, while humans have colonized every corner of the globe.
chimpanzee.translationZh: 如今，仅存不到30万只野生黑猩猩生活在非洲几片森林地带，而人类却已定居全球各个角落。
chimpanzee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

chimpanzee.sentenceEn: In a famous study, psychologists Victoria Horner and Andrew Whiten showed two groups of test subjects—children and chimpanzees —a mechanical box with a treat inside.
chimpanzee.translationZh: 在一项著名研究中，心理学家维多利亚·霍纳(Victoria Horner)和安德鲁·怀滕(Andrew Whiten)向两组实验对象——儿童和黑猩猩——展示了一个内有零食的机械盒子。
chimpanzee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

chimpanzee.sentenceEn: When it comes to copying, chimpanzees are more rational than human children or adults.
chimpanzee.translationZh: 在模仿方面，黑猩猩比人类儿童或成人更具理性。
chimpanzee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

chimpanzee.sentenceEn: What point does the author want to emphasize when he says "We're not chimpanzees "?
chimpanzee.translationZh: 作者说“我们不是黑猩猩”时想强调什么观点？

chimpanzee.sentenceEn: Chimpanzees could retrieve the treat more quickly than children did.
chimpanzee.translationZh: 黑猩猩能够比儿童更快地拿到零食。

click.sentenceEn: My "challenge" was to click on each cell in the grid that contained a traffic sign.
click.translationZh: 我的“任务”是点击网格中所有包含交通标志的单元格。
click.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

click.sentenceEn: It is becoming increasingly clear that retail reinvention isn't a simple battle to the death between bricks and clicks .
click.translationZh: 越来越明显的是，零售业的重塑并非实体店与线上店之间一场简单的生死较量。

click.sentenceEn: Have you ever had someone try to explain something to you a dozen times with no luck—but, then, when you see a picture, the idea finally clicks ?
click.translationZh: 你是否曾遇到过这种情况：有人反复向你解释某件事十几次，你却始终不得要领——然而，当你看到一张图片时，那个概念突然就豁然开朗了？
click.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

click.sentenceEn: Was it the satisfying click of the camera?
click.translationZh: 这是否与相机那令人满意的快门声有关呢？
click.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

click.sentenceEn: In Thailand, clicking the fingers, clapping your hands, or just shouting "Waiter!", will embarrass your hosts, fellow diners, the waiter himself and, most of all, you!
click.translationZh: 在泰国，打响指、拍手或直接喊"服务员！"会让主人、其他用餐者、服务员本人感到尴尬，而最尴尬的还是你自己！
click.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第10句

click.sentenceEn: He clicked on the cells randomly.
click.translationZh: 他随机点击了一些单元格。

comedy.sentenceEn: A comedy of manners tends to reward its clever and deceitful characters, rather than punish their bad deeds.
comedy.translationZh: 风尚喜剧往往会奖赏那些聪明狡诈的角色，而非惩罚他们的不良行为。
comedy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

comedy.sentenceEn: Her books have frequently been described as comedies of manners.
comedy.translationZh: 她的作品常被描述为世态喜剧。
comedy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

comedy.sentenceEn: That is to say, comedies that represent the complex and sophisticated code of behaviour current in fashionable circles of society, where appearances count more than true moral character.
comedy.translationZh: 也就是说，这类喜剧描绘了上流社会中复杂而精致的行为准则，在这些圈子里，表面形象比真实品德更为重要。
comedy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

comedy.sentenceEn: The humor of a comedy of manners relies on verbal wit and playful teasing.
comedy.translationZh: 风尚喜剧的幽默源于语言的机智和戏谑的调侃。
comedy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

comedy.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the clever and deceitful characters in a comedy of manners?
comedy.translationZh: 关于风尚喜剧（或译：世态喜剧）中的聪明狡黠角色，我们能了解到什么？

comedy.sentenceEn: Interactive television advertising is successful when incorporated into situation comedies .
comedy.translationZh: 交互式电视广告若融入情景喜剧节目中，便能取得成功。

commerce.sentenceEn: They were vessels built for war and commerce , crossing the globe carrying everything from coins to cannons, boxes of silver and gold, chests of jewels and porcelain, and pearls from the Caribbean.
commerce.translationZh: 这些船只或是战舰，或是商船，它们航遍全球，所载之物应有尽有：从普通硬币到军用大炮，从整箱的金银到满匣的珠宝瓷器，还有来自加勒比海的珍珠。

commerce.sentenceEn: It was an intellectual project, not about commerce or control, created in a scientific research center in Switzerland.
commerce.translationZh: 它是一个学术项目，与商业或控制无关，诞生于瑞士的一个科学研究中心。
commerce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

commerce.sentenceEn: It reduced many aspects of modern life to entertainment, sensationalism, and commerce .
commerce.translationZh: 它将现代生活的诸多方面简化为娱乐、耸人听闻的报道和商业活动。
commerce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

commerce.sentenceEn: More than 20 years after the internet was opened to commerce , the Census Bureau tells us that brick and mortar sales accounted for 92.3 percent of retail sales in the first quarter of 2016.
commerce.translationZh: 互联网开放用于商业已逾20年，美国人口普查局的数据显示，2016年第一季度实体店销售额占零售总额的92.3%。

commerce.sentenceEn: B2B commerce , for example, didn't move mainly online by 2005 as many had predicted in 2000, nor even by 2016, but that doesn't mean it won't do so over the next few decades.
commerce.translationZh: 例如，企业对企业(B2B)电子商务并未像许多人在2000年预测的那样在2005年主要转移到线上，甚至到2016年也没有，但这并不意味着未来几十年不会出现这种情况。

commerce.sentenceEn: With the rise of online commerce , physical retail stores are likely to suffer the same fate as the yellow pages.
commerce.translationZh: 随着电子商务的兴起，实体零售店似乎可能重蹈黄页的覆辙。

commonly.sentenceEn: He has found that personality traits commonly associated with creativity are openness (receptiveness to new thoughts and experiences), self-confidence, and autonomy—which may include "a lack of concern for social norms" and "a preference for being alone".
commonly.translationZh: 他发现，通常与创造力相关的人格特质包括开放性（乐于接受新思想和新体验）、自信心和自主性——其中可能包括“不太在意社会规范”和“喜欢独处”。

commonly.sentenceEn: It's commonly believed that leaders need to be sociable.
commonly.translationZh: 人们普遍认为，领导者需要具备社交能力。

commonly.sentenceEn: The hypothesis is the commonly pleasing features, like proportion or symmetry, are at work.
commonly.translationZh: 该假设认为，比例或对称等普遍令人愉悦的特征正在发挥作用。
commonly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

commonly.sentenceEn: Gratitude may be more beneficial than we commonly suppose.
commonly.translationZh: 感恩的益处可能比我们通常认为的要多。

commonly.sentenceEn: This is the "Out of Africa" model, as it's commonly known.
commonly.translationZh: 这就是人们通常所说的“走出非洲”模型。
commonly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

commonly.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say travelers commonly complain about?
commonly.translationZh: 说话者提到旅行者通常抱怨什么？

comparable.sentenceEn: There is no comparable full life-cycle assessment for transportation.
comparable.translationZh: 目前尚无类似的交通运输全生命周期评估。

comparable.sentenceEn: New Look, one of the first reputable store chains to use the vegan trademark, prices ballet shoes at £7.99 and a vegan laptop handbag at £29.99, comparable with its other products.
comparable.translationZh: New Look（新风貌）是首批使用 vegan 商标的知名连锁店之一，其芭蕾鞋定价7.99英镑，vegan 笔记本电脑手提包定价29.99英镑，与店内其他产品价格相当。
comparable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

comparable.sentenceEn: Historically, nothing comparable had happened prior to this.
comparable.translationZh: 从历史角度看，在此之前从未发生过类似的事情。

comparable.sentenceEn: But I believe it is the same as or even really comparable to learning a foreign language.
comparable.translationZh: 但我认为，编程学习与外语学习并非同类，甚至不具可比性。

comparable.sentenceEn: In what way does Michael Moss think processed food is comparable to alcohol and cigarettes?
comparable.translationZh: 迈克尔·莫斯认为加工食品在哪些方面可与酒精和香烟相提并论？

comparable.sentenceEn: It is comparable to that of virus.
comparable.translationZh: 这类似于病毒的传播方式。

compensation.sentenceEn: In the transaction, Ward was required to pay Jackson a sum of $1,200 (about $31, 000 today), either for the property itself or simply in compensation for improvements Jackson had made on the lot.
compensation.translationZh: 在这笔交易中，沃德需向杰克逊支付1200美元（约合今日31,000美元），这笔款项可能是房产本身的费用，也可能仅仅是对杰克逊在该地块上所做改善的补偿。

compensation.sentenceEn: With compensation , if you eat one large meal in the morning, you are naturally inclined to eat less for the rest of the day.
compensation.translationZh: 有了这种代偿机制，如果你早上吃了一顿大餐，自然就会倾向于在一天剩下的时间里少吃一些。
compensation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

compensation.sentenceEn: Humans were also programmed for something called " compensation ," which is the brain's regulatory mechanism for preventing the accumulation of excess weight.
compensation.translationZh: 人类还进化出了一种被称为“代偿机制”的功能，这是大脑防止体重过度增加的调节机制。
compensation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

compensation.sentenceEn: Mainstream economists insist that it is impossible to order up a sustainable increase in wages because compensation levels reflect the unerring judgment of market forces.
compensation.translationZh: 主流经济学家坚持认为，不可能人为促成工资的可持续增长，因为薪酬水平反映了市场力量的精准判断。
compensation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

compensation.sentenceEn: Overall, the strike is an effort to provide more secondary compensation along with other concerns, such as transparency upon hiring talent and on-set(制作中) safety precautions.
compensation.translationZh: 总体而言，此次罢工旨在争取更多的追加酬金，同时解决其他一些问题，例如在招聘演职人员时的透明度以及制作中的安全预防措施。
compensation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

compensation.sentenceEn: So the voice actors are pushing for the idea of secondary compensation —a performance bonus every time a game sells 2 million copies or downloads, or reaches 2 million subscribers, with a cap at 8 million.
compensation.translationZh: 因此，配音演员们正在争取追加酬金制度——即每当一款游戏的销量或下载量达到200万份，或订阅用户数达到200万时，他们就能获得一笔表演奖金，而奖金上限为800万份/用户。
compensation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

concentration.sentenceEn: And the occasional absence of focus ultimately helps concentration in the long run.
concentration.translationZh: 而偶尔的注意力分散，从长远来看最终有助于提高专注力。

concentration.sentenceEn: Many of the studies did show a reduction in the concentration of volatile organic compounds over time, which is likely why people have seized on them to praise the air purifying virtues of plants.
concentration.translationZh: 许多研究确实表明，随着时间的推移，挥发性有机化合物的浓度有所降低，这可能就是为什么人们会抓住这一点来赞扬植物的空气净化功效。
concentration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

concentration.sentenceEn: Combining whole grain foods with protein will help keep your blood sugar levels balanced, which is essential for mood and concentration .
concentration.translationZh: 将全谷物食品与蛋白质结合食用有助于保持血糖水平稳定，这对情绪和专注力至关重要。
concentration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

concentration.sentenceEn: Cape Canaveral contains one of the greatest concentrations of colonial shipwrecks in the world.
concentration.translationZh: 卡纳维拉尔角拥有世界上最密集的殖民时期沉船遗址之一。

concentration.sentenceEn: To establish whether effects such as improved concentration are caused by music participation itself, and not by investing time in an extracurricular activity of any kind, Assal Habibi, a psychology professor at the University of Southern California, is conducting a five-year longitudinal study with children from low-income communities in Los Angeles.
concentration.translationZh: 为了确定诸如注意力提升等效果是否由参与音乐活动本身引起，而非仅仅因为投入时间参与任何类型的课外活动，南加州大学心理学教授阿萨尔·哈比比正在对洛杉矶低收入社区的儿童开展一项为期五年的纵向研究。

concentration.sentenceEn: It helps improve concentration and memory.
concentration.translationZh: 它有助于提高专注力和记忆力。

conserve.sentenceEn: Scientists say that sequencing every species will revolutionise the understanding of biology and evolution, bolster efforts to conserve as well as protect and restore biodiversity.
conserve.translationZh: 科学家表示，对每个物种进行测序将彻底改变我们对生物学和进化的理解，并加强保护、维护和恢复生物多样性的努力。
conserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

conserve.sentenceEn: When resources are low, a person will shift into defence to conserve their remaining supply.
conserve.translationZh: 当资源匮乏时，人们会转入防御状态以保存剩余的资源。

conserve.sentenceEn: Who is more at fault, Bass asks, the professional archaeologist who carefully excavates a site and never publishes on it or the treasure hunter who locates a submerged wreck, salvages part, conserves part, and publishes a book on the operation?
conserve.translationZh: 巴斯问道：一位专业考古学家精心发掘了遗址却从不发表研究成果，与一位找到水下沉船、打捞部分文物、保存部分文物并出版相关著作的寻宝者相比，谁的过失更大？

conserve.sentenceEn: "As the number of children who have biophobia increases, public interest and support for biodiversity conservation will gradually decline. Although many conservation biologists still consider that preventing the loss of wildlife habitat is the most important way to conserve biodiversity, I think preventing increased biophobia is also important for conservation."
conserve.translationZh: 随着患有生物恐惧症的儿童数量增加，公众对生物多样性保护的兴趣和支持将逐渐下降。尽管许多保护生物学家仍然认为，防止野生动物栖息地的丧失是保护生物多样性最重要的方式，但我认为防止生物恐惧症加剧对保护工作也同样重要。

conserve.sentenceEn: Preventing the increase in children's fear of living creatures is also important for conserving biodiversity.
conserve.translationZh: 防止儿童对生物的恐惧感加剧对于保护生物多样性也很重要。

conserve.sentenceEn: It dwarfs all other efforts to conserve , protect and restore biodiversity on earth.
conserve.translationZh: 它使地球上所有其他保护、维护和恢复生物多样性的努力都相形见绌。

considerably.sentenceEn: It turns out that if we're unable to see the face, but rather focus on the voice of the person in question, our accuracy rate improves considerably .
considerably.translationZh: 事实证明，如果我们不去看对方的脸，而是专注于其声音，我们的判断准确率会显著提高。
considerably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

considerably.sentenceEn: But these plans will not bear fruit unless they get considerably more support from policy-makers.
considerably.translationZh: 但这些计划要想取得成果，就必须获得政策制定者更多的支持。
considerably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

considerably.sentenceEn: The sun was considerably less bright back then.
considerably.translationZh: 那时的太阳要暗淡得多。
considerably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

considerably.sentenceEn: While by no means perfect, it is considerably more comprehensive than average income, taking into account not only growth in consumption per person but also changes in working time, life expectancy, and inequality.
considerably.translationZh: 尽管这一指标并非完美无缺，但它比平均收入指标要全面得多，不仅考虑了人均消费的增长，还包含了工作时间、预期寿命和不平等程度的变化。
considerably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

considerably.sentenceEn: They have contributed considerably to its popularity.
considerably.translationZh: 他们为其普及做出了相当大的贡献。

construction.sentenceEn: W: You are involved with buildings and construction , right?
construction.translationZh: 女：您是从事建筑行业的，对吗？
construction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

construction.sentenceEn: Beyond ensuring that library construction projects consider environmental impact, libraries can take a lead in supporting local foods and craftsmen, like the Peabody Institute Library's partnering with local businesses to pioneer a farmers' market in their courtyard, or the Richmond Public Library's seed lending library which "nurtures locally-adapted plant varieties, and fosters community resilience(韧性), self-reliance and a culture of sharing."
construction.translationZh: 除了确保图书馆建设项目考虑环境影响外，图书馆还可以带头支持本地食品和手工艺人，例如皮博迪研究所图书馆与当地企业合作，在其庭院开创农贸市场，或者里士满公共图书馆的种子借阅图书馆，该图书馆“培育适应当地的植物品种，培养社区韧性、自力更生和分享文化。”

construction.sentenceEn: The political limit has also been reached in some places, with citizens meeting the construction of new wind turbines with loud protests.
construction.translationZh: 在一些地方，政治层面的限制也已显现，民众对新建风力涡轮机的建设发出了强烈抗议。
construction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

construction.sentenceEn: They hope to reduce both the number of components needed in a construction job and their weight—by replacing solid supports with hollow tubes, for example.
construction.translationZh: 他们希望减少建筑工程所需的部件数量并减轻其重量——例如，用空心管代替实心支撑件。
construction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

construction.sentenceEn: This period was one of inter-elite rivalry in which nobles sought to increase their influence by funding the construction of churches and other buildings.
construction.translationZh: 这一时期是精英阶层间相互竞争的年代，贵族们通过资助教堂和其他建筑的修建来扩大自身影响力。
construction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

construction.sentenceEn: The construction firm breached the contract.
construction.translationZh: 这家建筑公司违反了合同。

controversial.sentenceEn: If you read an article about a controversial issue, do you think you'd realise if it had changed your beliefs?
controversial.translationZh: 如果你读了一篇关于某个争议性问题的文章，你认为自己会意识到它是否改变了你的信念吗？
controversial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

controversial.sentenceEn: They may also worry about whether the public will understand their findings, or about findings being used to influence controversial policies.
controversial.translationZh: 他们还可能担心公众是否能够理解他们的研究结果，或者担心这些结果被用于影响有争议的政策。
controversial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

controversial.sentenceEn: The most controversial aspect of Marconi's life—and the reason why there has been no satisfying biography of Marconi until now—was his uncritical embrace of Benito Mussolini.
controversial.translationZh: 马可尼一生中最具争议的方面——也是迄今为止一直没有令人满意的马可尼传记的原因——是他对贝尼托·墨索里尼不加批判的拥护。

controversial.sentenceEn: With me today is Meghan Brown, an environmental activist whose controversial new book Beyond Recycling is making headlines.
controversial.translationZh: 今天与我一同做客节目的是梅根·布朗，她是一位环保活动家，其颇具争议的新书《超越回收》正占据各大头条。
controversial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

controversial.sentenceEn: What can we learn about the "interesting and controversial " finding?
controversial.translationZh: 关于这个“有趣且有争议的”发现，我们能了解到什么？

controversial.sentenceEn: It is controversial whether the goal of the whole world's exclusive dependence on renewables is attainable.
controversial.translationZh: 全世界完全依赖可再生能源这一目标是否能够实现，存在争议。

coverage.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, the agency's initial claim that livestock was responsible for the lion's share of world greenhouse gas emissions had already received wide coverage .
coverage.translationZh: 不幸的是，该机构最初声称畜牧业是全球温室气体排放的主要来源，这一说法已得到广泛报道。

coverage.sentenceEn: I pointed out this flaw during a speech to fellow scientists in San Francisco on March 22, 2010, which led to a flood of media coverage .
coverage.translationZh: 2010年3月22日，我在旧金山向同行科学家发表演讲时指出了这一缺陷，随后引发了媒体的广泛报道。

coverage.sentenceEn: These stories in people in low-income countries simply don't make for exciting news coverage .
coverage.translationZh: 低收入国家人民的这些故事很难成为新闻报道的亮点。
coverage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

coverage.sentenceEn: The move was a switch to leverage on the coverage of their fashion week show to make stock available immediately to consumers.
coverage.translationZh: 此举转变了策略，旨在利用时装周秀场的曝光度，让消费者能够立即购买到相关库存商品。

coverage.sentenceEn: Bills to expand Medicare coverage of telemedicine have bipartisan(两党的) support in Congress.
coverage.translationZh: 扩大联邦医疗保险远程医疗覆盖范围的法案在国会获得了两党支持。

coverage.sentenceEn: It connects many other specialties with its broad coverage .
coverage.translationZh: 它覆盖面广，连接了许多其他专业领域。

crash.sentenceEn: In the 1930s, prices crashed , to the point that in some parts of the country oil was cheaper than water.
crash.translationZh: 20世纪30年代，石油价格暴跌，以至于在美国部分地区，石油比水还要便宜。
crash.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

crash.sentenceEn: If the wooden frame of the towers had caught fire, it could have sent the bells—the largest of which, the Emmanuel Bell, weighs 13 tons— crashing down, potentially causing the collapse of both towers.
crash.translationZh: 如果塔楼的木质框架起火，就可能导致这些钟——其中最大的“ Emmanuel 钟”重达13吨——轰然坠落，进而可能造成两座塔楼坍塌。

crash.sentenceEn: Once she dreamed that the flight she was due to take the following day crashed .
crash.translationZh: 有一次她梦见自己第二天要乘坐的航班坠毁了。
crash.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

crash.translationZh: 那架飞机根本就没坠毁。
crash.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第8句

crash.sentenceEn: Had the bell towers' wooden frames burned down, the heavy bells would have crashed down.
crash.translationZh: 如果钟楼的木质框架被烧毁，沉重的钟就会坠落。

crash.sentenceEn: She dreamed of a plane crash .

curious.sentenceEn: In the city of Athens, Georgia, there exists a rather curious local landmark—a large white oak that is almost universally stated to own itself.
curious.translationZh: 在美国乔治亚州的雅典市，有一处颇为奇特的当地地标——一棵巨大的白橡树，据称这棵树几乎是名副其实地拥有自己。

curious.sentenceEn: Ageing is a curious thing and people's desire to beat it—and death—has become an industry worth hundreds of billions of dollars.
curious.translationZh: 衰老是一件奇妙的事情，而人们战胜衰老——乃至死亡——的渴望已催生了一个价值数千亿美元的产业。
curious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

curious.sentenceEn: Teachers and students alike have experienced the curious paradox that beginners, as a rule, tend to think too little about what they are doing because they think too much about what they are doing.
curious.translationZh: 师生们都曾经历过一个奇怪的悖论：通常来说，初学者往往对自己正在做的事思考得太少，因为他们对自己正在做的事思考得太多。
curious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

curious.sentenceEn: M: And it's refreshing to see a strong, curious , clever woman adding her voice to the scientific discourse in a field that has been traditionally dominated by men.
curious.translationZh: 男：而且，在一个传统上由男性主导的领域，能看到一位坚强、充满好奇心且聪慧的女性为科学对话贡献自己的声音，真是令人耳目一新。
curious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

curious.sentenceEn: The knowledge she collected over decades didn't just satisfy those curious about nature, but also provided valuable insights into medicine and science.
curious.translationZh: 她数十年间积累的知识不仅满足了那些对自然充满好奇的人，也为医学和科学领域提供了宝贵的见解。

curious.sentenceEn: Be kind to and curious about those who we happen to meet in our lives.
curious.translationZh: 对生命中偶然相遇的人，要心怀善意与好奇。

cafe.sentenceEn: We have a cafe & library upstairs and a ticket office down the hall, where you can buy tickets to all the major jazz concerts in the city.
cafe.translationZh: 楼上设有咖啡馆和图书馆，走廊尽头有票务办公室，您可以在那里购买本市所有重要爵士乐音乐会的门票。
cafe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

cafe.sentenceEn: M: Well, it's certainly the first time I've heard of a cafe like that.
cafe.translationZh: 男：嗯，我确实是第一次听说这样的咖啡馆。
cafe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

cafe.sentenceEn: W: We saw other cafes with cats in them.
cafe.translationZh: 我们看到过其他咖啡馆有猫咪。
cafe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

cafe.sentenceEn: So please tell us, why did you decide to open a cafe ?
cafe.translationZh: 那么请告诉我们，您当初为什么决定开一家咖啡馆呢？
cafe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

cafe.sentenceEn: On the contrary, the Parisian Cafe offers a great experience for children, a chance for them to learn about rabbits and how to take care of them.
cafe.translationZh: 恰恰相反，巴黎咖啡馆为孩子们提供了很棒的体验，让他们有机会了解兔子以及如何照顾它们。
cafe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第7句

cafe.sentenceEn: How does the Parisian cafe guarantee that its rabbits pose no health threat?
cafe.translationZh: 巴黎咖啡馆如何保证其兔子不构成健康威胁？

circulation.sentenceEn: The government keeps a steady supply of approximately two billion bills in circulation at all times.
circulation.translationZh: 美国政府始终保持着约20亿张纸币的稳定流通量。
circulation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

circulation.sentenceEn: Then there were the face slimming rollers that were said to improve your blood circulation and make your face smaller.
circulation.translationZh: 还有一种瘦脸滚轮，据说可以改善血液循环，让脸变小。
circulation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

circulation.sentenceEn: Acupuncture points are stimulated to balance the circulation of qi.
circulation.translationZh: 刺激穴位是为了平衡气血运行。
circulation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第10句

circulation.sentenceEn: The immediate effect of printing was to increase the circulation of works that were already popular in a handwritten form, while less popular works went out of circulation .
circulation.translationZh: 印刷术的直接影响是增加了那些已经以手写形式流行的作品的传播，而不太受欢迎的作品则不再流传。
circulation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

circulation.sentenceEn: Multiply $3 by the more than 5 billion magstripe credit and prepaid cards in circulation in the U.S.
circulation.translationZh: 将3美元乘以美国流通中的50多亿张磁条信用卡和预付卡

circulation.sentenceEn: There is some indication of an issue with his blood circulation .
circulation.translationZh: 有迹象表明他的血液循环存在问题。

colony.sentenceEn: He was probably stationed in this provincial trading port founded in 46 B.C. as a colony for veterans of the Roman army.
colony.translationZh: 他很可能被派驻在这座建于公元前46年的省级贸易港口，这里曾是罗马军队老兵的殖民地。
colony.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

colony.sentenceEn: The study by Greenpeace analysed the movements of krill fishing vessels in the region and found they were increasingly operating "in the immediate vicinity of penguin colonies and whale-feeding grounds".
colony.translationZh: 绿色和平组织的这项研究分析了该区域磷虾捕捞船的活动轨迹，发现这些船只越来越多地在“企鹅栖息地和鲸鱼觅食区的紧邻范围内”作业。
colony.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

colony.sentenceEn: He said although more fishing was taking place nearer penguin colonies it was often happening later in the season when these colonies were empty.
colony.translationZh: 他表示，尽管在企鹅聚居地附近的捕捞活动有所增加，但这类捕捞通常发生在季节后期，此时这些聚居地已不再有企鹅栖息。
colony.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

colony.sentenceEn: And as the distance between their breeding grounds and their food grows, entire colonies could be wiped out.
colony.translationZh: 而随着它们的繁殖地与食物来源之间的距离不断增加，整个种群可能会被彻底灭绝。
colony.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

colony.sentenceEn: Only a handful of islands in the Southern Ocean are suitable for sustaining large breeding colonies .
colony.translationZh: 南大洋中仅有少数岛屿适合维持大型繁殖群体。
colony.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

colony.sentenceEn: Keep the penguin colonies from all fishing interference.
colony.translationZh: 避免企鹅栖息地受到任何渔业活动的干扰。

commodity.sentenceEn: The artist Jenny Odell argues that in our "attention economy" human attention has been transformed into a commodity that big corporations buy and sell.
commodity.translationZh: 艺术家珍妮·奥德尔认为，在我们的“注意力经济”时代，人类的注意力已被转化为一种大公司买卖的商品。
commodity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

commodity.sentenceEn: M: Time is a very precious commodity right now.
commodity.translationZh: 男士：现在时间是非常宝贵的资源。
commodity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

commodity.sentenceEn: There is scarcely a single commodity in any American household that isn't dependent for its manufacture and sale, through one supply chain or another, on scores of different people spread out across the entire globe.
commodity.translationZh: 美国家庭中的任何一种商品，其生产和销售几乎都要通过这样或那样的供应链，依赖遍布全球的众多不同人员。

commodity.sentenceEn: But it's a narrative often drowned out by the shame that marketers rely on to peddle us their diet pills, miracle face creams and breathable yoga pants—as if self-love is a purchasable commodity .
commodity.translationZh: 但这种叙述常常被商家利用的羞耻感所淹没——他们向我们兜售减肥药、神奇面霜和透气 yoga 裤，仿佛自爱成了一种可以购买的商品。
commodity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

commodity.sentenceEn: In this oversubscribed society, experience becomes a commodity like any other.
commodity.translationZh: 在这个资源过度拥挤的社会中，体验如同其他任何商品一样被商品化了。
commodity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

commodity.sentenceEn: Few commodities in American homes are not reliant on people abroad in the process of manufacture and sale.
commodity.translationZh: 美国家庭中，很少有商品在生产和销售过程中不依赖国外人员。

confine.sentenceEn: For research to serve its full purpose, the results must leave the confines of research laboratories and academic journals.
confine.translationZh: 要让研究充分发挥其目的，研究结果必须走出研究实验室和学术期刊的局限。
confine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

confine.sentenceEn: The dominance of television was not confined to our living rooms.
confine.translationZh: 电视的主导地位并不局限于我们的客厅。
confine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

confine.sentenceEn: They were confined to the university or research center where they worked.
confine.translationZh: 他们局限于自己工作的大学或研究中心。
confine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

confine.sentenceEn: It's an approach not dictated by the confines of conventional, large-scale agriculture led by international corporations.
confine.translationZh: 这种方法不受国际公司主导的传统大规模农业模式的局限。
confine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

confine.sentenceEn: The rest is feed-lot confined and fed grain and corn.
confine.translationZh: 其余的野牛则被关在饲养场，喂食谷物和玉米。

confine.sentenceEn: Ascertain whether deferring to authority was confined to right-wing people.
confine.translationZh: 确定是否只有右翼人士才会盲从权威。

construct.sentenceEn: To construct the robot, the researchers used a shape-memory alloy material that transforms to its remembered shape when heated.
construct.translationZh: 为了制造这个机器人，研究人员使用了一种形状记忆合金材料，这种材料在受热时会恢复到其记忆的形状。
construct.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

construct.sentenceEn: This is why it's important to experience diverse cultures and their artifacts because it opens us up to different ways of approaching or constructing beauty.
construct.translationZh: 这就是为什么体验多元文化及其产物如此重要——因为它能让我们接触到欣赏和构建美的不同方式。
construct.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

construct.sentenceEn: There are three hot springs in Bath; one is the King's Spring, upon which the Roman Baths and a temple were constructed .
construct.translationZh: 巴斯有三处温泉：一处是国王泉，罗马浴场和一座神庙就建在它的旁边。
construct.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

construct.sentenceEn: One casualty of this was The Great Organ constructed in the 1730s, which was said to have escaped the flames but been significantly damaged by water.
construct.translationZh: 其中一个牺牲品是建于18世纪30年代的大风琴，据称它躲过了火焰，但遭到了水的严重损坏。

construct.sentenceEn: Why were the Viking churches constructed from wood?
construct.translationZh: 为什么维京教堂是用木材建造的？

construct.sentenceEn: Invest in constructing more recycling facilities.
construct.translationZh: 投资建设更多回收设施。

counter.sentenceEn: It's also a way to help counter perceptions of local crops as "old or poor people's food" or as inferior "women's crops", adds Tan.
counter.translationZh: 谭补充道，这也是一种有助于改变人们对本地作物的看法的方式——不再将其视为“老年人或穷人的食物”，或次等的“女性作物”。

counter.sentenceEn: One possible way to counter those negative effects is talking while watching the screen.
counter.translationZh: 应对这些负面影响的一个可能方法是边看屏幕边交谈。
counter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

counter.sentenceEn: And, they countered that no negative effects of bilingual education have been found.
counter.translationZh: 此外，他们反驳称，尚未发现双语教育存在任何负面影响。

counter.sentenceEn: To counter the fears of disaster, we need to identify stories, visions and actions that work quietly towards a more hopeful future.
counter.translationZh: 为了对抗对灾难的恐惧，我们需要找出那些默默致力于创造更充满希望的未来的故事、愿景和行动。

counter.sentenceEn: They can usually be found in the ticket counter area interacting with travelers.
counter.translationZh: 它们通常会出现在票务柜台区域，与旅客们互动。
counter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

counter.sentenceEn: After the Snowden incident, Apple made clear its position to counter government intrusion into personal data by means of encryption.
counter.translationZh: 斯诺登事件后，苹果明确了其通过加密手段对抗政府侵入个人数据的立场。

cast.sentenceEn: If there's a tie, and we can't come to an agreement, then we'll take it to John and let him cast the deciding vote.
cast.translationZh: 如果出现意见分歧，我们无法达成一致，那么我们会把问题提交给约翰，由他投出决定性的一票。
cast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第2句

cast.sentenceEn: Negative energy can then cast a shadow over your efforts to build a shared understanding.
cast.translationZh: 负能量会给你建立共识的努力蒙上阴影。
cast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

cast.sentenceEn: Schellenberg took that news in stride while continuing to cast a skeptical eye on the research in his field.
cast.translationZh: 舍伦贝格从容接受了这一结果，同时继续对其所在领域的研究持怀疑态度。

cast.sentenceEn: In Atomic Habits, I wrote, "Humans are herd animals. We want to fit in, to bond with others, and to earn the respect and approval of our peers. Such inclinations are essential to our survival. For most of our evolutionary history, our ancestors lived in tribes. Becoming separated from the tribe—or worse, being cast out—was a death sentence."
cast.translationZh: 在《原子习惯》一书中，我写道：“人类是群居动物。我们渴望融入群体、与他人建立联系，并获得同伴的尊重与认可。这些倾向对我们的生存至关重要。在人类进化史的大部分时间里，我们的祖先都生活在部落中。脱离部落——或者更糟的是被驱逐出去——无异于被判死刑。”

cast.sentenceEn: If Paris was cast aside, the tradition of beauty was also to some degree slighted.
cast.translationZh: 如果抛弃了巴黎（的时尚模式），那么对美的传统追求在某种程度上也会受到轻视。
cast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

cast.sentenceEn: Ask the board to cast the deciding vote.
cast.translationZh: 请董事会进行决定性投票。

causal.sentenceEn: They can generalize such abstract concepts as causal relationships and social roles from just a few examples.
causal.translationZh: 他们仅从少数几个例子中就能归纳出因果关系和社会角色等抽象概念。
causal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

causal.sentenceEn: His study didn't examine the causal reasons for its rise, but he assumes that the rise of both standardized testing and social media might play a role.
causal.translationZh: 他的研究并未探究其上升的原因，但他认为标准化考试和社交媒体的兴起可能起到了一定作用。

causal.sentenceEn: At best there is a weak statistical association and not a causal link between DNA and intelligence.
causal.translationZh: 充其量而言，DNA与智力之间只存在微弱的统计关联，而非因果关系。
causal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

causal.sentenceEn: After computing their assessments, Schellenberg concluded that the majority of the articles erroneously claimed that music training had a causal effect.
causal.translationZh: 在对评估结果进行统计分析后，舍伦贝格得出结论：大多数文章错误地宣称音乐训练具有因果效应。

causal.sentenceEn: "Most of these studies don't allow for causal inferences," he said.
causal.translationZh: 他说：“大多数这类研究都无法得出因果推论。”

causal.sentenceEn: Glenn Schellenberg's latest research suggests many psychologists and neuroscientists wrongly believe in the causal relationship between music and IQ.
causal.translationZh: 格伦·舍伦贝格的最新研究表明，许多心理学家和神经科学家错误地相信音乐与智商之间存在因果关系。

centenarian.sentenceEn: In 2000, the top five causes of death for centenarians were heart disease, stroke, flu, cancer and Alzheimer's disease.
centenarian.translationZh: 2000年，百岁老人的五大主要死因是心脏病、中风、流感、癌症和阿尔茨海默病。
centenarian.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

centenarian.sentenceEn: But because this population is getting larger, the number of deaths in this group is also increasing—18,434 centenarians died in 2000, whereas 25,914 died in 2014.
centenarian.translationZh: 但由于这一人群规模不断扩大，该群体的死亡人数也在增加——2000年有18,434位百岁老人去世，而2014年这一数字为25,914人。
centenarian.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

centenarian.sentenceEn: But by 2014, the death rate from Alzheimer's disease for this age group had more than doubled—increasing from 3.8 percent to 8.5 percent—making the progressive brain disease the second leading cause of death for centenarians .
centenarian.translationZh: 但到2014年，该年龄段人群的阿尔茨海默病死亡率已增加一倍以上——从3.8%升至8.5%——这使得这种进行性脑部疾病成为百岁老人的第二大死亡原因。
centenarian.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

centenarian.sentenceEn: Overall, the total number of centenarians is going up.
centenarian.translationZh: 总体而言，百岁老人的总数正在上升。
centenarian.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

centenarian.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say about the risk of dying for American centenarians in recent years?
centenarian.translationZh: 关于近年来美国百岁老人的死亡风险，讲话者说了什么？

centenarian.sentenceEn: It is now the second leading cause of death for centenarians .
centenarian.translationZh: 它现已成为百岁老人的第二大死因。

ceremony.sentenceEn: A couple of months later, an official ceremony was held featuring none other than the Mayor of Athens, Robert L McWhorter, to commemorate the occasion.
ceremony.translationZh: 几个月后，一场官方仪式隆重举行，雅典市长罗伯特·L·麦克沃特亲自出席，以纪念这一时刻。

ceremony.sentenceEn: I was lucky enough to attend the award ceremony as Gregory's guest.
ceremony.translationZh: 我有幸以Gregory的嘉宾身份参加了颁奖典礼。
ceremony.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第2句

ceremony.sentenceEn: In 2012, the city planned an opening ceremony .
ceremony.translationZh: 2012年，柏林市曾计划举办一场启用典礼。
ceremony.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

ceremony.sentenceEn: Next the ceremony focuses on remembering those who have died.
ceremony.translationZh: 接下来，仪式的重点是缅怀逝者。
ceremony.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

ceremony.sentenceEn: An official ceremony was held to celebrate the transplanting of a small tree to where its ancestor had stood.
ceremony.translationZh: 官方举行了一场仪式，庆祝将一棵小树移栽到其先祖曾生长的地方。

ceremony.sentenceEn: While holding a burial ceremony for a pet mouse, they were killing pest mice.
ceremony.translationZh: 他们在为一只宠物鼠举行葬礼的同时，却在消灭那些害鼠。

civic.sentenceEn: Surely the purpose of university is to prepare young people to participate fully in civic life, rather than just to find well-paid jobs.
civic.translationZh: 大学的目的当然是培养年轻人充分参与公民生活，而不仅仅是找到高薪工作。
civic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

civic.sentenceEn: "Over the last 50 years, public interest and civic responsibility have been progressively eroded," they write, "replaced by a focus on self-interest and competition in a supposedly free and open marketplace."
civic.translationZh: 他们写道：“在过去50年中，公共利益和公民责任感逐渐被侵蚀，取而代之的是在所谓自由开放的市场中对个人利益和竞争的关注。”

civic.sentenceEn: Arbor Day became a legal, civic holiday in the state in 1885.
civic.translationZh: 1885年，植树节成为该州的法定公民节日。
civic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

civic.sentenceEn: Such charges ignore the fact that these institutions continue to prepare students for success in their work, for thoughtful engagement in civic life, for lifelong learning, and for understanding the world and those with whom they live.
civic.translationZh: 这些指责忽视了一个事实：这些院校一直在为学生的职业成功、积极参与公民生活、终身学习以及理解世界和身边的人做好准备。
civic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

civic.sentenceEn: In the past, the young have eagerly participated in national service and civic affairs, often with lots of energy and idealism.
civic.translationZh: 过去，年轻人曾热切地参与国家服务和公民事务，往往充满活力与理想主义。

civic.sentenceEn: They have been actively engaged in civic life beyond the school campus.
civic.translationZh: 他们在校外积极参与公民生活。

clip.sentenceEn: The results showed that those who'd watched a rags-to-riches clip did indeed have a significantly greater belief in the American Dream.
clip.translationZh: 结果显示，那些观看了白手起家片段的人确实对美国梦抱有明显更强的信念。
clip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

clip.sentenceEn: To find out, Kim's team had participants watch a 5-minute clip from a reality show with a rags-to-riches storyline.
clip.translationZh: 为了找到答案，金的团队让参与者观看了一段5分钟的真人秀片段，内容讲述了一个白手起家的故事。
clip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

clip.sentenceEn: Control participants watched a clip from a reality show that didn't have a rags-to-riches story.
clip.translationZh: 对照组参与者观看了一段没有白手起家故事的真人秀片段。
clip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

clip.sentenceEn: Some of this discrepancy could be because the observers used only audio clips , and thus could not read cues like body language, but there are probably other explanations, as people should be able to hear when a participant is being kind versus being rude.
clip.translationZh: 这种差异的部分原因可能是观察者仅使用了音频片段，因此无法读取肢体语言等线索，但可能还有其他解释，因为人们应该能够听出参与者表现得友善还是粗鲁。
clip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

clip.sentenceEn: Six laboratory assistants rated each participant's audio clips to see how their observations compared with people's assessment of themselves.
clip.translationZh: 六位实验室助理对每位参与者的音频片段进行了评分，以比较他们的观察结果与参与者的自我评估。
clip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

clip.sentenceEn: Yet, adversely, those who listened to the critical audio clips were noted as having a higher heart rate and sweat response afterwards, both of which signify feelings of threat and distress.
clip.translationZh: 然而，相反的是，那些听过批评性音频片段的参与者随后被发现心率更高，出汗反应更强烈，这两种反应都表明存在威胁感和痛苦情绪。
clip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

colonial.sentenceEn: The tradition dates back to colonial times when inns were few and far between, and the weary traveler had to depend on the kindness of strangers for a meal and a bed.
colonial.translationZh: 这一传统可以追溯到殖民时代，那时旅店寥寥无几，疲惫的旅行者不得不依靠陌生人的善意来换取一顿热饭和一张床铺。
colonial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

colonial.sentenceEn: " Colonial powers said you can't grow that because there's no oil. We can't get a market for it."
colonial.translationZh: 殖民列强说你不能种那个，因为它不能产油。我们无法为它找到市场。

colonial.sentenceEn: The bambara groundnut, a protein-rich native crop of sub-Saharan Africa that is also grown in parts of southeast Asia, can trace its marginalisation to colonial rule.
colonial.translationZh: 班巴拉花生是撒哈拉以南非洲的一种富含蛋白质的本土作物，在东南亚部分地区也有种植，其边缘化可以追溯到殖民统治时期。

colonial.sentenceEn: Cape Canaveral contains one of the greatest concentrations of colonial shipwrecks in the world.
colonial.translationZh: 卡纳维拉尔角拥有世界上最密集的殖民时期沉船遗址之一。

colonial.sentenceEn: He was able to do this because of a combination of factors—most important, timing and opportunity—but the single-mindedness and determination with which he carried out his self-imposed mission was fundamentally character-based; millions of Marconi's contemporaries had the same class, gender, race, and colonial privilege as he, but only a handful did anything with it.
colonial.translationZh: 他之所以能做到这一点，是多种因素共同作用的结果——其中最重要的是时机和机遇——但他执行自我设定使命时所展现的专注与决心，本质上源于他的性格特质。与马可尼同时代的数百万人拥有与他相同的阶级、性别、种族和殖民特权，但只有极少数人能善用这些优势。

colonial.sentenceEn: Colonial rule marginalised local crops by punishing Africans who grew them.
colonial.translationZh: 殖民统治通过惩罚种植本地作物的非洲人，使这些作物逐渐被边缘化。

commuter.sentenceEn: In an experiment, commuters who talked to nearby strangers found their commute more enjoyable than those who didn't.
commuter.translationZh: 在一项实验中，与身边陌生人交流的通勤者发现他们的通勤体验比不交流的人更愉快。
commuter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

commuter.sentenceEn: As part of the upgrading of its rail yard, Castleman, who is an inventor and self-proclaimed steam visionary, is campaigning for a new steam train that runs without any fire and could run on an existing 10-kilometre line, drawing tourists and perhaps offering city commuters a green alternative to their cars.
commuter.translationZh: 作为其铁路货场升级改造的一部分，身为发明家和自封的蒸汽梦想家的卡斯尔曼正在倡议建造一种无需燃烧燃料的新型蒸汽火车。这种火车可以在现有的10公里线路上运行，既能吸引游客，也可能为城市通勤者提供一种绿色的汽车替代方案。
commuter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

commuter.sentenceEn: Second, there is the New York of the commuter , the city that is swallowed up by locusts each day and spat out each night.
commuter.translationZh: 第二种是通勤族的纽约——这座城市每天被如蝗虫般涌入的人群吞噬，夜晚又将他们尽数吐出。
commuter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

commuter.sentenceEn: Commuters give the city its tidal restlessness; natives give it solidity and continuity; but the settlers give it passion.
commuter.translationZh: 通勤族赋予这座城市潮汐般的躁动；本地人赋予它沉稳与延续；而外来的定居者则赋予它激情。
commuter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

commuter.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say commuters give to New York?
commuter.translationZh: 演讲者说通勤者给纽约带来了什么？

commuter.sentenceEn: It served more and more commuters .
commuter.translationZh: 它服务的通勤者越来越多。

companion.sentenceEn: Humans then bred dogs with the most desirable and useful traits so that they could function as companions and workers.
companion.translationZh: 随后，人类开始培育具有最理想和最有用特质的狗，使它们能够充当伴侣和工作伙伴。
companion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

companion.sentenceEn: On one very rough ferry crossing, on the route to the Isles of Scilly, for example, my traveling companion spent the entire 3-hour-ride throwing up in the bathroom, while I dozed happily on a plastic chair.
companion.translationZh: 例如，在一次前往锡利群岛的颠簸渡轮旅程中，我的旅伴在卫生间里吐了整整3个小时，而我却在塑料椅子上睡得很香。
companion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

companion.sentenceEn: Dogs do know when their human companions are having a rough time.
companion.translationZh: 狗狗确实知道它们的人类伙伴什么时候正经历艰难时期。
companion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

companion.sentenceEn: He may be slow to make friends, perhaps content with only one companion .
companion.translationZh: 老大可能不轻易结交朋友，或许有一个同伴就心满意足了。
companion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

companion.sentenceEn: Now, the only apparent cost to taking infinite photos of something as common as a meal is the space on your hard drive and your dining companion 's patience.
companion.translationZh: 而如今，为一顿再平常不过的饭菜拍下无数照片，唯一明显的代价不过是占用硬盘空间，以及消耗 dining companion 的耐心。
companion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

companion.sentenceEn: They could be domesticated to act as our companions .
companion.translationZh: 它们可以被驯化成为我们的伴侣。

compassion.sentenceEn: As uncomfortable as it may be to continuously receive, if you can respond with compassion , the situation will likely defuse much faster.
compassion.translationZh: 尽管不断面对这些可能会让人感到不适，但如果你能以慈悲之心回应，情况往往会更快得到缓解。
compassion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

compassion.sentenceEn: Practicing self-compassion increases your resilience(韧性), emotional intelligence, compassion toward others, and can boost your performance as well as help you develop a growth mindset.
compassion.translationZh: 练习自我同情能增强你的韧性、情商以及对他人的同理心，同时还能提升你的表现，并帮助你培养成长型思维。

compassion.sentenceEn: The gift of mindfulness is a practice of listening with compassion to others describe their experiences.
compassion.translationZh: 正念的馈赠，是一种怀揣慈悲之心，倾听他人描述其经历的修行。
compassion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

compassion.sentenceEn: Additionally, a human trainer can add compassion to the workout.
compassion.translationZh: 此外，人类教练可以为锻炼增添一份关怀。
compassion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第19句

compassion.sentenceEn: The sense is that for people prone to depression, meeting their negative thoughts and feelings with compassion is a radically different way; that these thoughts are not facts.
compassion.translationZh: 我们的体会是，对于易患抑郁症的人而言，以同情心面对自己的消极想法和感受是一种截然不同的方式；要明白这些想法并非事实。
compassion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

compassion.sentenceEn: It's important to cultivate forgiveness by developing compassion for the offender, reflect on whether the act was due to malicious intent, or whether it was caused by challenging circumstances in the offender's life.
compassion.translationZh: 培养宽恕的重要方式是对冒犯者产生同理心，反思其行为是出于恶意，还是源于其生活中的困境。
compassion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

compensate.sentenceEn: But recent studies show that 70% of American adults have lost the ability to naturally compensate for the calories they consume; worse still, a significant number of them report diminishing hunger halfway through an eating session, but, by the end of the meal, they feel the same or higher levels of hunger than when they sat down.
compensate.translationZh: 但最近的研究表明，70%的美国成年人已经失去了对所摄入卡路里进行自然代偿的能力；更糟糕的是，相当一部分人表示，在进食过程中饥饿感会有所减轻，但用餐结束时，他们的饥饿感却与坐下就餐时相同，甚至更强烈。
compensate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

compensate.sentenceEn: Higher prices, called price premiums, can be justified as a way to compensate farmers for providing ecosystem services and avoiding environmental damage or external costs.
compensate.translationZh: 被称为溢价的较高价格是合理的，这是对农民提供生态系统服务以及避免环境破坏或外部成本的一种补偿方式。
compensate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

compensate.sentenceEn: Picture this scenario: You often drive for work and can be compensated for up to 400 miles per month.
compensate.translationZh: 想象这样一个场景：你经常开车上班，每月最多可以报销400英里的车程费用。
compensate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

compensate.sentenceEn: Even if they get online traffic, they struggle to make enough money online to compensate for what they are losing offline.
compensate.translationZh: 即便获得了线上流量，它们也难以通过线上盈利来弥补线下业务的损失。

compensate.sentenceEn: One main factor that has driven up medical expenses is that doctors are compensated for the amount of care rather than its effect.
compensate.translationZh: 推高医疗费用的一个主要因素是，医生的薪酬取决于诊疗量而非诊疗效果。

compensate.sentenceEn: Its benefits may compensate for the adverse environmental consequences.
compensate.translationZh: 其益处或许能弥补不利的环境后果。

complexity.sentenceEn: The rise of the mobile phone has recently added a new level of complexity to the process of retail reinvention.
complexity.translationZh: 近年来，移动电话的兴起为零售业的转型过程增添了新的复杂层面。

complexity.sentenceEn: While human achievements in mathematics continue to reach new levels of complexity , many of us who aren't mathematicians at heart (or engineers by trade) may struggle to remember the last time we used calculus(微积分).
complexity.translationZh: 尽管人类在数学领域的成就不断达到新的复杂高度，但我们中许多并非天生数学家（或职业工程师）的人，可能很难记起上一次使用微积分是什么时候。
complexity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

complexity.sentenceEn: An open-science stance can also add complexity to a collaboration.
complexity.translationZh: 开放科学的立场也会给合作增加复杂性。

complexity.sentenceEn: Imagine how intimidating it can be for prospective students unfamiliar with the complexities of higher education to navigate this kind of information and then identify which schools are the best fit.
complexity.translationZh: 试想一下，对于不熟悉高等教育复杂性的准大学生来说，要梳理这类信息并确定哪些学校最适合自己，该是多么令人却步。

complexity.sentenceEn: While that may make suborbital travel safer, it would add significant cost and complexity to an emerging industry that has until now operated largely as the playground of billionaires and dreamy engineers.
complexity.translationZh: 尽管这可能会提高亚轨道旅行的安全性，但它将给这个新兴行业带来显著的成本增加和复杂性，而该行业迄今为止在很大程度上一直是亿万富翁和充满梦想的工程师们的游乐场。
complexity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

complexity.sentenceEn: It involves many aspects with great complexity .
complexity.translationZh: 这涉及多个方面，且极其复杂。

compromise.sentenceEn: "Right now people compromise on choice. We're presented with a one-size-fits-all menu. Ultimately, technology can allow us to make personal choices. You love spicy food and chicken? Here's the dish people like you mostly order," says Tom Weaver, CEO at the hospitality tech company Flyt.
compromise.translationZh: 餐饮科技公司 Flyt 的首席执行官汤姆·韦弗（Tom Weaver）表示：“目前人们在选择上有所妥协。我们面对的是千篇一律的菜单。而技术最终能让我们做出个性化的选择。你喜欢辣味和鸡肉？那么这道菜就是像你这样的人最常点的。”

compromise.sentenceEn: If you follow all of the guidelines, you need to use a different password for every one of your accounts; use an incomprehensible variety of letters, numbers, and symbols; sign up for two-step verification; and change every password every time one of them is compromised .
compromise.translationZh: 如果您遵循所有安全准则，就需要为每个账户设置不同的密码；使用由字母、数字和符号组合而成的难以理解的密码；启用两步验证；并且每当某个密码泄露时，都要更改所有密码。
compromise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

compromise.sentenceEn: And if they appeal to these outlets, do they risk compromising the integrity or the intelligence of the music?
compromise.translationZh: 而如果这些高等艺术机构迎合这类媒体平台，是否会面临损害音乐的完整性或艺术性的风险？

compromise.sentenceEn: M: No, I wouldn't ever compromise on the essential, the ideas or the themes.
compromise.translationZh: 不，对于那些核心要素，比如想法或主题，我绝不会妥协。
compromise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

compromise.sentenceEn: Higher institutions will be concerned about compromising the integrity of classical music if they have to resort to the television medium.
compromise.translationZh: 如果高等音乐机构不得不借助电视媒介，它们将会担心这会损害古典音乐的完整性。

compromise.sentenceEn: Both supporters and opponents should make compromises .
compromise.translationZh: 支持者和反对者双方都应做出妥协。

confused.sentenceEn: So I can relate to author Anneli Rufus, who wrote in *Party of One: The Loners' Manifesto*: "When parents on TV shows punished their kids by ordering them to go to their rooms, I was confused .
confused.translationZh: 所以我能理解作家安妮莉·鲁弗斯，她在《孤独者宣言》中写道：“当电视节目里的父母惩罚孩子，命令他们回自己房间时，我感到很困惑。

confused.sentenceEn: People with dementia have more serious problems, like feeling confused or getting lost in a familiar place.
confused.translationZh: 痴呆症患者则面临更严重的问题，例如感到困惑或在熟悉的地方迷路。

confused.sentenceEn: The woman, clearly confused , retreated into the public library.
confused.translationZh: 那个女人显然有些神志不清，退回了公共图书馆。
confused.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

confused.sentenceEn: I explained to my student that I actually thought he was rather more confused than I was and I argued back, but what was really important about that was the universities stand out as places that really are about the authority of ideas.
confused.translationZh: 我向这位学生解释说，其实我觉得他比我更困惑，于是我反驳了他的观点。但真正重要的是，大学之所以与众不同，正是因为它们是真正崇尚思想权威的地方。
confused.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

confused.sentenceEn: Such difficult economic times may leave many adolescents confused about their roles in society.
confused.translationZh: 如此艰难的经济时期可能会让许多青少年对自己在社会中的角色感到困惑。
confused.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

confused.sentenceEn: Chances are, you included things like happy, sad, excited, angry, afraid, grateful, proud, scared, confused , stressed, relaxed and amazed.
confused.translationZh: 你的清单上可能会有开心、难过、兴奋、生气、害怕、感激、自豪、恐惧、困惑、紧张、放松和惊讶等情绪。
confused.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

consciousness.sentenceEn: Does the group you belong to have a strong collective consciousness or shared beliefs?
consciousness.translationZh: 你所属的群体是否具有强烈的集体意识或共同信念？
consciousness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

consciousness.sentenceEn: They've become so embedded in our consciousness that people think it's absurd to think otherwise.
consciousness.translationZh: 它们已深深植根于我们的意识中，以至于人们认为任何不同的想法都是荒谬的。
consciousness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

consciousness.sentenceEn: The false consciousness that this paradox generates causes havoc on the debates we have about free trade.
consciousness.translationZh: 这种悖论所产生的错误认知，对我们关于自由贸易的辩论造成了严重破坏。

consciousness.sentenceEn: No sense of the dependence of our own material welfare on their work ever strikes our national consciousness .
consciousness.translationZh: 我们的民族意识从未意识到，我们自身的物质福利竟如此依赖于他们的劳动。

consciousness.sentenceEn: Gratitude for the anonymous men and women who make up the supply chain rarely makes its way into our consciousness .
consciousness.translationZh: 我们很少会想到要感谢那些构成供应链的无名男女。

consciousness.sentenceEn: It's a matter of false consciousness .
consciousness.translationZh: 这是一个虚假意识的问题。

consequently.sentenceEn: Consequently , individuality and autonomy are sacrificed to maintain the unity of the group.
consequently.translationZh: 因此，为了维持团体的统一，个性和自主权被牺牲掉了。
consequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

consequently.sentenceEn: Consequently , trade as a topic of discussion provides an opportunity for liberals and populists to have a real meeting of minds.
consequently.translationZh: 因此，将贸易作为讨论话题为自由主义者和民粹主义者提供了真正达成共识的机会。

consequently.sentenceEn: Consequently , it's worth bearing in mind that while deleting all social media accounts will undoubtedly make some feel infinitely better, many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed.
consequently.translationZh: 因此，我们应当记住，虽然删除所有社交媒体账号无疑会让一些人感觉好很多，但许多其他人却从这些分享平台所孕育的强烈社区归属感中受益。
consequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

consequently.sentenceEn: At this time, the causes of the disease are not well understood, and consequently , there are no proven steps that people can take to prevent it.
consequently.translationZh: 目前，这种疾病的病因尚未完全明确，因此，尚无确凿有效的预防措施可供人们采用。

consequently.sentenceEn: Feeding them, however, represents misguided kindness because the bears come to expect such generosity from everyone and consequently , trouble could lie ahead.
consequently.translationZh: 然而，投喂它们实属不当的善意，因为这会使熊类对人类的慷慨产生依赖，从而可能引发麻烦。
consequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

consequently.sentenceEn: Women, as their testimonies indicate, are generally more secure with each other and consequently are more likely to treat this issue lightly.
consequently.translationZh: 正如女性们的证词所表明的那样，她们彼此之间通常更加放心，因此更可能对这个问题不太在意。
consequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

constitute.sentenceEn: Massive rubbish dumps and sprawling landfills constitute one of the more uncomfortable impacts that humans have on wildlife.
constitute.translationZh: 巨大的垃圾堆和无序扩张的填埋场是人类对野生动物造成的较为令人不安的影响之一。
constitute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

constitute.sentenceEn: The knowledge we have about the object constitutes the cognitive component of an attitude.
constitute.translationZh: 我们对事物的认知构成了态度的认知成分。
constitute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

constitute.sentenceEn: In these abbreviated forms, much of what constituted the traditional political discourse of earlier ages has been lost.
constitute.translationZh: 在这些缩略形式中，早期时代构成传统政治话语的许多内容已不复存在。
constitute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

constitute.sentenceEn: Unbelievable as it may seem, part-time students constitute a considerable portion of the student body in many universities across the world.
constitute.translationZh: 尽管听起来令人难以置信，但在全球许多大学中，非全日制学生占学生总数的相当大比例。

constitute.sentenceEn: They constitute about 13 percent of the population.

constrain.sentenceEn: We think there is some risk that people's options will be constrained by their past in a new and unanticipated way.
constrain.translationZh: 我们认为存在这样一种风险：人们的选择将以一种全新且未曾预料的方式受到自身过去的限制。
constrain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

constrain.sentenceEn: Recommendation engines, which are increasingly prevalent intermediaries in people's consumption of culture, may serve to constrain choice and minimize luck.
constrain.translationZh: 推荐引擎作为人们文化消费中日益普及的中介，可能会限制选择并减少偶然性。
constrain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

constrain.sentenceEn: W: I felt too constrained working with the past, like what I wrote needed to be fact as opposed to fiction, but writing about the future gave me more freedom to imagine, to invent.
constrain.translationZh: 我觉得研究过去太受束缚了，好像我写的东西必须是事实而非虚构，但写未来给了我更多想象和创造的自由。
constrain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

constrain.sentenceEn: Simultaneously, food production has been constrained by a lack of scientific research.
constrain.translationZh: 与此同时，粮食生产因缺乏科学研究而受到制约。
constrain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

constrain.sentenceEn: However, parents shouldn't completely constrain children's viewing.
constrain.translationZh: 然而，父母不应完全限制孩子观看电视。
constrain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

constrain.sentenceEn: Innovative people are not constrained in connecting unrelated concepts.
constrain.translationZh: 创新人才在连接不相关概念时不受束缚。

coordinate.sentenceEn: An archivist is an advocate for preservation who, among other things, coordinates the restoration of maps and paintings, the digitization of vital records, and the creation of oral history projects.
coordinate.translationZh: 档案管理员是保护工作的倡导者，其职责包括协调地图与画作的修复、重要记录的数字化以及口述历史项目的创建等工作。

coordinate.sentenceEn: It helps them coordinate vast amounts of labor and material, and transforms the lives of its practitioners through focus and self-discipline.
coordinate.translationZh: 它帮助人们协调大量的人力和物力，并通过专注和自律改变实践者的生活。
coordinate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

coordinate.sentenceEn: Timed traffic lights are set according to schedules that are supposed to coordinate with peak traffic hours.
coordinate.translationZh: 定时红绿灯是根据旨在配合交通高峰时段的时间表来设置的。

coordinate.sentenceEn: Using computer technology, Pritchett and his crew created intricate, color-coded maps marked with the GPS coordinates of thousands of finds, all invisible under a meter of sand.
coordinate.translationZh: 普里切特和他的团队利用计算机技术绘制出了复杂的彩色编码地图，上面标注了数千处发现物的GPS坐标，而这些发现物全都隐藏在一米厚的沙子之下，肉眼无法看见。

coordinate.sentenceEn: Not all casualties can necessarily be prevented—but by coordinating across local, state, and even national borders, officials hope that the worst-case scenario can be averted.
coordinate.translationZh: 并非所有伤亡都能完全避免——但通过地方、州乃至国家层面的跨境协调，官员们希望能够避免出现最糟糕的情况。
coordinate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

coordinate.sentenceEn: It is closely coordinated despite seeming confusion.
coordinate.translationZh: 尽管看似混乱，但它的协调性很强。

criminal.sentenceEn: I'd say there's more money in property law, but the stakes are higher in criminal law.
criminal.translationZh: 我得说，财产法领域赚钱更多，但刑法领域的风险也更高。
criminal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第2句

criminal.sentenceEn: So I've been thinking about studying criminal law.
criminal.translationZh: 所以我一直在考虑学习刑法。
criminal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第2句

criminal.sentenceEn: The Paris prosecutor's office has opened an inquiry into "involuntary destruction by fire", indicating they believe the cause of the blaze was accidental rather than criminal .
criminal.translationZh: 巴黎检察院已对“过失火灾毁坏”展开调查，表明他们认为火灾原因是意外事故而非刑事犯罪。

criminal.sentenceEn: In contrast, the criminal justice system accounted for nearly one out of every five visual backgrounds.
criminal.translationZh: 相比之下，刑事司法系统几乎占据了五分之一的画面背景。

criminal.sentenceEn: Now, a new study that began with about 1,000 children in New Zealand has tracked how a child's low self-control can predict poor health, money troubles and even a criminal record in their adult years.
criminal.translationZh: 如今，一项在新西兰开展、约1000名儿童参与的新研究追踪发现，儿童时期自制力低下可能预示着成年后的健康问题、经济困境甚至犯罪记录。
criminal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

criminal.sentenceEn: Those with a criminal record mostly come from single parent families.
criminal.translationZh: 有犯罪记录的人大多来自单亲家庭。

cruise.sentenceEn: It's home to the second-busiest cruise ship port in the world and is a gateway to the cosmos.
cruise.translationZh: 这里拥有世界第二繁忙的邮轮港口，同时也是通往宇宙的门户。

cruise.sentenceEn: Recent protests in ports of call like Venice and Barcelona against disturbances created by cruise ships show the unfortunate consequences of emphasizing quantity over quality in tourism.
cruise.translationZh: 最近，在威尼斯和巴塞罗那等邮轮停靠港口爆发了反对邮轮造成干扰的抗议活动，这些事件揭示了旅游业重数量轻质量所带来的不幸后果。
cruise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

cruise.sentenceEn: On the contrary, when people stay at large resorts or on cruise ships, they make most of their purchases there, leaving local communities little opportunity to benefit from tourist spending.
cruise.translationZh: 相反，当人们入住大型度假村或乘坐游轮时，他们的大部分消费都发生在这些场所内，这使得当地社区几乎没有机会从游客消费中获益。
cruise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

cruise.sentenceEn: It's not clear that the cruise industry will survive.
cruise.translationZh: 邮轮行业能否挺过难关，目前尚不明朗。
cruise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

cruise.sentenceEn: Why did the couple fail to get to the cruise in time?
cruise.translationZh: 这对夫妇为什么没能及时赶上游轮？

cruise.sentenceEn: They have little opportunity to enjoy themselves on cruise ships.
cruise.translationZh: 他们几乎没有机会在游轮上享受。

calculation.sentenceEn: Solidarity is not just a product of strategic calculations of how much it will benefit the self.
calculation.translationZh: 团结不仅仅是基于个人利益能获得多少的战略计算产物。
calculation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

calculation.sentenceEn: But the researchers' calculation showed it would take 10 to 1,000 plants per square meter of floor space to compete with the air cleaning capacity of a building's air handling system or even just a couple of open windows in a house.
calculation.translationZh: 但研究人员的计算表明，要与建筑物空气处理系统甚至只是家中几扇打开的窗户的空气净化能力相媲美，每平方米地面空间需要10到1000株植物。
calculation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

calculation.sentenceEn: Similar calculations can be used to compare the U.S. and other countries.
calculation.translationZh: 类似的计算方法可用于比较美国与其他国家。
calculation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

calculation.sentenceEn: For example, this calculation puts economic welfare in the United Kingdom at 97% of U.S. levels, but estimates Mexican well-being at 22%.
calculation.translationZh: 例如，这种计算显示英国的经济福祉达到美国水平的97%，而墨西哥的福祉则估计为美国水平的22%。
calculation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

calculation.sentenceEn: More of them, though, will skip those calculations altogether and just power through the holidays into 2017: More than half of American workers don't use up all of their allotted vacation days each year.
calculation.translationZh: 然而，更多人会完全跳过这些计算，直接埋头苦干度过假期，进入2017年：超过半数的美国劳动者每年都用不完自己的法定假期。
calculation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

calculation.sentenceEn: Whether this is right, and if so where and when the ecological axe will fall, is hard to determine with any precision—which is why governments and financial institutions are only beginning to bring such risks into their economic calculations .
calculation.translationZh: 这种观点是否正确，以及如果正确的话，生态危机将在何时何地爆发，都很难精确确定——这就是为什么各国政府和金融机构才刚刚开始将此类风险纳入其经济计算中。

calendar.sentenceEn: Astronomer David Chapman explained that this is merely a peculiarity of our calendar ; once we stopped doing things based on the moon and started trying to follow the sun and the seasons, we stopped having one reliable full moon per month.
calendar.translationZh: 天文学家大卫·查普曼解释说，这只是我们日历的一个特殊之处；一旦我们不再根据月亮行事，而是开始尝试跟随太阳和季节，我们就不再每月有一个可靠的满月了。

calendar.sentenceEn: But these are all based on human calendars and activities and folklore; you will not go outside and see a pink moon in April, though I wish it were so.
calendar.translationZh: 但这些都基于人类的历法、活动和民间传说；四月里，你并不会在户外看到一轮粉色的月亮，尽管我也希望能看到。

calendar.sentenceEn: All of this is just calendar nonsense and we refuse to go into it further.
calendar.translationZh: 这一切都不过是日历上的无稽之谈，我们拒绝进一步讨论。

calendar.sentenceEn: And while that's not necessarily special in an oh-gosh-get-out-and-look-at-it way, it's certainly special: a blue moon is a nickname for when two full moons fall in the same calendar month, and we hadn't previously had two in one year since 1999.
calendar.translationZh: 虽然这不一定是那种会让人惊呼"天哪快出来看"的特别景象，但它确实很特别：蓝月是指一个公历月内出现两次满月的昵称，而自1999年以来，我们已经很久没有在一年中遇到过两次蓝月了。

calendar.sentenceEn: But after I moved to Tokyo and lived there for a number of years, I got used to having a pile of to-do lists and my calendar always looked like a mess, with loads of things to do written across it.
calendar.translationZh: 但在我搬到东京生活了几年后，我渐渐习惯了堆积如山的待办事项，日历也总是乱糟糟的，上面写满了各种要做的事情。
calendar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

calendar.sentenceEn: She stopped using to-do lists and calendars .
calendar.translationZh: 她不再使用待办事项清单和日历。

capitalism.sentenceEn: The champions of free market capitalism promised their way of life would bring us freedom.
capitalism.translationZh: 自由市场资本主义的拥护者曾承诺，他们的生活方式会给我们带来自由。
capitalism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

capitalism.sentenceEn: Free market capitalism hasn't freed us; it has trapped us.
capitalism.translationZh: 自由市场资本主义并未给予我们自由，反而将我们困入牢笼。
capitalism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

capitalism.sentenceEn: Capitalism turned printing from an invention into an industry.
capitalism.translationZh: 资本主义将印刷术从一项发明转变为一个产业。
capitalism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

capitalism.sentenceEn: Over the past year and a half, The Great Divide, a series in The New York Times, has presented a wide range of examples that undermine the notion that there are any truly fundamental laws of capitalism .
capitalism.translationZh: 在过去的一年半里，《纽约时报》的系列报道《大分化》提供了大量例证，对所谓存在真正基本的资本主义法则这一观点提出了质疑。

capitalism.sentenceEn: The dynamics of the imperial capitalism of the 19th century needn't apply in the democracies of the 21st.
capitalism.translationZh: 19世纪帝国主义资本主义的运行模式不必适用于21世纪的民主国家。

capitalism.sentenceEn: Many examples show the basic laws of imperial capitalism no longer apply in present-day America.
capitalism.translationZh: 诸多例证表明，帝国资本主义的基本法则已不再适用于当今美国。

carbohydrate.sentenceEn: Dr. Thompson argues that the main cause of this phenomenon is the modern diet, which is comprised of food high in sugar, carbohydrates and calories.
carbohydrate.translationZh: 汤普森博士认为，造成这一现象的主要原因是现代饮食结构，其中包含大量高糖、高碳水化合物和高热量的食物。
carbohydrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

carbohydrate.sentenceEn: Some people should eat more carbohydrates than others.
carbohydrate.translationZh: 有些人应该比其他人摄入更多的碳水化合物。
carbohydrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

carbohydrate.sentenceEn: Now, as we discussed last time, medical professionals have tried to fight the obesity epidemic by focusing on the nutrients found in different foods, emphasizing things like carbohydrate , fat, sugar and calorie content.
carbohydrate.translationZh: 正如我们上次所讨论的，医疗专业人员试图通过关注不同食物中的营养成分来对抗肥胖流行病，强调诸如碳水化合物、脂肪、糖和卡路里含量等方面。
carbohydrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

carbohydrate.sentenceEn: Whether the labels say 'non-GMO(非转基因的)' or 'no sugar,' or 'zero carbohydrates ', consumers are increasingly demanding more information about what's in their food.
carbohydrate.translationZh: 无论是标注着“非转基因”“无糖”还是“零碳水化合物”，消费者都越来越迫切地想知道自己所购买食品的成分信息。
carbohydrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句
