carbohydrate.sentenceEn: In addition to running and freezing showers, Rapp uses ice baths, hot yoga, and unconventional eating practices such as eliminating dairy, sugar, alcohol and various other foods high in carbohydrates .
carbohydrate.translationZh: 除了跑步和洗冷水澡外，拉普还采用冰浴、热瑜伽以及非传统饮食方式，例如戒食乳制品、糖、酒精和其他各种高碳水化合物食物。
carbohydrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

carbohydrate.sentenceEn: Those involved in the clinical trials on average ate 3.3 servings of pasta a week instead of other carbohydrates , one serving equaling around half a cup.
carbohydrate.translationZh: 参与临床试验的人平均每周食用3.3份意大利面，而非其他碳水化合物，一份大约相当于半杯。
carbohydrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

chart.sentenceEn: To truly chart our own path or vision, we have to be willing to isolate ourselves, at least for some period of time.
chart.translationZh: 要真正规划自己的道路或愿景，我们必须愿意独处一段时间，至少在某个时期内。

chart.sentenceEn: Once the final charts and tables are ready, I have to check them and organize a presentation.
chart.translationZh: 一旦最终的图表和表格制作完成，我就必须对其进行检查，并组织一场演示汇报。
chart.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第4句

chart.sentenceEn: W: As I said, variety is important and as for what I don't like, it has to be the checking of charts and tables.
chart.translationZh: 女：正如我所说，工作的多样性很重要。至于我不喜欢的部分，那肯定是核对图表和表格的工作了。
chart.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第1句

chart.sentenceEn: Mark read from the charts , "Police patrols cut back, illegal parking up 20%."
chart.translationZh: 马克读着图表上的内容：“警方巡逻次数减少，非法停车增加20%。”
chart.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

chart.sentenceEn: Mark looked at the charts taped to the walls.
chart.translationZh: 马克看了看贴在墙上的图表。
chart.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

chart.sentenceEn: There were charts for parking problems, crime, and for problems in vacant buildings.
chart.translationZh: 墙上贴着关于停车问题、犯罪问题以及空置建筑问题的图表。
chart.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

civilization.sentenceEn: The character traits held for every kind of community, be they traditional hunter gatherers or advanced civilizations , helping to uphold civilized society and foster social cooperation, researchers found.
civilization.translationZh: 研究人员发现，无论是传统的狩猎采集者群体还是先进文明社会，各类社群都具备一些共同的性格特征，这些特征有助于维护文明社会并促进社会合作。
civilization.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

civilization.sentenceEn: There's a risk that human civilization could be replaced by a superior type of digital life.
civilization.translationZh: 存在一种风险，即人类文明可能会被一种更高级的数字生命所取代。
civilization.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

civilization.sentenceEn: The Nile, which begins in central Africa and flows over 4,100 miles north into the Mediterranean, hosted one of the world's great ancient civilizations along its shores.
civilization.translationZh: 尼罗河发源于非洲中部，向北流淌4100多英里后注入地中海，其沿岸孕育了世界上最伟大的古代文明之一。
civilization.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

civilization.sentenceEn: Great civilizations and intensive settlement are hardly associated with the Amazon.
civilization.translationZh: 亚马逊河几乎从未与伟大文明和密集定居点联系在一起。
civilization.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

civilization.sentenceEn: Some have vanished from the face of the earth, others are dying slowly, but all have undergone changes as they have come into contact with an expanding machine civilization .
civilization.translationZh: 有些已经从地球表面消失，有些正在慢慢消亡，但所有这些社区在与不断扩张的机器文明接触后都发生了变化。
civilization.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

civilization.sentenceEn: Digital life could replace human civilization .
civilization.translationZh: 数字生命可能会取代人类文明。

collaborate.sentenceEn: By giving teachers more opportunity to collaborate , Mesa's administrators hoped to fill staffing gaps and boost teacher morale and retention.
collaborate.translationZh: 通过为教师提供更多合作机会，梅萨学区的管理人员希望能够填补人员缺口，并提高教师的士气和留任率。
collaborate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

collaborate.sentenceEn: That's why it's important for marketers to pay attention to the latest technological developments and consider collaborating with technological innovators.
collaborate.translationZh: 这就是为什么营销人员必须关注最新的技术发展，并考虑与技术创新者合作。
collaborate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

collaborate.sentenceEn: It seems to help us to course correct, improve and meet challenges while also building teams that collaborate and care for one another.
collaborate.translationZh: 这似乎能帮助我们及时调整方向、改进工作、应对挑战，同时也能打造出相互协作、彼此关怀的团队。
collaborate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

collaborate.sentenceEn: Particle physicists and astronomers collaborate often.
collaborate.translationZh: 粒子物理学家和天文学家经常开展合作。
collaborate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

collaborate.sentenceEn: The ability to work well with others and collaborate on projects is a sought-after ability in nearly every position.
collaborate.translationZh: 在几乎所有职位中，与他人良好合作并参与项目协作的能力都是备受青睐的技能。
collaborate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

collaborate.sentenceEn: Piaget believed that small children could not collaborate with others while playing.
collaborate.translationZh: 皮亚杰认为，小孩子在玩耍时无法与他人合作。

comet.sentenceEn: However, finding the comet is indeed very tricky.
comet.translationZh: 然而，要找到这颗彗星确实非常困难。
comet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

comet.sentenceEn: Where will this comet be in the sky?
comet.translationZh: 这颗彗星将出现在天空的哪个位置？
comet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

comet.sentenceEn: W: Tonight, the Earth will come into close proximity with the Oppenheimer comet .
comet.translationZh: 女：今晚，地球将与奥本海默彗星近距离接触。
comet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

comet.sentenceEn: W: The comet will be almost exactly due north, at 60 degrees above the equator.
comet.translationZh: 女士：这颗彗星将几乎正好位于正北方向，在赤道上方60度处。
comet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

comet.sentenceEn: W: The Oppenheimer comet will still be millions of miles away, on the edge of our galaxy.
comet.translationZh: 女：奥本海默彗星仍将在数百万英里之外，位于我们星系的边缘。
comet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

comet.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the conversation about the Oppenheimer comet ?
comet.translationZh: 从对话中我们了解到关于奥本海默彗星的哪些信息？

command.sentenceEn: This resulted in domesticated dogs that are highly responsive to human commands and gestures.
command.translationZh: 这使得驯化的狗对人类的指令和手势有高度的反应。
command.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

command.sentenceEn: Pet dogs can often readily understand a wide range of their owners' commands and gestures, but are these abilities inborn or are they exclusively learned through training?
command.translationZh: 宠物狗通常能轻松理解主人的各种指令和手势，但这些能力是天生的，还是完全通过训练习得的呢？
command.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

command.sentenceEn: Will it be one where the elite command the vast bulk of wealth and regional culture is defined by an aggressive business world?
command.translationZh: 我们会成为一个由精英阶层掌控绝大部分财富、区域文化被激进商业世界所定义的社会吗？

command.sentenceEn: By virtue of having the loudest voice, they're able to command greater attention and to further assert their dominance, even when what they're saying doesn't really make much sense.
command.translationZh: 凭借着最响亮的声音，他们能够获得更多关注，并进一步巩固自己的主导地位，即便他们所说的话其实没什么道理。
command.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

command.sentenceEn: To an extent, it has surprised us and the rest of the scientific community that telomeres do not simply carry out the commands issued by your genetic code.
command.translationZh: 在某种程度上，端粒并非简单地执行基因密码发出的指令，这让我们以及整个科学界都感到惊讶。
command.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

command.sentenceEn: They could understand the implications of human commands .
command.translationZh: 它们能够理解人类指令的含义。

competent.sentenceEn: Even if a competent person isn't required, supervisors need a broad set of skills to not only identify and alleviate workplace hazards but also build a safety climate within their team that supports intervening and open communication among them.
competent.translationZh: 即使不需要专业人员，主管也需要具备广泛的技能，不仅要识别和减轻工作场所的危害，还要在团队中营造安全氛围，支持团队成员之间的干预和开放沟通。
competent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

competent.sentenceEn: Beyond competent workers and supervisors, it's important to educate everyone within the organization that they are obliged to intervene if they witness a possible unsafe act, whether you're a designated competent person, a supervisor or a frontline worker.
competent.translationZh: 除了合格的员工和主管外，重要的是要让组织内的每个人都明白：无论你是指定的合格人员、主管还是一线员工，只要目睹可能不安全的行为，都有义务进行干预。
competent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

competent.sentenceEn: Competent workers are also required to stop work from continuing when there's a danger.
competent.translationZh: 有能力的员工在遇到危险时也必须停止继续工作。
competent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

competent.sentenceEn: On many worksites, competent workers must be appointed.
competent.translationZh: 在许多工作场所，必须任命合格的工人。
competent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

competent.sentenceEn: Several studies suggest that men feel the need to appear competent in all realms, while women worry only about the skills in which they've invested heavily.
competent.translationZh: 多项研究表明，男性认为自己需要在各个领域都表现出能力，而女性只担心那些她们投入了大量精力的技能。
competent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

competent.sentenceEn: The more knowledge one has, the more competent one will be.
competent.translationZh: 一个人的知识越丰富，能力就越强。

comprehend.sentenceEn: It will not comprehend that there are competing interests outside of health and fitness.
comprehend.translationZh: 它无法理解健康和健身之外还存在其他相互竞争的利益。
comprehend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第18句

comprehend.sentenceEn: One only has to look at the remarkable arts facilities at Britain's top private schools to comprehend this.
comprehend.translationZh: 只需看看英国顶尖私立学校里那些卓越的艺术设施，就能明白这一点。
comprehend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

comprehend.sentenceEn: This unintended impact has to do with the portrayal of conflict in media and how preschool-age children comprehend that conflict.
comprehend.translationZh: 这种意外影响与媒体中冲突的呈现方式以及学龄前儿童如何理解这些冲突有关。
comprehend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

comprehend.sentenceEn: Also, what I will say is that teaching a subject helps me comprehend it better myself.
comprehend.translationZh: 此外，我想说的是，教授一门学科能帮助我自己更好地理解它。
comprehend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

comprehend.sentenceEn: They will not be able to comprehend some of the profiles users put in.
comprehend.translationZh: 他们无法理解用户填写的一些个人资料。

container.sentenceEn: The problem lies in the fact that NASA conducted their tests in sealed containers that do not simulate the conditions in most people's homes or offices.
container.translationZh: 问题在于，NASA的测试是在密封容器中进行的，这些容器并不能模拟大多数人家庭或办公室的实际环境。
container.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

container.sentenceEn: I even use the same container .
container.translationZh: 我甚至使用同一个集装箱。
container.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

container.sentenceEn: You mean you own a 40-foot cargo container ?
container.translationZh: 您是说您拥有一个40英尺的货运集装箱？
container.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

container.sentenceEn: And I send all that to my warehouse in China in the same freight container I use for the furniture.
container.translationZh: 然后我把所有这些食品装进原本装家具的同一个货运集装箱，发往我在中国的仓库。
container.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第8句

container.sentenceEn: Not to be outdone, India's futuristic new Bharathi base, built on stilts(桩子) using 134 interlocking shipping containers , resembles a spaceship.
container.translationZh: 印度也不甘示弱，其新建的未来派巴拉蒂科考站采用134个互锁集装箱桩式结构，形似一艘宇宙飞船。

container.sentenceEn: NASA did experiments in sealed containers resembling the super insulated offices of 1970s.
container.translationZh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）在密封容器中进行了实验，这些容器类似于20世纪70年代的超级隔热办公室。

continually.sentenceEn: You don't have to continually be thinking of all your past decisions and whether or not you made the right one.
continually.translationZh: 你不必总是纠结于过去所做的每一个决定，也不必反复思考当初的选择是否正确。
continually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

continually.sentenceEn: But it's also a great example of how scientific research should continually reexamine and question findings to get closer to the ground truth of understanding what's actually happening.
continually.translationZh: 但它同时也极好地展示了科学研究应当如何不断重新检验和质疑发现，以更接近理解实际情况的根本真相。
continually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

continually.sentenceEn: Where changing a strongly deep-rooted habit requires changing our belief about that habit that penetrates deeply into our lives, continually manifesting that wisdom requires that we maintain a positive outlook.
continually.translationZh: 改变根深蒂固的习惯需要改变我们对这种深入生活的习惯的认知，而持续展现这种智慧则需要我们保持积极的心态。

continually.sentenceEn: One explanation of this superiority is that speakers of two languages are continually inhibiting one of their languages, and this process of inhibition confers general cognitive benefits to other activities.
continually.translationZh: 这种优势的一种解释是，双语者需要持续抑制自己的其中一种语言，而这种抑制过程能为其他活动带来普遍的认知益处。

continually.sentenceEn: Psychologists continually reveal new insights into the depth of young children's knowledge of the world, including their understanding of other minds.
continually.translationZh: 心理学家不断揭示出幼儿对世界认知深度的新见解，包括他们对他人心智的理解。

continually.sentenceEn: With the costs of education continually rising, public libraries remain places where all people can have access to education.
continually.translationZh: 随着教育成本的持续上涨，公共图书馆依然是所有人都能获取教育资源的地方。

corn.sentenceEn: It's been 10 days since the corn emerged and the farmer wants to determine if there are any parts of the field that require replanting due to a lack of emergence or wind damage, which can be severe in the early stages of the summer rainy season.
corn.translationZh: 玉米出苗已经10天了，这位农民想要确定田地里是否有任何区域因出苗不足或风灾而需要重新播种——在夏季雨季初期，风灾的破坏性可能会很大。

corn.sentenceEn: A group of corn farmers stands huddled around an agronomist(农学家) and his computer on the side of an irrigation machine in central South Africa.
corn.translationZh: 在南非中部，一群玉米农正簇拥在一位农学家和他的电脑旁，他们站在一台灌溉机旁边。

corn.sentenceEn: But Smith counters that if you factor in the hidden cost of government corn subsidies, environment degradation, and decreased human health and animal welfare, grass-fed is the more cost-effective model.
corn.translationZh: 但史密斯反驳道，如果把政府玉米补贴、环境退化以及人类健康和动物福利下降等隐性成本都考虑在内，草饲模式实际上更具成本效益。

corn.sentenceEn: The rest is feed-lot confined and fed grain and corn .
corn.translationZh: 其余的野牛则被关在饲养场，喂食谷物和玉米。

corn.sentenceEn: It has consequences: South Africa's ongoing drought—the worst in three decades—will cost at least a quarter of its corn crop this year.
corn.translationZh: 这会带来严重后果：南非目前正在经历三十年来最严重的干旱，今年至少将导致四分之一的玉米作物受损。

corn.sentenceEn: Other items placed on the table are a variety of fruit, ears of corn , gifts, and a communal unity cup for pouring and sharing drinks.
corn.translationZh: 桌上还摆放着各种水果、玉米穗、礼物，以及一个用于倒饮料和分享饮品的共用团结杯。
corn.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

correctly.sentenceEn: Trainers can monitor whether a person is doing exercises correctly .
correctly.translationZh: 教练可以监测一个人是否正确地进行锻炼。
correctly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第21句

correctly.sentenceEn: This is not a cheap way to do your shopping, however, as your host will, quite correctly , expect you to respond by presenting him with a gift of equal worth and beauty.
correctly.translationZh: 然而，这绝不是一种廉价的购物方式，因为主人完全有理由期待你回赠一份价值相当、同样精美的礼物。
correctly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第9句

correctly.sentenceEn: Paraphrasing what the other person has said to make sure we have understood correctly and refraining from offering advice unless asked to do so are two more ways to listen effectively.
correctly.translationZh: 转述对方所说的话以确保我们理解正确，以及除非对方要求否则避免提供建议，这是另外两种有效倾听的方法。
correctly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

correctly.sentenceEn: Whenever they responded correctly , they were rewarded with fish.
correctly.translationZh: 每当它们做出正确反应，就会得到鱼作为奖励。
correctly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

correctly.sentenceEn: Airline staff have not correctly coded its destination tag.
correctly.translationZh: 航空公司工作人员未对其目的地标签进行正确编码。

creator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

creator.sentenceEn: Creators are simply humans who use what they inherit, who absorb the past and manipulate it to create possible futures.
creator.translationZh: 创造者不过是那些利用所继承的事物、吸收过去并对其加以改造以创造可能未来的普通人。
creator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

creator.sentenceEn: Thus, humans are creators as a rule rather than as an exception.
creator.translationZh: 因此，人类天生就是创造者，而非例外。
creator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

creator.sentenceEn: Is a creator a genius who makes something out of nothing?
creator.translationZh: 创造者难道是那种无中生有的天才吗？
creator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

creator.sentenceEn: Mega Face's creators say it's the largest publicly available facial-recognition dataset out there.
creator.translationZh: MegaFace的创建者表示，这是目前最大的公开可用面部识别数据集。
creator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

creator.sentenceEn: The way their creators apply the principle of beauty may not be pleasing to everybody.
creator.translationZh: 创作者们对美的原则的运用方式可能并非人人都欣赏。

cynical.sentenceEn: W: Oh, Jeff, you're too preoccupied and cynical .
cynical.translationZh: 噢，杰夫，你心思太重，而且也太愤世嫉俗了。
cynical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第1句

cynical.sentenceEn: She's scientifically-minded, practical, somewhat cynical , and always skeptical.
cynical.translationZh: 她具有科学思维，注重实际，略带愤世嫉俗，且总是持怀疑态度。
cynical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

cynical.sentenceEn: W: I think your attitude to education is a bit cynical , Frank.
cynical.translationZh: 弗兰克，我觉得你对教育的态度有点过于功利了。
cynical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

cynical.sentenceEn: In a study of British civil servants, men who scored high on measures of cynical hostility had shorter telomeres than men whose hostility scores were low.
cynical.translationZh: 在一项针对英国公务员的研究中，在愤世嫉俗敌意测试中得分高的男性，其端粒长度比得分低的男性要短。
cynical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

cynical.sentenceEn: People who score high on measures of cynical hostility tend to get more heart disease, metabolic disease and often die at younger ages.
cynical.translationZh: 在愤世嫉俗敌意测试中得分高的人往往更容易患心脏病、代谢疾病，并且通常寿命较短。
cynical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

cynical.sentenceEn: What have scientists learned about cynical hostility?
cynical.translationZh: 科学家们对愤世嫉俗的敌意有何了解？
